1928a1711cdc623a54b9.title: Learning and Development Specialist
1928a1711cdc623a54b9.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

The Learning & Development Specialist supports the design, development, and delivery of member-facing training programs that enhance member engagement, support compliance and improve operational performance. Working closely with the Learning & Development Manager, this role helps create and deliver learning solutions across multiple formats – including instructor-led training, eLearning, and practical resources. The Learning & Development Specialist will own select projects while supporting program execution and the ongoing expansion of member-facing learning offerings. This role will also contribute to internal learning initiatives by assisting with employee training and partnering with leaders to drive adoption and participation.

**Duties And Responsibilities**
===============================

*Instructional Design*

* Design and develop member-facing learning content aligned to compliance, operational performance, and engagement objectives.
* Translate subject matter expertise (internal SMEs, legal/HR, operations) into practical learner-centered training materials.
* Create content across formats, including instructor-led training, virtual sessions, eLearning modules, and job aids/tool kits.
* Apply adult learning principles to ensure content is relevant, actionable, and accessible to diverse member audiences.
* Update and maintain existing training materials to reflect regulatory changes, business priorities, and feedback.
* Support needs analysis efforts by identifying learning gaps and recommending appropriate learning solutions.
* Collaborate with the Learning & Development Manager to scope, design, and prioritize new training initiatives.
* Ensure consistency in branding, tone, and quality of all learning materials.
* Contribute to the design and facilitation of employee-facing training and support assigned learning portfolios.

*Training Implementation*

* Coordinate and support delivery of member-facing training programs (virtual and/or in-person).
* Facilitate select training sessions, as appropriate, and support the Learning & Development Manager or other facilitators in delivery.
* Travel to agricultural regions to deliver training (25%). Mostly California and Arizona but can include national locations as well.
* Prepare facilitators with materials, agendas, and logistical support to ensure effective program execution.
* Manage training schedules, registrations, and participant communications for employee and member programs.
* Monitor participant engagement and adjust delivery approaches as needed to enhance learning outcomes.
* Gather and synthesize participant feedback to inform continuous improvement.
* Support rollout of new or updated training programs, including communication and adoption efforts.
* Partner with internal stakeholders (e.g., HR, legal, operations) to ensure training aligns with business and compliance needs.
* Assist in implementing internal training programs and supporting leaders in promoting participation.

*Training Administration*

* Assist in maintain and update training records, materials, and resources within the LMS or other learning platforms.
* Track participation completion, and basic training metrics for member programs.
* Generate reports to support evaluation of program effectiveness and member engagement.
* Ensure training materials and records are organized, current, and audit-ready (particularly for compliance content providers).
* Support vendor coordination, including scheduling, materials management, and basic oversight of external content providers.
* Manage logistics for training events, including materials, technology setup, and distribution of resources.
* Assist in maintaining training calendars and program documentation.
* Support continuous improvement efforts by organizing feedback, data and version control of materials.
* Provide administrative support for all WG University training programs and assigned learning portfolios.

*Other*

* Utilize all capabilities to satisfy one mission - to enhance the competitiveness and profitability of our members. Do everything possible to help members succeed by being curious and striving to understand what others are trying to achieve, planning, and executing work helpfully and collaboratively. Be willing to adjust efforts to ensure that work and attitude are helpful to others, be self-accountable, create a positive impact, and be diligent in delivering results.
* Maintain internet speed of 40 MB download and 10 MB upload and router with wired Ethernet.
* Maintain and service safety equipment (e.g., smoke detector, fire extinguisher, first aid kit.
* Maintain a clean DMV record and the ability to travel to locations throughout the U.S. (mainly California and Arizona) up to 25% of the time.
* All other duties as assigned.

**Physical Demands/Work Environment**
=====================================

The physical demands and work environment described here represent those that an employee must meet to successfully perform this job’s essential functions. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to communicate with others. The employee frequently is required to move around the office. The employee is often required to use tools, objects, and controls. This noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

* Bachelor’s degree or training certification and two (2) to three (3) years of experience designing learning (including eLearning) and facilitating training in a business environment preferred.
* Exceptional fluency in speaking, reading, and writing both English and Spanish and a solid understanding of cultural nuances of the Spanish language when translating written material.
* Proficiency with training technologies (LMS, multimedia, web conferencing). Exceptional skills in Microsoft Office suite, eLearning authoring software and the use of Artificial Intelligence.
* Experience in needs assessment, coordinating, planning, and evaluating learning programs
* Exceptional understanding of adult learning theory and Instructional Systems Design (IDS).
* Experience in working with learning technology solutions including learning management systems and online training platforms to help employees.
* Experience with individualized coaching to facilitate direct practical skills training.
* Internet access provided by a cable or fiber provider with 40 MB download and 10 MB upload speeds.
* Home router with wired Ethernet (wireless connections and hotspots are not permitted).
* A designated room for your office or steps taken to protect company information (e.g., facing computer towards wall, etc.)
* A functioning smoke detector, fire extinguisher, and first aid kit on site.
* Verifiable, clean DMV record and the ability to travel to various locations throughout the U.S. (mainly California and Arizona) up to 25% of the time.

03afdddfe0467e5fa54f.title: Firmware Engineer (Python / Embedded Linux)
03afdddfe0467e5fa54f.description:
#### **About Torus**

Torus is headquartered in Utah and is expanding manufacturing at our 545,000-square-foot facility in Salt Lake City called GigaOne. **We are** **the world’s first mesh energy infrastructure, uniting communities through resilient, sustainable, and intelligent power.** We design, engineer, manufacture, install, and support our systems end-to-end, standing behind them throughout their lifecycle. Torus systems help reduce costs, lower emissions, and protect facilities from outages, while strengthening the security and reliability of the broader utility grid. Torus is committed to American manufacturing, engineering excellence, and building energy systems that last.

Torus has raised over $267 million from investors like Magnetar, Mercado, ICONIQ and Origin Ventures. The investments are helping to accelerate deployment of modular power plants across utilities, data centers, and industrial sectors. This investor confidence reflects the strength of our team, technology as well as the scale of the problem we are solving.

At Torus, you will be part of something larger than a single product or technology. Your work will help build energy infrastructure that supports and strengthens our electrical grid, critical systems, industry, and communities for decades to come. We value accountability, collaboration, and clear thinking. We are looking for people who want to solve hard problems and build things that matter.

#### **About the Role**

*Embedded Systems and Firmware @ Torus*

We’re building energy storage and management solutions that help:

* Commercial and industrial businesses reduce their operating costs while increasing reliability.
* Grid operators keep the electricity grid stable and cost efficient.

Torus is hiring a **Firmware Engineer** to be an individual contributor on our firmware team, working in close partnership with our Firmware Architect. This is a hands-on role where you'll translate architectural direction into well-engineered, production-grade firmware.

#### **Our Tech Stack**

Our firmware application layer is Python on Embedded Linux (Yocto)—not C, not C++. This was a deliberate architectural choice: Python gives us speed-to-market, flexibility to respond to changing grid program requirements, and a clean separation between hardware and application logic. Our comms are primarily RS-485, so Python runtime overhead is seldom the limiting factor.

*If you've been writing Python to control hardware over serial protocols—in energy, robotics, industrial IoT, or test & measurement—you'll feel immediately at home here. If you've spent your career in C/C++ and are looking for that, this probably isn't the right fit.*

Each Torus device generates over a million data points per day and integrates with our cloud platform via MQTT/AWS IoT. Our systems also participate in Virtual Power Plant (VPP) programs, responding to real-time dispatch signals from utilities—which means our firmware decisions have direct, measurable impact on grid operations.

#### **What You’ll Do**

In this role, you will report to our Head of Embedded Systems and will be responsible for:

* **Developing firmware** features across our energy storage product lines: telemetry, control loops, cloud connectivity, and hardware abstraction layers.
* **Owning system integration**—working closely with hardware, data, and software teams to ensure seamless interoperability across the full stack.
* **Driving quality** through design reviews, automated testing, and documentation. (We believe engineers own their own QA.)
* **Debugging and optimizing** real-time embedded applications and serial communication interfaces in the field and in the lab.
* **Supporting scaling operations**—deployment tooling, remote monitoring, and root-cause analysis of field issues across a growing fleet.
* **Participate in on-call rotation** for escalated technical issues.

#### **Who Thrives Here**

* You're a systems thinker who's comfortable owning a problem end-to-end—from a register on a Modbus device to a graph in a customer dashboard. You care about code quality without letting it become a bottleneck. You're energized by the fact that the firmware you write shows up in real buildings, on real grids, doing real work.
* You don't need to be an energy domain expert on day one—but you're curious about how the grid works and motivated by the idea that good engineering here has an outsized impact on creating sustainable communities.
* You're also comfortable in a structure where a Firmware Architect sets system-level direction and you're the person who makes it real—bringing deep implementation judgment, surfacing tradeoffs, and pushing back when something won't work in practice.

#### **Required Experience**

* BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2-5+ years of hands-on experience developing commercial embedded software or firmware applications.
* Strong Python proficiency and real production experience running Python on Embedded Linux (Yocto or similar).
* Solid understanding of serial communication protocols—RS-485, Modbus, I²C, CAN, Ethernet.
* Experience with real-time embedded systems: multi-threading, inter-process communication, timing constraints.
* Ability to read schematics and PCB layouts to troubleshoot hardware integration issues.

#### **Preferred Experience**

* Experience with IoT device management at scale (fleet OTA, remote diagnostics).
* Familiarity with AWS IoT, MQTT, or data telemetry pipelines.
* Exposure to energy storage systems, inverters, or grid-connected hardware.
* Knowledge of VPP programs, demand response, or utility interconnection standards (IEEE 1547, UL 1741).
* Experience with containerized embedded deployments (Docker/Balena on Linux targets).
* CI/CD practices in embedded or hardware-adjacent environments.

#### **Additional Details**

**Background Check** All candidates are subject to a background check.

**Location + Travel** Remote U.S.-based role with occasional onsite work in Salt Lake City and surrounding area locations (air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned). Must be available during MT business hours.

**Compensation** $135,000 - 180,000 (Note: We have the flexibility to hire at different levels, which may impact the corresponding pay range.)

**Work Authorization** Applicants must already have the legal authorization to work in the US without requiring any employer sponsorship.

**Physical Requirements**

* Regularly operates a computer and other peripheral office equipment such as a printer or mouse.
* Ability to read, identify, observe and recognize details, color-coding and fine print at close range on associated engineering drawings.
* Ability to communicate information so others can understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.
* Must report to work reliably and with the ability to use full and unimpaired skills and judgment to safely execute your job.
* Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking English required.
* When on the production floor, required to don personal protective equipment to include, but not limited to ear protection, gloves, eye protection and/or safety helmet.
* When on the production floor, ability to observe, detect and respond to audible and visual machine malfunction warnings.

#### **Our Perks & Benefits**

Benefits eligibility is based on employment status.

Financial

* Employee Rewards Package including equity
* 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
* Torus paid life and AD&D Insurance with options to purchase additional coverage
* Voluntary short- and long-term disability insurance

Health & Wellness

* Health Benefits Package: Choice between traditional PPO or HSA-eligible medical plans with Torus covering 50% of medical premiums; Dental insurance; and Vision insurance
* Plan participants have access to telehealth services, mental health support and coaching, and exclusive discounts on brands, dining, entertainment, and more.

Time Off

* Unlimited discretionary PTO
* 10 paid company holidays
* Waiting period-free 100% paid parental leave

Culture & Community

* Regular company-wide offsites to showcase our progress and learnings. A time to step back, think strategically, and work on the business together.
* Team members receive Torus branded gear
* Peer Recognition Program
* Fully stocked break rooms with free snacks and drinks. Because great work deserves great fuel.

Torus is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

Torus participates in E-Verify. Once you accept a job offer, we will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from your Form I-9 to confirm work authorization.

123d85dfd26df02b0cd6.title: Account Executive, Upgrades
123d85dfd26df02b0cd6.description:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

**About the Role**

As an Account Executive on our customer expansion team, you'll help existing Steer customers get more value from our platform. This is a **full-cycle sales role**: you'll identify opportunities in your book of customers, make outbound calls, learn how each shop operates, demonstrate the right solution, handle objections, and close upgrades to Steer CRM or our phones product.

You'll work with repair shop owners and managers who already know Steer, but you'll need to earn each conversation and make a clear case for why an additional product fits their business. We're looking for someone who enjoys prospecting, takes ownership of their pipeline, and can build trust with small business owners.

  

*The role is remote.*  
*Compensation: $60,000 base salary; $120,000 on-target earnings (OTE), including commission.*

  

**What You'll Do**

* Proactively call and follow up with existing Steer customers to uncover opportunities for CRM and phones upgrades.
* Manage the entire sales cycle, from first outreach through discovery, demo, proposal, negotiation, and close.
* Learn each shop's goals and current workflow, then explain how the right Steer product could help.
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through consistent outreach and thoughtful follow-up.
* Keep customer conversations, opportunities, and forecasts accurate in the CRM.
* Partner with customer-facing teams to understand account history and support a smooth transition after the sale.
* Meet or exceed revenue and activity goals while providing a good experience for customers.

**What You Bring**

**Required**

* Experience owning and closing sales opportunities, ideally in a full-cycle or expansion sales role.
* Confidence making outbound calls and creating opportunities rather than relying only on inbound leads.
* Strong discovery, presentation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
* The ability to explain software in practical terms to busy small business owners.
* Organized pipeline management and consistent follow-through.
* A coachable, self-directed approach and comfort working toward a quota.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience selling SaaS, CRM, communications, or phone products.
* Experience growing revenue within an existing customer base.
* Familiarity with automotive repair shops or other service businesses.

**Interview Process**

* Initial screen — 30 minutes with Lead Recruiter

* Executive Interview — 30 minutes with Head of Sales

* Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes with Sr. Sales Manager

* Problem Solving Interview - 60 minutes with Director of People

* Reference checks

**Benefits**

* 100% remote
* 100% employer-paid medical insurance
* Flexible PTO with a 15-day minimum
* Generous parental leave
* FSA and HSA
* Employee Assistance Program
* 401(k)
* Learning stipend
* Work-from-home equipment
* Opportunities for career growth and development

**Why Join Steer?**  
  
At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence.

Here, you'll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well-being.

Join Steer to be part of a forward-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work.  
  
  
  
  
We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries.

Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.

79649990fe5be319d359.title: Shipping Coordinator
79649990fe5be319d359.description:
Job Title: Shipping Coordinator

Department: Shipping

Reports to: Converting Superintendent

Location: Shipping Department

Position Summary: The Shipping Coordinator manages the Inbound and outbound flow of finished product from ND Packaging to our customers. This role sets and confirms delivery appointments with customer receiving docks, coordinates closely with Customer Service and customers on scheduling and order changes, arranges pickups with dedicated and market/spot carriers, and manages the drop trailer yard to ensure the right trailers are in the right place at the right time. The Shipping Coordinator is a key link between production, customer service, and the carrier network, and directly impacts on-time delivery performance and customer satisfaction.

Compensation

The actual base pay offered to the successful candidate will be based on multiple factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge/skills, experience, geographical location, and internal equity. At ND Paper, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the high end of the range for their role, and compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate.

About Us

ND Paper is a leading manufacturer of high-quality pulp, paper, and packaging products in the United States, generating over half a billion dollars in annual sales. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Nine Dragons Paper (Holdings) Limited – the largest containerboard producer in the world – ND Paper is part of a global network committed to excellence and innovation. With two integrated pulp and paper mills in Rumford, Maine and Biron, Wisconsin, a packaging plant in Sturtevant, Wisconsin, and two sheeting facilities in Langhorne, Pennsylvania and Fairmont, West Virginia, the ND Paper family produces nearly one million tons of products annually. Our 1,100 dedicated employees are the heart of our operations, and we are committed to fostering positive work environments where individuals can advance and thrive. At ND Paper, we are investing in our future, and that starts with our staff.

Key Responsibilities & Expected Results:

* Demonstrate safety as a core value and establish a safe work environment by actively leading the safe execution of work.

**APPOINTMENT SCHEDULING & CUSTOMER COORDINATION**

* Set and confirm delivery appointments with customer receiving docks based on order ready dates, customer receiving windows, and transit time.
* Coordinate with Customer Service on order status, ship dates, and any changes to quantities, due dates, or delivery instructions.
* Communicate directly with customers as needed to schedule, reschedule, or troubleshoot dock appointments and delivery issues.
* Track and manage appointment windows to avoid missed or late appointments, detention charges, and customer dock rejections.
* Proactively flag orders at risk of missing their ship or delivery date and work with Customer Service and Production to resolve.
* Maintain accurate appointment and load records in the TMS/ERP system.

**CARRIER COORDINATION**

* Coordinate pickups and deliveries with dedicated fleet carriers and market/spot carriers to cover all outbound freight.
* Tender loads to carriers, confirm pickup times, and track load status through delivery.
* Source and negotiate spot market coverage for loads outside dedicated capacity, balancing cost, service, and on-time performance.
* Maintain relationships with core carriers and monitor their on-time performance, communicating issues back to carriers and leadership.
* Resolve carrier issues in real time — no-shows, delays, equipment problems, or appointment conflicts — and find alternate coverage as needed.
* Ensure carrier paperwork (BOLs, PODs, load confirmations) is complete and accurate for every shipment.

**DROP TRAILER YARD MANAGEMENT**

* Maintain real-time visibility of all trailers in the drop yard — empty, loaded, and in the queue for loading or pickup.
* Coordinate with the yard/spotter and shipping crew to position trailers where they're needed to keep loading and shipping on schedule.
* Track trailer detention/dwell time and push for timely carrier pickups to avoid unnecessary detention costs and yard congestion.
* Maintain an accurate trailer inventory (yard check) and reconcile against the TMS/ERP system regularly.
* Coordinate with carriers on trailer pool needs, swaps, and any shortages that could affect the shipping schedule.
* Keep the yard organized and flag any trailer damage, maintenance needs, or safety issues.

**OTHER KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Partner with Shipping/Production to sequence load-out around production schedules and bay/dock availability.
* Monitor and report on-time shipping and delivery performance; help identify root causes of misses and support corrective action.
* Track freight costs and flag opportunities to reduce spot market usage, detention, or accessorial charges.
* Support month-end and reporting needs related to shipping, freight, and yard activity.
* Assist with carrier onboarding, rate confirmations, and basic compliance/insurance documentation as needed.
* Communicate proactively and clearly across Shipping, Customer Service, Production, and Carriers — this role runs on coordination.

Qualifications and Skills /Education and Experience

* High school diploma or GED required, associate's or bachelor's degree in logistics, supply chain, or business a plus.
* 1-3+ years of experience in shipping, transportation, dispatch, or logistics coordination preferred.
* Experience working with dedicated fleets, spot/market carriers, or a TMS is a strong plus.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel/Office and ERP or transportation management systems.
* Strong phone and written communication skills for daily contact with customers and carriers.
* Ability to work under time pressure and manage a high volume of appointments and shipments daily.
* Occasional availability outside standard hours to resolve time-sensitive carrier or delivery issues.

Physical Requirements

* Primarily an office/desk role with frequent phone, email, and system-based work.
* Regular walking between the office and shipping floor/yard to coordinate with crews and check trailer status.
* Works in a manufacturing environment with periodic exposure to noise, dust, and dock/forklift traffic when on the shipping floor or in the yard.
* Required to wear designated PPE (safety glasses, hearing protection, safety footwear, high-visibility vest) when in production or yard areas.

324173daf25db4850a62.title: Senior Manager, LRBO Regulatory Operations
324173daf25db4850a62.description:
**Position Summary**

The Senior Manager, LRBO Regulatory Operations Is responsible for managing and executing specialized regulatory operations activities within Laws, Regulation & Business Optimization (LRBO), primarily supporting pharmaceutical promotional regulatory activities. The position ensures the accurate, timely, and compliant preparation and submission of promotional materials to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), including Form FDA 2253 submissions and applicable Office of Prescription Drug Promotion (OPDP) presubmissions.

  
  

The incumbent provides operational expertise in submission planning and readiness, process improvement, technology optimization, data analytics, and procedural development. The position requires independent judgment, proactive problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration to support efficient, effective, and scalable regulatory operations. The incumbent also provides notarial services and may coordinate or oversee additional Regulatory Operations resources as the function evolves.

  
  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Promotional Regulatory Submission Operations**

* Manage and execute FDA promotional submission activities, including preparation, assembly, tracking, and submission of required materials, as well as launch-related submission packages and supporting documentation.
* Perform independent operational quality control to verify submission completeness, accuracy, required components, and appropriate document versions prior to submission.
* Coordinate the operational planning, preparation, and submission of materials to OPDP for advisory review, including activities associated with accelerated approval products and product launches.
* Maintain accurate regulatory submission records, documentation, and correspondence in accordance with applicable requirements and internal procedures.
* Develop and maintain standardized submission checklists, templates, and reference materials to support accuracy, consistency, and timely execution.
* Identify and resolve submission-related operational issues, proactively escalating material risks or delays with recommended solutions.
* Collaborate with relevant cross-functional stakeholders to ensure timely availability of required materials and documentation for FDA promotional submissions.
  

  

**Operational Planning and Process Improvement**

* Anticipate and plan for promotional submission activities, including product launches and other time-sensitive regulatory submissions, and coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Support workload planning and o resource forecasting needs and recommending solutions to support business priorities.
* Evaluate and improve operational processes to enhance efficiency, accuracy, consistency, and scalability, including opportunities for standardization and automation.
* Support with establishing and maintaining business continuity and cross-training processes to ensure consistent regulatory submission support and reduce reliance on individual resources.
  

  

**Systems, Technology, and Data Analytics**

* Partner with system owners and relevant stakeholders to contribute to technology enhancements, including automation and system integration opportunities, supporting regulatory submission activities.
* Develop, maintain, and analyze operational metrics, dashboards, and reports to monitor submission performance, identify trends and risks, and recommend improvements.
* Provide operational updates and recommendations to functional leadership to support planning and decision-making.
  

  

**Operational Governance and Cross-Functional Support**

* Develop and maintain applicable procedures, work practices, operational guidance, and training materials; provide related training to internal stakeholders.
* Assess changes to FDA promotional submission requirements and coordinate necessary updates to operational processes and procedures.
* Serve as primary operational point of contact for FDA promotional submission activities, coordinating cross-functional alignment on workflows, responsibilities, and operational requirements.
* Support applicable inspection, audit, and internal assessment readiness activities.
* Coordinate and provide guidance to Regulatory Operations personnel and other supporting resources, as applicable, to ensure consistent execution of submission activities.
* Perform other regulatory, operations, legal, and/or corporate duties upon request.
  

  

**Knowledge, Skills, Competencies, Education, and Experience**

**Knowledge/Experience and Skills**

* 5+ years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical regulatory operations, including experience with FDA promotional submissions and Form FDA 2253 requirements.
* Knowledge of FDA promotional submission requirements and applicable OPDP presubmission processes.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex operational activities, competing priorities, and time-sensitive deliverables.
* Experience evaluating operational processes, identifying improvement opportunities, and implementing effective solutions.
* Experience with regulatory submissions systems, document management platforms, workflow technologies, and related operational tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to develop and interpret operational metrics, dashboards, and reporting.
* Strong project management, organizational, and cross-functional coordination skills.
* Demonstrated Independent judgment, proactive communication, and ability to develop actionable recommendations.
* Ability to lead projects, coordinate resources, and provide guidance or oversight to others.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
* Active Notary Public commission in the applicable jurisdiction, or ability to obtain a commission within six months of appointment; must maintain a valid commission thereafter.
  

  

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline preferred, or equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant professional experience.
* Additional training or certification in regulatory affairs, regulatory operations, project management, or related disciplines preferred.
* Paralegal certification and notary public commission preferred.
  

  

**Physical Demands and Work Environment**

* Type/keyboard, stand, lift/carry/pull light Items (10 lbs.).
* Use computer, phone, copier.
* Occasional travel may be required.

**Empower your Future at One of the Nation's Leading Independent Electrical Distributors!**

U.S. Electrical Services, Inc. (USESI) is the country's largest independent electrical wholesale distributor, comprised of 14 regional businesses, over 100 years of experience, and more than 1,500 employees.

USESI is seeking a full-time CDC Operations Manager to join our Distribution Center team. The successful candidate will be a hands-on operational leader who can build a strong safety culture, develop people, establish disciplined warehouse processes and deliver consistent service, productivity and inventory accuracy in a growing CDC environment. This position will be in a new CDC operation and will be a key role in establishing operations in a new territory.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead daily warehouse operations across receiving, put-away, replenishment, picking, packing, wire, staging and loading, ensuring safe, accurate and timely execution that meets branch and customer expectations.
* Build and maintain a safety-first culture by ensuring employees are trained, qualified and follow applicable SOPs, RF/scanning processes, PIT practices, PPE requirements and safety procedures.
* Provide visible, hands-on leadership on the warehouse floor, setting clear expectations, reinforcing accountability, coaching employees and removing barriers to success.
* Develop supervisors and frontline leaders through regular coaching, feedback, training and performance discussions.
* Establish daily staffing and labor plans based on workload, service requirements and available resources, adjusting as needed to ensure sufficient leadership coverage and effective communication and handoffs between shifts and departments.
* Monitor warehouse performance using key metrics such as safety, productivity/LPH, overtime, OTIF/service, inventory accuracy, attendance and turnover.
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying operational gaps, conducting root-cause analysis, implementing corrective actions and evaluating warehouse layout, product flow, labor utilization, equipment usage and standard work.
* Maintain inventory control and location integrity through accurate product movement, cycle counting, adjustment controls, shortage investigation and proper handling, storage, measurement and transaction accuracy for wire and other high-value inventory.
* Partner closely with transportation leadership to ensure outbound orders are staged, loaded and dispatched accurately and on time.
* Lead the onboarding and development of new employees, including training plans, coaching and 30/60/90-day reviews.
* Manage attendance, scheduling, performance issues and employee development consistently and in partnership with HR.
* Participate actively in recruiting, interviewing and selecting warehouse employees as staffing needs arise.
* Conduct regular startup meetings and communicate priorities, safety concerns, workload expectations and performance results to the team.
* Maintain warehouse organization and housekeeping standards that support a safe, efficient and professional operation.
* Ensure material-handling equipment, RF devices and other warehouse assets are properly assigned, maintained and used.
* Create a culture of accountability where employees understand what success looks like, how their performance is measured and how their work impacts the customer.
* Support implementation of new systems, processes and operational initiatives.
* Perform other operational leadership responsibilities as needed to support the overall success of the CDC.

**Qualifications:**

**Education**

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Bachelor's degree in business administration, supply chain, or a related field preferred.

**Experience**

* Minimum of 8 years of leadership experience in warehouse operations or a distribution center.
* Experience leading inventory control and receiving operations preferred.
* Previous experience supervising, coaching, and developing warehouse teams.
* Experience improving warehouse processes and operational performance.
* Wholesale distribution experience is preferred.

**Skills and Knowledge**

* Strong leadership, coaching, and employee development skills.
* Excellent organizational, planning, and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong understanding of warehouse operations, inventory management, and logistics.
* Knowledge of warehouse safety, PIT equipment and standard operating procedures.
* Experience with staffing, scheduling, hiring and performance management.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel.
* Experience with Solar Eclipse ERP or WMS is a plus.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate across departments and maintain a hands-on leadership presence.
* Ability to analyze operational data and make informed business decisions.
* Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.

**Benefits:**

At USESI, we believe that our benefits should make a difference—to you, your job, and the life you lead outside of work. We are dedicated to supporting our most valuable asset, our employees!

Full-time employees are eligible for the following comprehensive benefit plan:

* Medical, Dental, Vision, Rx coverage

* TeleMedicine
* Matching 401(k)
* Company-paid Life Insurance + (AD&D)
* Supplemental Life Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability
* Flexible Spending Accounts

As a company, we promote a culture of honesty and integrity, and value the trust it allows us to build with customers and employees alike. Our focus on our people is what sets us apart and keeps our customers coming back to work with us!
  
  
If you are seeking to be a part of a family, this is the place for you!
  
  
Performance Team handles end-to-end warehousing and distribution logistics needs utilizing our strategic network of storage facilities. Our facilities are capable of receiving, storing, processing and dispatching cargo, so we can build flexibility and resilience into the supply chain process. Our integrated solutions allow us to be prepared for supply chain risks, so we can plan distribution to better achieve lead time and goals despite unexpected conditions. Our extensive experience, connections, and deep expertise across different sectors, industries, and transportation modes, means we can be counted on for process excellence that will save time and money.

**Summary:**

Supervises and coordinates activities of workers concerned with ordering, receiving, storing, inventorying, issuing, and shipping materials, supplies, tools, equipment, and parts, in stockroom, warehouse, or yard by performing the following duties.

**Shift: Wednesday to Saturday 5am to 15:30**

**Responsibilities:**

* Reviews inbound appointment log and open order report each day in order to plan work activities.
* Plans inbound and out bound schedules accordingly to meet customer metrics.
* Determines staffing needs based on work load and schedules staff accordingly.
* Assigns workers to specific duties based on work load and shipping schedules.
* Reviews and updates operational procedures as necessary and ensures they are communicated to and understood by the warehouse associates.
* Tracks productivity and qualifies performance by individual, function, and department.
* Works with Inventory Control to ensure the highest level of inventory accuracy possible.
* Manages payroll of department.
* Advises employees on handling of items received, stored, and shipped; methods and use of equipment in handling, storing, maintaining, and shipping stock; and related problems.
* Traces history of items to determine reasons for discrepancies between inventory and stock control records and recommends remedial actions to resolve discrepancies.
* Determines work procedures, prepares work schedules, and expedites workflow.
* Issues written and oral instructions.
* Ensures that proper safety procedures are followed.
* Maintains harmony among workers and resolves grievances.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

Directly supervises 20+ employees in the area of Operations. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

**Education and/or Experience:**

High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or one to three months related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Company Benefits:**

* Medical
* Dental
* Vision
* 401k + Company Match
* Employee Assistance Program
* Paid Time Off
* Flexible Work Schedules (when possible)
* And more!

**Pay Range:**

$60,000 - $65k annually

* The above stated pay range is the anticipated starting salary range for the position. The Company may adjust this range in light of prevailing market conditions and other factors such as location. The Company will work directly with the selected candidate(s) on the final starting salary in accordance with all applicable laws.

You'll get the keys to how the agency runs: people, process, capacity and the money side of ops. You'll also get a founder who actually wants to let go of them.

One 10 Media isn't just another eCommerce growth agency. We run Meta and Google Ads and Klaviyo email and SMS retention for DTC brands. We're a top Klaviyo partner. We're a fully remote team of 10+ who have been working together for several years. We genuinely care about the work, the results, and each other. We're proactive, we say the thing even when it's uncomfortable, and we work with no egos and no silos.

**The Role**

You'll run day-to-day operations and report directly to our Founder & CEO, which frees him to focus on growth. This is a real ownership seat, not an assistant role. You set the rhythm, make the calls, and build the systems that let a small agency scale without breaking. The seat can grow into Director of Operations as we grow.

Full-time, remote (US) on Eastern business hours.

**What You'll Own**

* People and policies: team policies, PTO and time off approvals and coverage, and the team policy book.

* Capacity and resourcing: who's working on what, workload across client pods, and when we need to hire.

* Time and utilization: Harvest time tracking, weekly reviews and reporting that tells us where the hours (and margins) go.

* Team rhythm: team meetings, the operating cadence and following action items through to done.

* Hiring and onboarding: finding, trialing, onboarding and offboarding employees and contractors, including access, paperwork and first-30-day plans.

* Process: our SOPs and Asana setup, working with our SOP/QA coordinator so everything has an owner and a due date.

* Billing ops: invoicing follow-up, collections and contractor and creator payments (W-9s, fee tracking), working with our outside bookkeeper.

* Admin: contracts, renewals, tools and subscriptions, and the small asks that keep everything moving.

* Client experience: keep operations running smoothly all year so clients stay happy.

* Automation and AI: simple automations and AI workflows (Zapier, Claude, ChatGPT and similar) that keep admin light.

**You Might Be a Fit If**

* You've helped a small agency (ideally ecommerce, performance or email marketing) grow through the ~$1M to $3M stage, and you know what breaks along the way.

* You'd rather build a checklist than send the same reminder twice, and you hold people to it kindly and consistently.

* You're comfortable with the money side (invoices, collections, contractor pay) and with spreadsheets.

* You know Asana, Harvest (or Toggl/Clockify), Slack and Google Workspace, and you reach for AI to get things done faster.

* You write clearly, follow up in writing and don't wait for problems to escalate.

* You like autonomy and want a founder who hands you real decisions, not busywork.

* Bonus: you've worked a BFCM season, or you know Klaviyo, Meta Ads Manager, Shopify or QuickBooks.

**Pay & Perks**

* $85K–$115K base, depending on experience

* Performance-based incentives

* Fully remote, with a "work from anywhere" culture that takes work/life balance seriously

* Training and an education budget for your professional and personal growth

* Real autonomy to shape the role, with a path to Director of Operations

* Annual company events and team retreats

**How to Apply**

Apply with your resume and a short answer to the questions.

We read every answer. If this sounds like your kind of job, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: $85,000.00 - $115,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan

Application Question(s):

* Tell us about an agency that you scaled. What was your role and contribution?

Work Location: Remote

Job Description

Community Health Care Providers (CHCP) is seeking a **Program Specialist** to support the coordination, quality, compliance, and day-to-day operations of services provided to individuals with intellectual disabilities and/or autism.

The Program Specialist plays a key role in ensuring that individuals receive **person-centered, safe, and quality services** consistent with their Individual Support Plans (ISPs), CHCP policies and procedures, and applicable Pennsylvania Office of Developmental Programs (ODP) requirements.

This position requires someone who is organized, detail-oriented, dependable, and able to effectively communicate with individuals, families, Direct Support Professionals, management, supports coordinators, and other members of the individual's team.

Responsibilities

* Monitor the implementation of individuals' **ISPs** and ensure services are provided according to identified needs and outcomes.
* Complete, coordinate, and monitor required **individual assessments**.
* Obtain, maintain, and monitor required **consents and authorizations**.
* Complete and maintain accurate **quarterly reports** documenting individual progress, services provided, outcomes, and barriers.
* Create, update, and maintain accurate **individual face sheets** and ensure information remains current.
* Monitor individual records for missing, incomplete, or expired documentation.
* Ensure individual records are maintained in an organized and **audit-ready** manner.
* Conduct regular residential and program visits to monitor service delivery, health and safety, and compliance.
* Review service documentation and progress notes for accuracy and completeness.
* Monitor staff implementation of ISP requirements, behavioral supports, and individual-specific procedures.
* Provide coaching, guidance, and support to Direct Support Professionals.
* Assist with staff training and ensuring staff understand individual needs and program requirements.
* Participate in ISP meetings, quarterly reviews, behavioral support meetings, team meetings, and other required meetings.
* Monitor and assist with **incident reporting and follow-up**.
* Identify changes in an individual's needs, behavior, health, or safety and communicate concerns appropriately.
* Assist with internal audits, quality assurance activities, ODP monitoring, and licensing reviews.
* Maintain confidentiality of individual and employee information.
* Communicate effectively with families, guardians, supports coordinators, clinicians, staff, and management.
* Follow CHCP's established **chain of command** when addressing concerns.
* Promote individual rights, dignity, choice, independence, and community inclusion.
* Complete other duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications

* High school diploma or GED required.
* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Human Services, Psychology, Social Work, Education, Behavioral Health, or a related field required.
* Previous experience working with individuals with intellectual disabilities, autism, developmental disabilities, or behavioral health needs preferred.
* Experience with residential habilitation, Community Participation Services (CPS), or other human services programs preferred.
* Knowledge of ISP implementation and person-centered services.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and meet deadlines.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and professional boundaries.
* Reliable transportation and the ability to travel between program locations as required.

Required/Preferred Training

CHCP will provide or require applicable training, which may include:

* CPR/First Aid
* Medication Administration, when applicable
* Mandated Reporter
* ODP-required training
* NADSP training, when applicable

What We Offer

* Full-time employment
* Training and professional development opportunities
* Opportunities for advancement
* Supportive team environment
* Meaningful work supporting individuals in achieving greater independence and quality of life

Equal Opportunity Employer

Community Health Care Providers is an **Equal Opportunity Employer**. Employment decisions are made without regard to applicable protected characteristics in accordance with federal, state, and local law.

**Apply today to join CHCP and make a difference in the lives of the individuals we serve!**

Pay: $19.25 - $23.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Paid time off

**Description**

Working at Shared Practices Group means being part of a dynamic work environment where each one of our employees has the opportunity to make a difference. We love what we do, and it shows.

This role is equal parts sales strategist, performance coach, and operational leader. You’ll be responsible for meeting monthly collection targets.

The Practice Operations Manager is responsible for the patient experience through excellent service, ensures compliance with legal regulations, leads and motivates the dental team, and often contributes to marketing and growth strategies. This role is vital as it directly impacts the practice's reputation, profitability, and long-term success.

* Lead morning huddles with a sales lens: goals, behaviors, opportunities, and accountability
* Celebrate wins, troubleshoot gaps, and keep the team focused on outcomes

**Operations Management**

* Oversee day-to-day office operations to ensure efficiency and patient satisfaction
* Implement and maintain policies, procedures, and compliance standards
* Track and report weekly KPIs via the practice scorecard
* Support inventory and ordering when needed

**Team Leadership**

* Recruit, train, and coach high-performing staff
* Schedule and coordinate coverage to support production goals
* Conduct performance reviews and ongoing development
* Foster a culture of accountability, energy, and results

**Patient Experience**

* Ensure exceptional service from consultation through post-treatment
* Step in to complete consultations when needed
* Manage patient records and appointment flow
* Address patient concerns with professionalism and urgency

**Financial Management**

* Oversee collections and ensure monthly revenue targets are met
* P&L Responsibility
* Manage accounts receivable/payable and daily/monthly closings in Open Dental
* Monitor expenses and identify cost-effective solutions

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

This position will oversee the Sales Consultant, Dental Assistants and Lab Technicians.

**Requirements**

* 3–5 years of leadership or sales-focused role
* Proven ability to drive revenue and coach performance
* Proficiency in Google Suite
* Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, goal-driven environment
* Dental knowledge is preferred

**WHAT WE OFFER:**

* Competitive base salary
* Full healthcare benefits: medical, dental, vision
* Company-paid life insurance
* 401(K)
* Paid holidays, vacation, and sick time
* Leadership development and career growth opportunities
* A culture that values innovation, ownership, and patient-centric care

If you’re a sales-minded leader who thrives on driving results, coaching teams, and owning the business, this is your moment. Apply today and help us build the future of full arch dentistry.

**Salary Description** $65-75k/year

a877f1deb16fd94e37c0.title: Customer Care Operations Manager
a877f1deb16fd94e37c0.description:
**Company Description**

Founded in 1978, California Closets has built a reputation as the leader and design authority in premium space management, delivering custom-designed organizational solutions and exceptional service. We believe home is more than just a place — it should be a source of creativity, comfort, and connection. From beautiful walk-in closets and entertainment centers to versatile pantries and home offices, we design custom storage solutions that add value to your life and home by making space for what belongs. Think of it as ‘practical magic.’

 **Job Description**

The Manager, Customer Care is the accountable operational leader for California Closets’ centralized Customer Care function. This hands-on role leads the internal Central Support team and owns the operational relationship with the First Contact Call Center vendor, TLS. The Manager is responsible for day-to-day service performance, departmental KPIs, quality, lead-management operations, customer escalations, market support, operational risk, and continuous improvement.

The role maintains a strong working knowledge of contact-center workforce management principles to evaluate TLS forecasts, staffing and capacity recommendations, identify performance risks, and hold the vendor accountable for corrective action.

The Manager also serves as the business and operational owner for Customer Care Salesforce campaigns and lead-routing requirements. The role defines and validates operational requirements, coordinates setup and testing with appropriate technical partners, monitors routing performance, and remains accountable for business impact, escalation, communication and validation when issues occur.

Success requires equal strength in people leadership and operational management. This individual is expected to operate with minimal day-to-day direction, use data to identify root causes and recommendations, and drive issues through resolution even when execution requires support from TLS, Salesforce/Technology resources, Service Delivery or other business partners.

Pay - $95K or more depending on experience

Duties and Responsibilities

* Independently lead the day-to-day operation of the Central Support team, establishing priorities and ensuring business goals, service expectations and customer experience standards are met.
* Directly manage Customer Liaisons, Specialists and Team Leads responsible for consultation scheduling, technical support and back-office administration across supported communication channels.
* Own departmental performance and KPIs, including lead-management metrics, complaint and feedback handling, quality, team NPS and applicable contact-center service metrics; identify root causes and establish measurable corrective actions when results fall below expectations.
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for markets supported by Customer Care. Prepare performance reporting, analyze trends, conduct regular business reviews and translate findings into clear recommendations, owners and follow-up actions.
* Lead hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, payroll administration, schedules and rosters for the internal Central Support team; build a culture of accountability, customer focus and continuous improvement.
* Manage the Quality Assurance program and provide guidance to the Quality Assurance Team Lead. Audit and monitor customer interactions, identify trends and ensure coaching and corrective actions are completed for internal and external teams.
* Lead customer escalations with sound judgment, customer focus and solution-oriented decision making.
* Partner with Service Delivery to develop and maintain departmental SOPs, training and operational documentation, and ensure consistent execution across Central Support and applicable vendor teams.
* Communicate recurring issues, trends, risks and key learnings to leadership and internal partners, including Marketing, Product, Service Delivery and Technology, and drive follow-through on agreed actions.
* Perform other duties aligned to the scope and accountability of the role.

Vendor Performance

* Own the day-to-day operational relationship with TLS, including service performance, quality, lead-management expectations, issue escalation, action-plan follow-through and adherence to agreed operating standards.
* Maintain a strong working knowledge of workforce-management principles, including forecasting, capacity planning, staffing, scheduling and intraday management, sufficient to evaluate vendor recommendations and performance.
* Review and challenge TLS forecasts, staffing and capacity plans; understand forecast-versus-actual performance and escalate material staffing or service-level risks.
* Hold TLS accountable for investigating performance gaps, presenting recovery plans and demonstrating sustained improvement. Ensure operational issues remain actively managed through resolution rather than relying solely on ticket creation or vendor escalation.
* Use vendor performance, quality and operational data to identify trends and recommend changes to processes, training, staffing assumptions or service-delivery practices.

Salesforce Campaign & Lead Routing Operations

* Own the business and operational requirements for Customer Care lead management and customer service campaigns, queues and lead-routing processes.
* Guide and coordinate campaign setup, routing changes, testing, launch readiness and post-launch validation with appropriate Salesforce/Technology partners and TLS.
* Maintain current documentation of campaign purpose, routing logic, operational dependencies, ownership and escalation paths.
* Monitor lead-routing and campaign performance for exceptions, failures or unintended outcomes that may affect customer response, lead handling or market performance.
* When campaign or routing issues occur, assess business impact, coordinate containment or interim procedures, engage the appropriate technical owner, communicate status to stakeholders, and validate operational recovery before closure.
* Provide operational input into Salesforce enhancements and process changes that affect Customer Care, lead management, routing or call-center workflows.

Operational Risk & Incident Management

* Identify and escalate material operational risks based on customer, lead, service, revenue or brand impact, developing and following established escalation protocols.
* Own business-side incident coordination through containment, technical or vendor escalation, operational workaround, validation and closure.
* Communicate issue scope, business impact, current status, ownership, interim actions and next steps to affected stakeholders and leadership.
* Lead or participate in post-incident reviews for material or recurring issues and ensure preventive actions, documentation, controls, testing or training are implemented.

 **Qualifications**  

* 7+ years of progressive customer care or contact-center experience, including demonstrated responsibility for contact-center operations and people leadership.
* Demonstrated experience managing outsourced contact-center or BPO relationships and holding partners accountable for service, quality and operational performance.
* Strong understanding of contact-center workforce-management principles and ability to evaluate forecasts, staffing plans, capacity recommendations and service-level performance; direct ownership of vendor agent scheduling is not required.
* Experience working with Salesforce or a comparable CRM in a lead-management, campaign, queue or routing environment. Ability to define business requirements, validate operational outcomes and partner effectively with technical resources.
* Thorough understanding of contact-center KPIs and performance drivers, with the ability to interpret operational data, identify root causes and turn findings into executable, measurable plans.
* Experience leading operational incidents or cross-functional escalations and maintaining accountability through resolution.
* Strong process-management and continuous-improvement capabilities, including development and maintenance of SOPs and operating controls.
* Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to clearly communicate performance, risks, recommendations and decisions to team members, vendors, markets and leadership.
* Proven people leadership capability, including hiring, coaching, performance management and development of team members and leads.
* Strong working knowledge of contact-center and CRM technologies and the ability to distinguish operational issues from technical issues and engage the appropriate owner.

Key Success Characteristics

* Operational ownership: takes accountability for business outcomes and drives issues through resolution, even when another team or vendor performs the technical work.
* Analytical judgment: uses data to diagnose performance, challenge assumptions and make clear recommendations.
* Proactive communication: identifies and communicates material risks early, with impact, ownership and an action plan.
* Vendor leadership: establishes clear expectations and follows through on corrective actions and sustained performance.
* Process discipline: ensures campaign, routing, escalation and service processes are documented, tested and consistently executed.
* Customer focus: balances operational efficiency with the quality of the customer and market experience.

  
**Additional Information**

Find us on Facebook, YouTube, and Instagram

*We are an equal opportunity employer. We E-Verify.*  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

fdf4eaca7fcdbff70b18.title: Senior People Operations Coordinator, Claude Corps
fdf4eaca7fcdbff70b18.description:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 50,000 students from more than 1,000 universities. Our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. After nearly a decade of training technical talent, we launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic to prepare people for careers in AI.

We're expanding into new markets and growing our team as AI changes the workforce. People joining CodePath now will help shape this next stage of our work.

We believe technical skills create opportunities. Our goal is to train millions of learners and create lasting economic impact. If you want to build something new, take ownership, and see the results of your work, this is a place to do it.

**Location:** Remote (US)
  
**Role Type:** Full-Time
  
**Reporting to:** Senior HR Business Partner, Claude Corps  
**Compensation:**$65,000 to $85,000

**About Claude Corps**

Claude Corps is a fellowship that places early-career talent in nonprofits, government agencies, and public-interest organizations to build AI solutions those organizations can continue using after the fellowship ends. It is a partnership between Anthropic, CodePath, and Social Finance. Fellows are full-time employees for a one-year term.

Cohorts now run in the hundreds, and new fellows onboard while earlier cohorts are still placed. We need a coordinator who can run the day-to-day onboarding work at that scale, in partnership with the Senior HR Business Partner, and make sure every step is organized, accurate, and completed on time.

**About the Role**

You run the day-to-day onboarding work for Claude Corps fellows, from signed offer through completion of required employment steps. You send instructions, track progress, maintain employee records, and coordinate payroll and benefits setup.

The Senior HR Business Partner owns the overall onboarding process and handles sensitive questions and exceptions. You complete the work, keep fellows informed, and flag issues early.

You work closely with recruiting, the Claude Corps program team, Finance, and our HR service providers. Between onboarding waves, you help maintain records, coordinate offboarding, and improve processes so the team is ready for the next cohort.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**Coordinate fellow onboarding**

* Manage onboarding for each cohort, including offer tracking, background checks, I-9 verification, employee information collection, HRIS setup in CoAdvantage, and benefits enrollment
* Track required employment steps and deadlines, ensuring fellows are ready to start on time and records are complete and accurate
* Maintain a centralized onboarding tracker, proactively identifying outstanding items, potential delays, and issues requiring escalation
* Coordinate with Finance on onboarding clearances and flag sensitive or compliance-related concerns to the Senior HR Business Partner

**Be the primary point of contact for fellows**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for onboarding questions, providing timely, clear, and supportive communication
* Send onboarding instructions, reminders, and updates so fellows understand what to expect and what actions they need to take
* Resolve routine questions and coordinate with the appropriate HR partners on benefits, system issues, or policy-related matters
* Manage the HR inbox with care, discretion, and consistent follow-through

**Maintain systems and improve processes**

* Keep employee records, onboarding trackers, process documentation, the Notion hub, and relevant Fellow Handbook resources accurate and up to date
* Support offboarding and ongoing employee record maintenance between onboarding cohorts
* Create clear, repeatable workflows that support larger cohorts and allow additional team members to step in when needed
* Use AI and automation to reduce repetitive work, improve efficiency, and maintain accuracy as the program grows

**Requirements**
----------------

* Experience coordinating high-volume onboarding, people operations, or HR processes with time-sensitive requirements
* Familiarity with HRIS or PEO systems and the ability to learn new tools quickly
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with experience maintaining accurate records, trackers, and deadlines
* Clear, warm communication skills and a commitment to creating a positive employee experience
* Sound judgment when handling confidential information, resolving questions, and escalating sensitive matters
* Experience using AI or automation tools to improve workflows and reduce manual work
* A proactive, service-oriented approach and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

**Key Success Metrics**

* **Onboarding Readiness:** Fellows complete required employment steps accurately and on time, with payroll and benefits information ready for their start dates
* **Fellow Experience:** Fellows receive clear instructions, timely updates, and responsive support throughout onboarding
* **Operational Accuracy:** Employee records and onboarding trackers remain current, with potential issues identified and communicated early
* **Efficiency and Collaboration:** Teams receive timely information, and onboarding processes become more consistent and efficient as cohorts grow

**Compensation**

CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position’s level, no matter where you live. For this role, we’re offering an annual salary of $65,000 to $85,000. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process.

**Full-Time Employee Benefits**

This is a remote position—work from anywhere in the US! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

* Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program
* Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection
* Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)
* Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support
* Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt
* Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings

Pay range

$65,000 - $85,000 USD

f4d712a5e8f916aea6e3.title: Senior TA Operations Specialist
f4d712a5e8f916aea6e3.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

#### **The role**

You will be the hands-on operator behind our Workday work and a key resolver for our core recruiting systems. In the near term you will help test and implement Workday for Talent Acquisition, then support it and improve its processes after go-live. Alongside that, you will resolve issues across Greenhouse and ChartHop for the core processes that recruiters and coordinators depend on, such as backfills and conversions. You will spot patterns in what breaks and fix the process, not just the ticket.

### **What you will do**

#### **Workday testing and implementation**

* Partner with the Workday project team and TA stakeholders to document requirements, write and run test scenarios, and track and retest defects.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing with recruiters, coordinators, and business partners, and make sure issues are resolved before go-live.
* Validate data and process flows between Workday and our other TA systems, and help prepare cutover, training materials, and communications.

#### **Workday support and improvement after go-live**

* Be a first point of escalation for Workday questions and issues from TA, resolving what you can and routing the rest with clear context.
* Iterate on processes after launch: gather feedback, find friction, and propose and test improvements.
* Keep process documentation and job aids current as configuration and workflows change.

#### **Core systems resolution (Greenhouse and ChartHop)**

* Resolve system issues that affect core processes, including backfills, conversions, and requisition and headcount alignment between systems.
* Investigate data and sync discrepancies, fix the root cause where you can, and escalate with a clear summary where you cannot.
* Handle support tickets and requests with consistent quality and response times.

#### **Continuous improvement**

* Track recurring issues and questions, identify root causes, and recommend changes to configuration, process, or training.
* Partner with the enablement team so recurring questions become better training and guidance.
* Help define process around outcomes and actual tool usage, so the tools get used correctly and consistently.

**How the role evolves**
------------------------

Early on, your time is split between Workday testing and implementation and core systems resolution. After go-live, the balance shifts toward Workday support and process improvement, while core systems resolution continues. As the Workday footprint grows, this role is a natural path toward leading larger systems projects, initiatives, and process improvement for TA to meet increasingly complex and scaling business needs.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
  + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
  + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

### **Data Privacy**

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

  

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.
