2b6473eb52122e286d00.description:
Are you ready to Level Up?  
Join our growing team as a Support Operations Specialist  
  
**About the role**  
You will own the systems, reporting, and knowledge that keep Track's Customer Support team running smoothly. Reporting to the Support Operations Manager, you will partner with Support Leadership, Product, and Engineering to tune Zendesk, build the dashboards our leaders rely on, and grow our AI and self-service tools. As our support team scales, this role exists to make every ticket easier to solve, or better yet, never needed. This is a remote, full-time role with about 10% travel.  
  
**What you will do**  

* Keep Zendesk running clean by tuning views, macros, triggers, automations, and routing so tickets land in the right hands the first time.
* Build dashboards that track ticket volume, backlog, response and resolution times, SLA performance, and CSAT, and flag trends before they turn into problems.
* Find the manual work slowing the team down and remove it through better workflows, automation, or documentation.
* Own the knowledge base so customers and agents find answers fast, writing and updating internal and external articles and troubleshooting guides across Track's products.
* Configure, test, and improve our AI support tools and chatbots, keeping content AI-ready and driving up ticket deflection and self-service adoption.
* Build onboarding and ongoing training for Tier 1 and Tier 2 Support so new agents ramp faster and stay current on product changes.
* Partner with Tier 3, Product, and Engineering to document known issues, defects, and workarounds, and keep user access across support tools accurate.

**What you will bring**  

* 2+ years in customer support, support operations, or technical enablement at a SaaS or technology company.
* Hands-on admin experience with Zendesk or a similar platform, including views, macros, triggers, automations, routing, and reporting.
* Real experience implementing and optimizing AI-powered support tools, chatbots, or self-service solutions that reduced support volume.
* A track record of writing knowledge base articles, technical documentation, or training content that turns complex topics into clear, actionable steps.
* Solid command of support operations and metrics, including SLAs, escalation paths, and defect tracking, and the ability to use data to recommend process changes.
* Working knowledge of tools like Jira, Confluence, or Salesforce.

**You will thrive here if**  

* You see the same ticket come in a third time and can't help but build the article, macro, or automation that stops it from coming back.
* You like being the connector between Support, Product, and Engineering, and you will chase down the details on a defect until the workaround is documented and the team knows about it.
* You are excited to figure out what actually works with AI in support, and you want a seat that can grow into leadership in Support Operations, AI and Support Automation, CX Operations, or Support Enablement.

**Compensation**  
The expected starting base salary range for this role is $38.46 - $43.27 per hour, plus eligibility for a 10% annual incentive tied to company performance. Final compensation is based on relevant skills, experience, education, and geographic location.  
  
**About Track**  
Track is an end-to-end SaaS and Service Operating Platform for short term rental. For more than two decades we have helped hospitality professionals achieve digital transformation and operational excellence, anchored by our flagship Track Property Management System.  
  
Our single-vendor ecosystem gives growing vacation rental companies the enterprise-class tools they need to scale, backed by 70+ integration partners, a growing suite of native features, and AI-driven tools that sharpen pricing, distribution, and guest communication. We combine deep hospitality expertise with forward-thinking technology and a customer-obsessed mindset to help property managers win.  
  
Track is proud to be named an Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Company in America and a People's Choice Award winner.  
  
**Our core values**  
These are the behaviors that shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our customers.

1ee52a325e3c9550c8ac.description:
Vimly is hiring a Client Services Specialist to serve as the Tier 2 contact for members, employer groups, brokers and internal teams. You will own nine areas of group administration, from user access to EDI support. You will keep each one accurate and on deadline. This role will report to our Manager, Client Services.

  

At Vimly, our mission is to simplify the complexities of workforce and benefit administration for our customers and partners. We need team-oriented people who want to do excellent work, grow and enjoy the day while they do it.

  

**YOU WILL OWN NINE AREAS OF GROUP ADMINISTRATION**

Each area has a clear start, a deadline and a record in Salesforce. You will work them through cases and log every step so the next person can see what happened.

* **User Access** - Set up, change and remove Vimly platform access for employer, broker and trust users. Troubleshoot login and permission problems, and answer how-to questions about SIMON features.
* **New Groups** - Set up new employer groups, including plan setup, SBS tagging and new plan document tagging. Confirm each group is ready before its effective date.
* **Renewals** - Process renewing groups and rolling renewals. Update plan and rate information, and track every renewal deadline through completion.
* **Terms & Reinstatements** - Process employer and group terminations, then reinstate groups and members when coverage resumes. Confirm the billing and carrier impact of each change.
* **New Group & Renewal Audits** - Check each new group and renewal against its source documents. Maintain the audit engine, and correct errors before they reach a carrier or member.
* **Broker Management** - Keep broker records current, answer producer questions, and support broker commissions and case closing.
* **Reporting** - Build recurring and ad-hoc reports in Excel and Cleaner Reports. Support ACA reporting and send compliance notices (SAR, Medicare Part D, CMS disclosure, Form M-1).
* **Trust Meeting Support** - Prepare reports and materials for trust meetings, record action items, and follow up until each one closes. Track deadlines and deliverables for your assigned trusts.
* **EDI Support** - Start manual carrier loads, review 834 suspensions and reconcile eligibility between SIMON and carriers. EDI (electronic data interchange) 834 files carry enrollment data to carriers.

  

**YOU WILL ALSO PROVIDE GENERAL SUPPORT**

* Keep detailed logs, documentation and audit trails in internal systems.
* Act as the liaison between clients, brokers, insurance carriers and providers.
* Contribute to internal initiatives, process documentation and cross-functional projects.
* Help other departments with overflow work and special assignments.

  

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* High school diploma or GED required. Associate or bachelor's degree preferred.
* 1+ years in customer service, administrative support, operations or customer success.
* 1-2 years in benefits, eligibility, billing, and enrollment/Benefits Administration Experience
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, especially Excel (pivot tables, formulas, reporting).
* Salesforce or another CRM (preferred).
* Working knowledge of EDI 834 files or carrier eligibility feeds (preferred).
* Strong math, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Clear verbal and written communication with a professional tone.
* High accuracy, attention to detail and respect for confidentiality.
* Skill at managing large workloads, shifting priorities and firm deadlines while working remotely.
* Comfort with Teams, Zoom and shared drives.

  

**What Will Help You Excel**

* Alignment with Vimly's values and strategic goals.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a customer-first mindset.
* Organization and time-management habits that hold up under volume.
* Composure under pressure and in challenging conversations.
* High integrity and sound judgment.
* Self-motivation and willingness to learn and take on new responsibilities.
* Project management skills and comfort with changing processes.

  

**What We Offer**

**Base salary:** $23/hr.+Bonus.

Comprehensive bonus plan.

Thomas Jefferson University Hospitals, Inc.

ae710ff117f8fc1f69a6.title: Coordinator, New Student and Family Programs
ae710ff117f8fc1f69a6.description:
**Temple University's New Student and Family Programs Department is searching for a Coordinator.**

Become a part of the Temple family and you will have access to the following:  
**A hybrid work schedule**  
**Full medical, dental, vision coverage**  
**Paid time off**  
**3 Personal Days**  
**Tuition remission - eligible employees and their dependents can obtain a degree TUITION FREE**  
**A generous retirement plan and so much more!**

**Salary Grade: T24**  
*A variety of important factors are reviewed by HR when considering salary, including job duties, the applicant’s education and experience, all relevant internal equity considerations, department budget, and funding source.*

**Position Summary**  
The Coordinator for New Student Programs is a full-time member of the New Student and Family Programs (NSFP) team within the Division of Student Affairs and reports to the Associate Director of New Student and Family Programs. This role supports the planning, implementation, and continuous improvement of orientation and transition programs that foster belonging, engagement, academic readiness, and successful transition for new first-year and transfer students.  
Primary responsibilities include the implementation of day-to-day coordination of assigned components of orientation experiences, transition initiatives, student communications and resources, and related programs. This includes coordinating program logistics, staffing, materials, technology, registration, and on-site execution while collaborating with academic and administrative partners across the University.

A key component of the role is coordinating and supporting the recruitment, selection, training, scheduling, supervision, and evaluation of undergraduate student leaders, working closely with the Associate Director to ensure effective staffing and program delivery. This position also supports the implementation and support of year-round transition and engagement initiatives for new first-year and transfer students, including programs designed to foster connection, belonging, peer support, and continued engagement throughout the first-year experience.

The Coordinator supports the department's assessment and continuous improvement efforts through data collection, program evaluation, reporting, and implementation of identified improvements. The position also contributes to the development and delivery of student-facing communications, resources, and outreach associated with orientation and transition programs.

In collaboration with members of New Student and Family Programs and university partners, the position supports departmental priorities and contributes to broader programs and initiatives, including family and Engagement Portfolio programs, as assigned.

Performs other duties as assigned.

**Application requirements**  

* Please submit a resume

**Job-related Details**  

* This position requires the following background check: Cash Handling and Personally Identifiable Information background check. This must be completed prior to commencement of service.
* Offer of employment is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment physical.
* This position is assigned to a hybrid work arrangement (on-campus and remote). The duration of this hybrid work arrangement is at the discretion of Temple University and the hiring department.
* Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends (when necessary).

**Required Education and Experience**  

* Bachelor's degree with concentration in Student Affairs, Higher Education, or related field
* And at least 2 years directly related experience in a full-time, professional environment.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

**Preferred Experience**  

* Master’s degree with concentration in Student Affairs, Higher Education, or related field and at least one year of full-time, professional experience.

**Required Skills and Abilities**  

* Demonstrated ability to handle and prioritize diverse tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience coordinating and implementing student programs, orientation and transition programs, or related student services and training.
* Excellent organizational skills, along with the ability to prioritize and work independently and efficiently.
* Ability to foster positive interactions and work with a diverse group of students, parents, faculty, staff and other stakeholders.
* Ability to recruit, direct, and manage large group of student workers.
* Competency with remote learning and engagement technology.
* Exceptional oral and written communication skills, along with the ability to tailor communication to specific audiences.
* Strong customer service and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Access and Excel).

**Temple University** is committed to a policy of equal opportunity for all in every aspect of its operations, including employment, service, and educational programs. The University has pledged not to discriminate on the basis of age, color, disability, marital status, national origin or ethnic origin, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information or veteran status.

**Compliance Statement**: In the performance of their functions as detailed in the position description employees have an obligation to avoid ethical, legal, financial and other conflicts of interest to ensure that their actions and outside activities do not conflict with their primary employment responsibilities at the institution. Employees are also expected to understand and be in compliance with applicable laws, University and employment policies and regulations, including NCAA regulations for areas and departments which their essential functions cause them to interact.

**Temple University's Annual Security and Fire Safety Report** contains statistics, policies, and procedures related to campus safety. Go here to review: https://safety.temple.edu/reports-logs/annual-security-report

You may request a copy of the report by calling Temple University’s Department of Public Safety at 215-204-7900.

38d33a8abd47352e7531.title: Planning Studio - Studio Leader
38d33a8abd47352e7531.description:
The Planning Studio Leader demonstrates the leadership, technical expertise, and business acumen necessary to lead and grow NELSON’s Planning Studio while delivering exceptional client service and successful project outcomes. This individual is responsible for the overall performance of the studio, including teammate development, resource management, project delivery, quality, and financial performance.

The Planning Studio Leader provides strategic direction and oversight for a range of urban planning and development initiatives, including land use planning, master planning, zoning and entitlements, community development, and sustainable design. Working collaboratively with Practice Leadership, project leads, and clients, this individual ensures projects are executed successfully while identifying opportunities to strengthen existing client relationships, pursue new business, and expand the studio’s capabilities and market presence.

A key responsibility of this role is building a collaborative and engaging studio environment where teammates are supported, developed, and empowered to excel. The Planning Studio Leader mentors and grows NELSON talent, establishes a vision for the studio, and ensures the team has the resources, guidance, and technical expertise necessary to deliver high-quality work and achieve business objectives.

  

**Attributes to support the NELSON culture:**

* **Go All In. Own the Outcome.**We go all in—with urgency, follow-through, and pride in the result.
* **Be Direct. Be Respectful. Be Authentic.**We keep it real—with clarity, candor, and care.
* **Grow with Purpose.**We embrace growth—through learning, coaching, and continuous improvement.
* **Think Bold. Execute Smart.**We think boldly—and pair ambition with discipline.
* **Make Space for Everyone.**We value you—and build a culture where people can thrive and do their best work.

  

**Qualifications**:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty and responsibility satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Critical features of this job are described under the headings below. They may be subject to change at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons.

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned:**

##### ***Leadership & Team Development:***

* Provide strategic direction and establish a vision for the Planning Studio, aligning team goals and priorities with broader firm and practice objectives.
* Lead, mentor, and develop project leads and teammates, fostering an environment of accountability, collaboration, professional growth, and continuous improvement.
* Manage and support project leads and assigned teams, ensuring teammates are engaged, appropriately supported, and positioned for success.
* Establish performance goals, conduct performance evaluations, provide regular feedback, and identify opportunities for professional development and advancement.
* Develop project leads in core responsibilities, including communication, presentation skills, time management, workload prioritization, and team leadership.
* Evaluate team capabilities and identify opportunities to strengthen technical expertise and expand studio capabilities.
* Promote a diverse and inclusive workplace that encourages collaboration, innovation, and engagement.
* Develop professional and industry relationships that support talent acquisition and the continued growth of the studio.
* Address team challenges, resolve conflicts, and maintain a positive and productive studio environment.
* Serve as a resource and mentor to teammates across the studio and broader firm.

*Resource Management & Operations:*

* Oversee resource planning and allocation to ensure appropriate staffing, balanced workloads, and effective utilization across projects and teams.
* Meet regularly with project leads to review project progress, staffing needs, schedules, and resource requirements.
* Provide direction and support to project leads in resolving project-related issues and balancing workloads across teams.
* Evaluate team skills and capabilities and make staffing recommendations to Practice Leadership.
* Participate in recruiting, interviewing, hiring, and onboarding efforts to support the continued growth of the studio.
* Coordinate with Practice Leadership and other Studio Leaders on staffing decisions, resource sharing, and business priorities.
* Monitor studio utilization and staffing levels to support established performance targets.
* Ensure timely completion of internal reporting, project planning, pipeline projections, timesheet approvals, and other operational requirements.

*Technical Leadership & Planning Expertise:*

* Provide technical guidance and oversight across urban planning projects, ensuring quality, consistency, and adherence to applicable standards and regulations.
* Oversee the development of comprehensive land use plans, master plans, conceptual designs, and planning studies that address community needs, environmental considerations, and long-term development objectives.
* Guide teams in zoning analysis, entitlement processes, land use regulations, building codes, accessibility requirements, and applicable federal and local government programs.
* Ensure teams understand and incorporate relevant regulatory, environmental, social, economic, and infrastructure considerations into planning recommendations and deliverables.
* Provide direction on the use of Geographic Information Systems (GIS) for mapping, spatial analysis, and data-driven planning decisions.
* Promote sustainable planning practices, including an understanding of LEED, WELL, energy efficiency, environmental impact, and responsible land development.
* Ensure project teams follow NELSON standards and established quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) procedures.
* Review project work and deliverables, providing technical direction and recommendations to maintain quality and consistency.
* Support the development of best practices, tools, and resources that strengthen the studio's technical capabilities.
* Stay informed of industry trends, emerging planning practices, regulatory changes, and advancements in technology relevant to urban planning and community development.

*Project Delivery:*

* Oversee project execution across the studio, ensuring projects are delivered on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with established scope and quality expectations.
* Provide guidance to project leads in developing project work plans, schedules, budgets, and resource requirements.
* Oversee the preparation and execution of master plans, conceptual and schematic designs, zoning analyses, planning studies, reports, and related project deliverables.
* Support the preparation of proposals, contracts, scopes of work, and fee estimates.
* Lead or participate in complex projects and provide additional project leadership when necessary to support studio performance and client needs.
* Guide teams through zoning reviews, entitlement processes, permitting requirements, and coordination with applicable authorities having jurisdiction.
* Oversee coordination of internal teams, external consultants, and project stakeholders to ensure comprehensive and consistent project execution.
* Lead or facilitate client workshops and design charrettes, communicating planning concepts and recommendations through presentations, discussions, and visual communication.
* Ensure project deliverables meet NELSON standards and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Monitor project progress, identify potential scope or schedule issues, and work with project leads to implement corrective actions.
* Support project leads in identifying additional services, managing scope changes, and maintaining accurate project documentation.
* Encourage knowledge-sharing and collaboration across project teams to improve project delivery and overall studio performance.

*Financial Management:*

* Maintain accountability for the overall financial performance of the Planning Studio, including revenue, profitability, utilization, and project performance.
* Review financial reports and use performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring improvement.
* Oversee project budgeting, fee development, resource planning, and financial forecasting.
* Ensure project leads and project managers effectively manage project budgets, schedules, and financial performance.
* Monitor project plans, fee expenditures, staffing projections, and profitability to ensure projects remain on track.
* Partner with Practice Leadership to develop annual revenue forecasts and establish strategies to achieve financial objectives.
* Monitor client and account revenue, identify potential risks, and proactively address issues that may impact studio performance.
* Ensure timely project invoicing and support accounts receivable collections, escalating client payment concerns as needed.
* Mentor teammates on financial management fundamentals, including project budgets, timesheets, utilization, and invoicing.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, maximize profitability, and support sustainable studio growth.

*Client Relationships & Business Development:*

  

* Build, strengthen, and maintain relationships with existing clients while identifying opportunities to develop new client relationships and expand the studio's market presence.
* Maintain awareness of client satisfaction and proactively address concerns related to project performance, service delivery, or client relationships.
* Serve as a senior point of contact for key clients and support project leads in managing client expectations and relationships.
* Participate in client meetings, presentations, interviews, and project reviews with Practice Leadership and Account Leaders.
* Support business development initiatives by identifying new opportunities, participating in pursuits, responding to RFPs, developing proposals, and interviewing for new business.
* Identify opportunities to expand NELSON's planning services through relationships with developers, public officials, government entities, community organizations, and industry partners.
* Represent NELSON in professional organizations, industry events, and community initiatives to strengthen the firm's visibility and reputation.
* Develop and maintain relationships with industry professionals and organizations to support business development, recruiting, and the continued growth of the Planning Studio.

*Supervisory Responsibilities:*

* Directly supervises assigned teammates and project leads within the Planning Studio.
* Responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of assigned teams.
* Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with NELSON policies and applicable laws.
* Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training teammates; planning, assigning, and directing work; conducting performance evaluations; providing feedback; and addressing complaints and resolving problems.

  

##### **Required Knowledge and Skills:**

* Extensive knowledge of urban planning, land use, community development, zoning, and entitlement processes.
* Strong understanding of design, urban development trends, construction methodologies, materials, and sustainable planning practices.
* Extensive knowledge of federal, state, and local government programs, regulations, zoning codes, and applicable building and accessibility requirements.
* Demonstrated experience with master planning, land use planning, conceptual design, and development strategies.
* Experience utilizing Geographic Information Systems (GIS) software for mapping, analysis, and planning applications.
* Strong understanding of project management, including budgeting, scheduling, resource planning, and project delivery.
* Proficiency in financial management concepts, including project profitability, revenue forecasting, utilization, and financial reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop teams while managing multiple projects and competing priorities.
* Strong business development, client relationship management, and presentation skills.
* Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including the ability to lead client presentations and design charrettes.
* Ability to develop and maintain relationships with clients, public officials, developers, consultants, and industry partners.
* Proficiency in Deltek Vision/Vantagepoint and Microsoft Office applications.
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD or Revit, Adobe Photoshop, Bluebeam Revu, and other relevant planning and design software.
* Knowledge of LEED, WELL, and other sustainability guidelines.

  

##### **Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Urban Planning, Architecture, Public Policy, or a related field from an accredited university required.
* 12+ years of relevant professional experience in urban planning, regional planning, architecture, or a related field preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams, managing complex projects, and overseeing studio or practice performance.
* Experience with business development, client relationship management, and financial management within a professional services or AEC environment.
* Master's degree in Urban Planning or Regional Planning preferred.
* American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP) certification preferred.
* Architectural license in at least one state preferred.

  

##### **Continuing Education & Professional Development:**

* Maintain applicable professional certifications and fulfill continuing education requirements.
* Stay current on industry trends, regulatory developments, planning methodologies, and emerging technologies.
* Continuously develop leadership, business management, and communication skills.
* Participate in professional organizations and industry events to support continued learning and professional growth.

  

***Benefits of NELSON******: (additional benefit details can be found at:******nelsonworldwide.com/careers (https://nelsonworldwide.com/careers/))***

* **401(K) plan with company match**
* **Full health benefits including medical, dental, and vision**
* **Wellness program with rewards for healthy activities**
* **Pet Insurance**
* **Opportunities for career advancement**
* **Paid time off and holiday pay**
* **Paid parental leave**
* **Flexible working schedules and work from home options based on client’s needs**
* **Professional Development including discretionary support and reimbursement for registrations, certifications, and membership to a professional organization**

  

***NELSON and its related affiliates are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, transgender, national origin, status as a protected veteran, disability or any other classification protected by law.***

fee4f7acaef7d691a006.title: Commercial Insurance Senior Account Manager
fee4f7acaef7d691a006.description:
**Position Summary**  
Rue Insurance’s Senior Account Manager is a Trusted Advisor to clients and a liaison between clients and insurance carriers. Senior Account Managers are primarily responsible to provide exceptional client service and advisory support to key Rue client accounts. They are accountable to build and maintain strong relationships with clients, insurers, and Rue producers; and to work closely with the Department Manager and team to support client retention and new prospect opportunities for the purpose of improving and growing the Unit. Quality of work must exemplify the best-in-class service standards established by Rue Insurance at all times.

* Handle primary responsibility for overall servicing of larger ($200K+ premium) and/or complex Commercial client accounts
* Build and maintain strong internal and external relationships
* Efficiently and effectively lead new client onboarding and account renewals, and advocate for client interests as needed
* Assist Producers with renewal and mid-term account risk analysis and insurance structure and coverage recommendations; and obtain and offer quote proposals as appropriate
* Lead complex account servicing such as advanced coverage inquiries and policy change requests, audit and billing inquiries, insurance proof compliance, and OCIP/CCIP enrollment and compliance
* Conduct thorough review of insurance requirements for client contractual agreements, advise client in accordance with findings, and assist client with its third-party negotiations
* Support the Rue Be Ready model by proactively seeking to discover client operational or exposure-based risk improvement opportunities, making appropriate risk control or insurance coverage recommendations to address identified risks, and following through to resolution
* Resolve coverage questions or deficiencies identified in the course of account servicing, independently or with joint accountability with Producers, as appropriate
* Collaborate with Producers, Rue Risk Services, and Claims on strategic recommendations and implementation for client’s Total Cost of Risk reduction
* Contribute to enhancement of agency processes and procedures, including, but not limited to, taking initiative to drive continuous improvement in client service offerings, Epic Workflows, system documentation, and paper and electronic records management
* Proactively identify and resolve client, insurer, Rue personnel, and third-party communication and service issues in an empathetic and professional manner
* Collaborate with agency management to drive growth, including, but not limited to, leading account rounding efforts and supporting new program development and integration
* Serve as liaison between insurers and clients, both as a technical advisor and on service-related issues
* Lead internal agency and departmental meetings with respect to market relationships and/or client servicing

**Associate Director, Global Quality Business Operations**

The Global Quality (GQ) Business Operations Associate Director is responsible for providing centralized oversight and coordination of strategic initiatives, resource planning, portfolio management, and program performance management across Global Quality. This role enables data-driven decision making by maintaining an integrated view of program priorities, resource capacity, dependencies, and initiative progress. The position serves as a key business partner within Global Quality, driving transparency, accountability, operational effectiveness, and continuous improvement while strengthening collaboration across global programs and strategic initiatives.

  

The Associate Director, GQ Operations will help build and mature program management capabilities, preserve organizational knowledge through process documentation and governance, and support the scalability of Global Quality operations to meet evolving business needs.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Portfolio & Program Management**

* Lead the management of a consolidated portfolio view of Global Quality strategic initiatives, programs, and key projects, enabling informed prioritization, resource allocation, and investment decision-making.

* Track initiative progress, milestones, risks, dependencies, and deliverables across Global Quality Operations global programs.

* Designs and governs program management standards, tools, and reporting mechanisms to strengthen program management discipline, improve execution consistency, and build organizational capabilities across Global Quality.

* Facilitate governance reviews and provide regular updates on program performance across Global Quality Operations

**Continuous Improvement & Performance Monitoring**

* Enable performance monitoring through the development and maintenance of metrics, dashboards, and reporting processes that provide visibility into operational effectiveness.

* Drive action tracking, follow-through, and accountability to support the timely execution of commitments, deliverables, and strategic priorities.

* Utilize performance data, trends, and insights to identify opportunities for operational effectiveness, process optimization, and continuous improvement.

* Support governance activities, performance reviews, and operational assessments to drive proactive decision-making and sustained improvement across Global Quality.

**Process Governance & Knowledge Management**

* Maintain end-to-end process maps, operational documentation, and process ownership frameworks.

* Ensure process documentation remains current, accurate, and aligned with organizational objectives.

* Promote program best practices across Global Quality.
* Preserve organizational knowledge and reduce dependency on individual expertise through robust documentation and governance practices.

**Stakeholder Partnership & Collaboration**

* Strengthen engagement and collaboration between Global Quality and functional business partners through the Centers of Excellence.

* Foster strong cross-functional partnerships to support alignment on strategic priorities, initiatives, and organizational objectives.

* Facilitate effective communication and coordination across regions, programs, and stakeholder groups to promote shared understanding and execution.

* Enhance transparency of priorities, dependencies, risks, and outcomes to support informed decision-making and organizational alignment.

* Act as a strategic partner to Global Quality leadership, Global Quality Operations, and business stakeholders to drive operational effectiveness and successful delivery of strategic initiatives. .
  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Quality, Life Sciences, or a related field.

Excellent organizational, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

* Resource planning and prioritization

* Data analysis and performance management

* Process mapping and governance

* Continuous improvement mindset

* Stakeholder engagement and influence

* Cross-functional collaboration

* Organizational change and transformation support
  

**Competencies**  
**Accountability for Results -** Stay focused on key strategic objectives, be accountable for high standards of performance, and take an active role in leading change.

e32de17caf591f06f198.title: Head of Talent Acquisition
e32de17caf591f06f198.description:
### **About Throne**

Throne is a fast growing Series C startup transforming local communities by delivering clean, safe, accessible restrooms to cities, transit agencies, and public spaces. With flagship customers in Los Angeles, the San Francisco Bay Area, Ann Arbor, and Washington DC, and recent launches in New York City, Atlanta, and Seattle, we're rapidly scaling into new markets in 2027 and beyond.

We recognize an unspoken problem: that better bathroom accommodations are sorely needed in most cities. Public and retail bathrooms are neither positioned to meet demand, nor incentivized to provide the quality experience people deserve.

Our mission is to provide peace of mind to the millions of people who set out on an adventure on any given day. That adventure may be big or small. It may involve taking your toddler to the park, driving a stranger to the airport, running a half marathon, or exploring a new city for the first time.

**About the Job**

We are looking for a full-time Head of Talent Acquisition to join our team, reporting to the Head of People Operations. As Throne's first dedicated Talent Acquisition hire, you will be responsible for building and running our hiring engine for professional and managerial roles across engineering, product, sales, and corporate functions. You will partner closely with Finance, People Operations, our Founders and executive team, and hiring managers to connect hiring decisions to their tangible impact. While this role is being hired as an individual contributor given the nimble nature of our team, as Throne's business needs grow, you may have the opportunity to build out a team to further support specialized recruiting efforts, high-volume field staffing, and other disciplines.

This role can be performed remotely within the United States, with flexibility expected to work across timezones to support hiring teams. Minimal domestic travel (less than 10%) will be required.

The base salary range for this position is $150,000 - $190,000. This role is also eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including equity.

### **Primary Responsibilities:**

* **Full-cycle recruiting for professional roles**: Own the full-cycle recruiting for central roles across engineering, product, sales, and corporate functions, from intake and sourcing through offer and close. As the first internal talent acquisition hire, you will design the entire hiring process: sourcing strategy, structured interviews and scorecards, interviewer training for hiring managers, offer construction and approvals within Throne's pay bands, and a candidate experience we are proud of. You will select and implement a scalable Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and use AI tooling (with unlimited Claude access) to automate scheduling, sourcing, and reporting from day one. If you are looking to maintain a well-established playbook, it does not exist, and this is not the right position for you.
* **Partner with the business**: Deeply understand the business by working with Finance, People Operations, Founders, and managers across every discipline. You will co-own the annual hiring plan with Finance and People Operations, including req prioritization and an honest view of whether the plan can be delivered with current resourcing. You will own recruiting metrics (time to fill, pipeline health, offer acceptance, candidate experience) and report monthly to the Founders and Finance. You will be expected to be commercially fluent in Throne's business, and will be fully supported in that endeavor.
* **Optimize field hiring**: While not serving as a field recruiter, you will support our Operations and Production Managers to reduce time to fill and cost to hire in high-volume recruiting efforts. This will look like enabling them with easy to implement templates and hiring guides, tooling, and coaching to improve hiring practices.
* **Leadership hiring**: Run senior and executive searches (VP+ and GM level) as Throne expands into new markets, including selecting and managing retained search firms and agencies where needed. Own the recruiting budget and vendor relationships.

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, especially for professional and managerial roles
* Ability to partner closely with finance and business leaders to connect hiring plans to business outcomes
* Exceptional communication and influencing skills, with the ability to coach and align hiring managers at every level in the organization
* Proven track record of recruiting for a variety of positions, including technical roles, sales, and corporate
* Experience selecting and implementing an ATS, with no particular preference given to one system
* Strong knowledge of compliant hiring practices across multiple states, including but not limited to CA, WA, and NY
* Comfortable working both strategically and hands-on in a fast-paced, evolving environment
Can-do attitude and passion for Throne's mission - You* toilets!

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building or scaling a talent acquisition function, ideally as an early or first TA leader at a high-growth company
* Experience recruiting for government contractors or public-sector-facing businesses
* Experience working with visa sponsorship, such as coordinating with immigration counsel on H-1B, O-1, L-1B, and PERM cases
* Experience recruiting for hardware, IoT, or operations-heavy businesses

### **Benefits:**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance, with medical options that are 100% employer-paid
* Equity for all US-based positions, so you share in Throne's growth
* Daily access to earned wages
* 401(k) plan
* Paid time off that grows with tenure, in addition to paid sick time and paid parental leave
* Life insurance, AD&D coverage, and short and long-term disability insurance
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

*Benefits offered to full-time and part-time employees may vary by State.*

*Throne is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer, and we are committed to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce. We believe that every person has a right to equal employment opportunities without discrimination, and that diversity contributes to the overall health of the organization. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, religion, sex, sexual stereotyping, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, pregnancy (which includes pregnancy, childbirth, and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth, or breastfeeding), or any other protected characteristic. Employment may be contingent upon Throne's receipt of an acceptable and job-related drug test, motor vehicle report, and/or background check, as applicable and permissible by law.*

*Throne provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs, as applicable by law. If you require an accommodation, please contact us at careers[at]thronelabs.co*

e4c0ab18e804270cb0bb.title: Customer Success Director
e4c0ab18e804270cb0bb.description:
Torsh Inc. is an education technology company that produces a suite of coaching and professional development support products, including Torsh TALENT, a cloud-based coaching and professional learning platform through which all of the disparate elements of coaching can be organized, tracked, implemented, and managed and SESEBA powered by Torsh, a research based and evidence-backed coaching model that supports educators who teach Dual Language Learners in grades pre-K through 3. Our core mission is to improve student outcomes by increasing educator effectiveness, and we do this by helping schools and organizations increase educator instructional capacity, improve the delivery of educator professional development, and generate insights into educator effectiveness.

As Director of Customer Success, you'll lead and develop a team that helps customers realize the full value of TORSH's solutions. You'll play a critical role in driving customer retention, renewals, account growth, and overall customer satisfaction.

This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for someone who enjoys both the people and operational sides of Customer Success. You'll coach and support your team, strengthen customer engagement strategies, improve processes, and use data to make informed decisions.

Working closely with Business Development, Product, Engineering, and Marketing, you'll help shape how we deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience as TORSH continues to grow.

**What You'll Do**

**Lead, Coach, and Develop Your Team**

* Lead and mentor Customer Success Managers and Customer Enablement Managers, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous development.
* Establish clear goals, performance expectations, and consistent coaching practices that help team members succeed.
* Support team development, hiring, onboarding, and workforce planning.
* Identify opportunities to improve team effectiveness, workload distribution, and customer coverage.

**Drive Customer Retention and Growth**

* Own the overall strategy and performance of customer renewals, retention, and expansion opportunities.
* Develop accurate renewal and growth forecasts, identify risks early, and implement proactive customer retention strategies.
* Partner with Customer Success Managers to strengthen account planning, customer engagement, and renewal readiness.
* Monitor account health and portfolio performance, using data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring attention.

**Build Scalable Customer Success Practices**

* Develop and improve Customer Success processes, playbooks, and operating standards.
* Strengthen customer onboarding, account transitions, executive business reviews, and escalation management.
* Design customer engagement approaches that balance personalized support with scalable service delivery.
* Maintain accurate customer information, renewal forecasts, and account activity within our CRM.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency, and the overall customer experience.

**Build Strong Customer and Cross-Functional Partnerships**

* Serve as an executive-level partner for strategic, high-value, and at-risk customers.
* Build trusted relationships with customer leaders, helping them connect TORSH's solutions to their organizational goals.
* Collaborate with Business Development, Product, Engineering, and Marketing to address customer challenges and improve customer outcomes.
* Represent customer needs internally and help prioritize improvements that support retention and long-term growth.
* Provide leadership with meaningful insights into customer performance, revenue opportunities, and business risks.

**What We're Looking For**

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years of progressive experience in Customer Success, account management, or implementation within a SaaS environment.
* 3+ years of experience managing, coaching, and developing customer-facing teams.
* Demonstrated success improving customer retention, renewals, account growth, and overall portfolio performance.
* Strong understanding of Customer Success operations, including account health monitoring, renewal forecasting, customer lifecycle management, and escalation processes.
* Experience developing scalable Customer Success strategies and service models across different customer segments.
* Proven ability to build relationships with senior and executive-level customer stakeholders.
* Strong analytical skills, including experience using CRM data, reporting, and customer performance metrics to guide decisions.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and leadership skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Product, Engineering, and other business functions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in EdTech, K–12 education, early childhood education, or education-focused SaaS.
* Experience with HubSpot or similar CRM platforms.
* Familiarity with Gong or other conversation intelligence tools.
* Experience leading customer success operations in a growing SaaS organization.
* Experience developing tiered customer engagement models, including high-touch, mid-touch, and technology-enabled support.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Base Salary:** $110,000 annually
* **On-Target Earnings (OTE):** $130,000, including performance-based incentives
* Competitive employee benefits package
* Paid time off and company holidays
* Fully remote work environment
* Professional development opportunities

**Join Our Team**

If you're a Customer Success leader who enjoys developing people, solving complex challenges, and building strong customer partnerships, we'd like to hear from you.

Join TORSH and help us strengthen the customer experience while supporting educators and organizations in achieving meaningful outcomes.

We are passionate about cultivating career advancement for our people and support them through mentorship, leadership, and career-development programs. Our exceptional team is the cornerstone of MarketStar's accomplishments. We are proud of our award-winning workplace culture and to be named a top employer in our industry. These achievements are a testament to our six core values, embraced by our 3,000+ employees worldwide. From our headquarters in Utah, USA, to our global offices in India, Ireland, Bulgaria, Mexico, the Philippines, and Australia, we all work together to drive innovation and success.

  

We are excited to have you apply to join our leadership team and can’t wait to discuss how we can help you find growth, as well as how you can drive growth for your team and make an impact on our business.

93324bd89f43db26b6f9.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
93324bd89f43db26b6f9.description:
Marek Health is built around a simple vision: help people reach a level of health and performance they did not think was possible. Our expert clinical team creates a clear path to higher energy, stronger bodies, sharper minds, and a longer, fuller life. We do this through personalized, clinician-guided care grounded in advanced diagnostics and evidence-based treatments, including hormone optimization, peptides, nutrition, and lifestyle support. Our goal is to become the partner that guides people to the healthiest, most capable version of themselves.

We are hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own email and SMS end-to-end across all three Marek brands: Marek Health, Marek Diagnostics, and Marek Supplements. This covers every email and text we send: lifecycle and automated flows, lead nurture, campaigns and promotions, client and care communications, and newsletters. Email and SMS are the channels we control outright, and they are one of our biggest levers for intakes, revenue, and retention. This role sets the strategy and does the build, and is directly accountable for what the program drives. It reports to the Growth and Operations Manager and works closely with the tech, sales, product, and clinical teams.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Lifecycle Strategy and the Client Journey**

* Own, manage, and scale the email and SMS program across all three brands: strategy, calendar, and cadence.
* Map the entire client lifecycle and hold the source of truth for every automated touchpoint: what triggers it, who receives it, what it says, and how it looks.
* Own stage-to-stage conversion after intake: intake to labs, labs to provider exam, exam to treatment plan, and first refill. Set baselines for each stage and show the lift email and SMS drive.
* Work in parallel with the tech and sales teams to rebuild and maintain the journey, define what lifecycle needs, and see it through.
* Focus heavily on client retention and reactivation.
* Drive adoption of the new Account Management portal. Use email and SMS to notify clients of status changes and incentivize the actions we want them to take, and partner with product to see which features clients use and scale adoption.

**All Email and SMS, Across All Brands**

* Run every type of send: lifecycle and automated flows, campaigns and promotions, client and care communications, and newsletters.
* Build lead nurture and mid-funnel journeys that move prospects from first touch through the questionnaire, discovery call, and intake.
* Build and run onboarding, evergreen sends to inactives, abandonment, win-backs, and retention journeys.
* Ship campaign and promotional sends on time, and modify flows for sales and promotions as they come up, without being asked.

**Data, Build, and Deliverability**

* Define and maintain the event and attribute spec that lifecycle depends on, covering the clinical system, payments, scheduling, and both Shopify stores. QA new events with tech before they go live.
* Own segments and the data behind them, and verify in QA before a send goes out.
* Write the copy, build and QA responsive emails that render across clients, and hold the final call on quality. Design supports the build.
* Own inboxing for email: warming, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, list hygiene, suppression, and the Gmail and Yahoo bulk-sender rules. Own SMS compliance and delivery: 10DLC registration, opt-in and opt-out handling, and quiet hours.

**Compliance and Patient Privacy**

* Keep every send compliant with HIPAA, CAN-SPAM, and TCPA, and make sure protected health information is only used where it is allowed and never exposed in marketing.
* Work with the clinical team on care communications and health claims so messaging stays accurate and within regulatory guidelines.

**Testing, Optimization, and Reporting**

* Run a standing testing program and optimize flows continuously. Test hooks, offers, timing, channel, and structure to drive conversion.
* Own the funnel from first touch to refill, package performance with clear takeaways, and report up.
* Use AI to move faster on build, personalization, testing, and reporting.

### **Qualifications**

* 5 to 7 years running lifecycle, email, SMS, or CRM marketing, including owning strategy for a program, not just executing it.
* Experience in a service-based or subscription business where the customer relationship is ongoing, not purely transactional e-commerce. Health, wellness, telehealth, SaaS, or membership all fit.
* You have run an email and SMS platform end to end. Customer.io preferred; Klaviyo, Iterable, Braze, Attentive, Postscript, or similar transfers.
* You build multi-step automated flows with triggers, segmentation, and decision logic across channels, not just one-off sends.
* Strong grasp of deliverability: authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), warming, inbox placement, list hygiene, and SMS registration and consent.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA and how PHI should and should not move through marketing tools, plus CAN-SPAM and TCPA.
* Fluent in HTML and email templating (Liquid or similar), responsive and cross-client.
* You handle segmentation and the data behind it, and can write an event spec a technical team can build from.
* You map systems and document them. You can walk into something undocumented and make it organized and maintainable.
* You run A/B tests properly and read the results.
* Strong copywriter with a sharp analytical mindset. You live in the data and turn it into decisions.
* You run independently: you own your area, drive it without being managed task to task, and carry several workstreams across three brands at once.
* Health, wellness, supplements, or longevity industry experience preferred.

### **Role Expectations**

* Full-time.
* Remote role.
* Ability to work effectively across PST to EST time zones.
* Reports to the Growth and Operations Manager, working in close partnership with the tech, sales, product, and clinical teams.

### **Compensation**

* Base compensation: $85,000 to $95,000 annually, depending on experience.
* Paid time off (PTO).
* 401(k): employer-contributed.
* Health insurance: employer-subsidized medical, dental, and vision.

*Marek Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.*

*This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.*

bec8841740c1104de7f3.title: Senior Project Manager
bec8841740c1104de7f3.description:
The Senior Project Manager will take primary responsibility within the project team for planning, coordinating, and delivering project activities through the entire project life cycle, from pre-development through construction and handoff to the client, on major, complex, and business-critical projects. Under the general direction of the Project Director, the SPM delivers CMD’s Owner’s Advisor Services as an extension of the client’s team, independently leading day-to-day execution to meet schedule, budget, quality, and client objectives, in conformance with CMD’s project management methodologies and standards.

The SPM brings CMD’s core values to every relationship (internally and externally) and engagement. Stewardship: take ownership of what is ours, following through on our commitments, and caring for the people, resources and responsibilities entrusted to us. Collaboration: building an aligned and effective team through working together with openness, trust, and shared purpose, valuing the perspectives and contributions of everyone involved. Professionalism: holding ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do, bringing expertise, integrity, and dedication to every engagement from start to finish. The SPM will lead multidisciplinary international project teams, independently direct day-to-day planning, design management, and construction activities, and be instrumental to the successful development, implementation, and delivery of a highly complex, ground-up ultra-luxury resort and branded residential development on a remote island in the Caribbean.

#### **DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

Project Leadership and Client Relations

* Assume primary responsibility for independently directing daytoday project execution, establishing projectspecific objectives, priorities, policies, and procedures, and ensuring accountability across all project disciplines.
* Serve as a senior representative of the client in coordinating with ownership, internationally recognized architects and designers, engineering consultants, contractors, operators, and regulatory agencies. Lead highlevel project meetings, drive critical decisions, and provide executivelevel briefings on project milestones, financial performance, risks, and strategic recommendations.
* Exercise independent judgment in anticipating and resolving complex project challenges, proactively identifying risks, evaluating technical and commercial implications, and implementing effective solutions while escalating major strategic matters to the Project Director.
* Provide leadership and direction to multidisciplinary project teams, holding consultants and contractors accountable for performance, deliverables, and project objectives. Mentor junior project staff in technical coordination, design management, and project management methodologies and standards.

#### **Pre-Development**

* Lead early planning efforts, including site analysis, feasibility studies, land planning, area programming, master planning, infrastructure assessments, and conceptual design, ensuring alignment with the client’s development objectives and ultraluxury hospitality expectations.
* Direct technical due diligence of site conditions, infrastructure, environmental constraints, and development risks to inform project decisions.
* Lead preliminary budgets, cost estimates, financial models, and master schedules; assess design feasibility and construction approaches.
* Recommend project delivery, contracting, procurement, phasing, and bid packaging strategies suited to remote island logistics and available resources.
* Coordinate entitlements, permitting, and regulatory approvals, identifying potential obstacles early.
* Challenge early design solutions to align architectural vision with constructability, infrastructure, cost, and schedule.

#### **Pre-Construction**

* Establish project communication, document control, roles, and accountability across international teams; lead design coordination and project control meetings.
* Direct the multidisciplinary design process from concept through construction documentation, managing internationally recognized architects, engineers, interior designers, and specialty consultants to ensure coordinated, technically sound deliverables that meet project quality, schedule, and budget objectives.
* Critically evaluate architectural and engineering designs for technical feasibility, interdisciplinary coordination, constructability, regulatory compliance, and alignment with the client's vision and luxury hospitality brand standards. Identify deficiencies, challenge proposed solutions, and direct appropriate corrective measures.
* Evaluate detailed budgets, schedules, cash flow, and design cost exposure; identify cost and schedule impacts of design decisions and recommend mitigation.
* Direct comprehensive design reviews, value engineering initiatives, peer reviews, and constructability assessments, balancing architectural integrity, technical performance, construction feasibility, cost, and schedule without compromising the intended design quality.
* Oversee coordination of complex structural systems, building envelopes, waterproofing, MEP systems, highend architectural finishes, FF and E, IT/lowvoltage systems, and other ownerfurnished components, ensuring seamless integration across design, procurement, and construction disciplines.
* Coordinate permitting and regulatory reviews with local authorities and technical consultants; proactively address schedule risks.
* Lead procurement and contracting activities, including RFQ/RFP development, consultant and contractor prequalification, bid evaluation, negotiations, contract awards, and buyout. Develop procurement strategies addressing international sourcing, shipping logistics, limited local resources, and longlead materials and equipment.
* Oversee consultant and contractor agreement administration, financial controls, invoice review, and tracking of budgeted, committed, actual, and projected costs. Evaluate commercial risks, proposed changes, and potential cost exposures to protect the client's financial interests.
* Oversee project QA/QC procedures and risk and issue registers; proactively resolve technical, commercial, and logistical challenges.

#### **Construction Management**

* Direct and oversee general contractors and multidisciplinary construction teams, lead OAC and project control group meetings, and assume primary responsibility for daytoday construction execution, including complex sequencing, site logistics, infrastructure coordination, and adherence to project quality, schedule, and budget objectives.
* Provide seniorlevel technical oversight of construction activities, critically evaluating structural systems, building envelopes, waterproofing, MEP installations, construction methodologies, and highend architectural finishes. Proactively identify deficiencies, resolve complex field conditions, and direct consultants and contractors in implementing technically sound solutions.
* Oversee the review and resolution of submittals, RFIs, shop drawings, substitution requests, change proposals, and change orders. Evaluate technical and commercial implications, challenge unnecessary costs or design complexities, and review and approve monthly payment requests in accordance with contractual requirements and delegated authority.
* Direct construction quality assurance and quality control activities, oversee special inspections, site safety compliance, insurance requirements, construction schedules, and FF and E installation. Monitor contractor performance and enforce accountability for workmanship, coordination, and adherence to the project's luxury design and construction standards.
* Oversee construction reporting and provide executive updates on milestones, financial performance, schedule risks, technical issues, and corrective actions.
* Direct substantial completion and project closeout activities, including inspections, punch lists, occupancy approvals, commissioning, record drawings, warranties, contract closeouts, final payments, digital turnover, and coordination with hospitality operators and client representatives to ensure operational readiness and successful handover.
* Other duties may be assigned.

#### **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* A minimum of a bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related technical field is required.
* A minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible construction or project management experience.

11aa39af99b6e59fa52e.description:
**JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way**.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

**Facility Condition Assessment – Technical Director, Asset Services**
======================================================================

**JLL Real Estate Due Diligence (JREDD) – Asset Service*****s***

* Serves as a senior leader within the Asset Services business of the JLL Real Estate Due Diligence (JREDD) division, providing strategic direction, national operational oversight, and executive-level client engagement for Facility Condition Assessment (FCA) in accordance with ASTM E2018, as well as Regulatory Compliance Audit (RCA) services.
* Reports to and partners directly with the Global Leader of Asset Services to shape and execute the business strategy, drive sustainable revenue growth, and uphold the highest standards of technical and professional excellence across the Asset Services platform.
* Provides enterprise-level leadership across technical operations, talent development, quality and risk management, and service innovation to advance JREDD’s position as the premier provider of real estate due diligence services.
* Directs complex, multi-market client portfolios and serves as a key executive relationship owner, representing Asset Services in strategic business development pursuits, industry forums, and client-facing engagements.
* Champions the development and continuous improvement of service delivery frameworks, technical standards, and operational processes to support scalable, high-quality FCA execution nationally.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------------------

* Leads and oversees national production operations of the Asset Services – Facility Condition practice, including supporting accountability for revenue targets, gross profit margin, and overall financial health of the business line.
* Exercises senior-level review authority over Facility Condition Assessment reports, ensuring alignment with JREDD quality standards, client-specific protocols, ASTM E2018, and applicable regulatory frameworks.
* Establishes and cultivates executive-level client relationships across key accounts, proactively identifying opportunities to expand service scope, resolve escalated issues, and align delivery with clients; evolving portfolio objectives.
* Collaborates with the Global Leader of Asset Services to define and implement the strategic vision for the business, including market expansion, service line innovation, and competitive positioning within the broader platform.
* Provides support for executive oversight of project management staff nationally, ensuring consistent application of policies, technical standards, and operational procedures across all geographies and service engagements.
* Serves as one of the division’s senior subject matter experts in areas including building systems and conditions, MEP, structural, building envelope, seismic risk, and ADA compliance in the context of Facility Condition Assessments.
* Drives enterprise-level business development efforts, including leading pursuit strategies, responding to RFPs, and presenting JREDD Asset Services capabilities to JLL Integrated Facility Management (IFM) accounts, JLL Real Estate Management Services (REMS) verticals, institutional clients, and investment managers.
* Leads the design, development, and governance of standardized service templates, scope frameworks, and field assessment tools to ensure scalable, repeatable delivery of FCA services.
* Actively monitors industry trends, regulatory developments, and emerging best practices to inform service evolution and maintain Asset Service’s technical leadership position.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**
--------------------------------

* Provides senior leadership and formal supervision across multiple functional and operational teams within the Asset Services – Facility Condition practice.
* Partners with the business leader to make final decisions regarding staff recruitment, selection, promotion, advancement, and corrective action for direct reports and their respective teams.
* Establishes and monitors staffing strategies, workforce planning, and resource allocation to align with budgeted revenue goals and service delivery demands nationally.
* Oversees performance management processes, including review cycles, development planning, and compensation recommendations for direct reports and their teams.
* Serves as a senior mentor and coach to the Asset Services team members to build bench strength and cultivate future leaders within the business.
* Models and reinforces leadership behaviors aligned with JLL’s values, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and professional excellence.

**QUALIFICATIONS, EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**
--------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) in architecture, engineering, or a related technical discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum 15 years of progressively responsible commercial building evaluation experience, including extensive application of ASTM E2018 and Facility Condition Assessment methodologies across diverse asset classes.
* Minimum of 12 years of experience in client management, strategic account development, and leadership of multi-disciplinary technical service teams.
* Minimum of five (5) years of senior leadership experience with direct management of multi-level teams and demonstrated accountability for business line financial performance.
* Demonstrated track record of driving revenue growth, managing operational costs, and scaling technical service organizations in a national or multi-market context.
* Expert-level knowledge of FCA scope requirements, and specialty applications including seismic, roofing, building envelope, conveyance, ADA, and MEP evaluations.

**CERTIFICATES AND/OR LICENSES**
--------------------------------

* Active licensure as a Professional Engineer (PE) or Registered Architect (RA) required.

**COMMUNICATION SKILLS**
------------------------

* Exceptional ability to comprehend, analyze, and interpret complex business and technical documents and translate findings into actionable strategic recommendations for executive and client audiences.
* Distinguished written and verbal communication, interpersonal, and consultative skills, with the ability to represent JREDD and Asset Services at the highest levels of client and industry engagement.
* Proven ability to navigate and resolve sensitive, high-stakes issues with clients, regulatory bodies, and internal leadership, demonstrating sound judgment and diplomatic effectiveness.
* Accomplished presenter with experience delivering strategic briefings, technical content, and business case arguments to C-suite and board-level audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to inspire and influence clients, stakeholders, and team members to advance organizational objectives and service excellence.

**FINANCIAL KNOWLEDGE**
-----------------------

* Advanced knowledge of financial terms, principles, and performance metrics. Demonstrated ability to develop business cases, interpret financial statements, and manage complex P&L responsibilities across a multi-team service organization.

**REASONING ABILITY**
---------------------

* Exceptional analytical and strategic problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data, competing priorities, and market intelligence to develop enterprise-level solutions. Exercises independent, expert judgment with broad impact on division performance and client outcomes.

**OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES**
------------------------------

* Advanced proficiency in technology platforms and Microsoft Office Suite; familiarity with project management, data analytics, and reporting tools relevant to technical due diligence services.
* Outstanding time management, organizational, and prioritization skills with demonstrated capacity to lead multiple high-value, concurrent engagements in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong negotiation skills with the ability to effectively engage and align key internal and external stakeholders around shared objectives.

**SCOPE OF RESPONSIBILITY**
---------------------------

* Exercises broad, autonomous decision-making authority grounded in expert understanding of JREDD and Asset Services policies, technical standards, business practices, and market conditions to achieve division objectives and long-range strategic goals.
* Responsible for setting and adjusting priorities, deadlines, and resource allocation across the Asset Services – Facility Condition practice at a national scale.
* Errors in judgment may have significant short- to mid-term financial, reputational, or operational impact on the Asset Services business and the broader JREDD division.
