612b2f76a055fb68ef54.title: Associate Client Success Director
612b2f76a055fb68ef54.description:
***Job Title: Associate Client Success Director***

***Location: Philadelphia, PA***

Health Union powers the first and largest community-based activation and data platform, transforming healthcare by providing unparalleled support, information, and validation for millions navigating complex health conditions and their care teams. With over 125+ condition-specific online communities and 15 years of community leadership, Health Union’s authentic engagements fuel the company’s robust suite of endemic media, influencer marketing, market research, and data solutions, driving proven outcomes for patients, HCPs, and brands.

**Position Overview:** The Associate Client Success Director has a critical impact on the success of our business. The CS team is responsible for client service, campaign success, revenue growth, and driving Health Union’s reputation as an industry leader among our client partners.

**What You Do:**

* **Fostering Client Relationships and Success:** Serve as the main point of contact throughout the campaign life cycle
  + Manage day-to-day communication internally and externally by triaging client inquiries, ensuring timely follow-up and effective communication on campaign results
  + Help develop and/or compile program proposals and materials, RFPs, and participate in new business sales meetings.
  + Communicate regularly with clients to provide campaign updates, solve issues, and set realistic expectations; ensure all of their needs are understood and addressed
  + Create and maintain client campaign documentation and deliverables
  + Foster strong client relationships to maintain current business and influence incremental / renewal dollars
* **Collaborating Internally:** Support the internal delivery team to ensure a broad understanding of the client’s business, goals, and point of view to meet and exceed revenue goals
  + Plan and lead internal team meetings (i.e., kickoffs, weekly statuses, performance reviews, etc.) and ensure clarity and productivity (setting meeting agendas, logging notes, etc.)
  + Recommend product improvements based on performance feedback and internal execution
* **Tracking Campaign Performance:** Analyze client campaigns and 3rd party tracking
  + Review campaign metrics and measurement dashboards on a weekly basis and proactively determine action times and timely updates to the client
  + Partner with internal delivery teams to create and review monthly and quarterly client reports to determine whether KPIs are being met, where there is a need for improvement, and what’s being done to optimize for improvement
* **Impacting Revenue** (after “closed won”)
  + Actively identify opportunities to grow our revenue with current client accounts, and partner with sales on new program proposals and identify expansion and upsell opportunities
  + Develop program proposals and RFPs, and participate in external proposal meetings

**What You Bring:**

* Experience in the healthcare/pharma industry is highly valued

* **Troubleshooter** – solving client problems. HU’s first line of defense to understand and take ownership of the problem, communicate with the customer and coordinate communication, and help facilitate resolution with the internal teams
* **Positive attitude** - always interested in finding solutions to problems while keeping a positive, but realistic, can-do attitude internally and externally
* **Proactive** - acts on the chance to help secure incremental through performance highlights, pricing out incremental inventory, offering expanded channels
* **Performance tracker** – primary owner of overseeing KPIs and flagging any potential issues internally
* **Champion** – represents the customer within and outside their own department. The voice of the customer and the liaison between customers and internal delivery teams
* **Change maker** – striving for continuous improvement. Efficiency experts looking for better ways to serve clients, streamline processes and improve products/services
* **Project manager** – juggling tasks, projects and people. Coordinating with other departments to serve customers without duplicating efforts or letting things fall through the cracks

* **Leader** – maintain the account and take charge of its success
* **Solution-oriented** – anticipating hurdles and client needs before they occur. A proactive solution seeker
* **Sounding board** – Not only good listeners but putting themselves in their customers’ shoes. Not just about solving the problem at hand. It’s also about recognizing and acknowledging the emotions that go along with it
* **Subject Matter Expert** – having measurable and specific knowledge and abilities. Having product and service knowledge, as well as client expertise

Annual base salary for positions at this level and job group is $79,000-$105,000, and your base pay will depend on the qualifications, experience, skills, and competencies required for this job.

At Health Union, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range that provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role.

In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan, a professional development budget, and paid time off available to full-time employees upon hire. You will also be granted time off for designated company-paid holidays, summer Fridays, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

**HEALTH UNION REALLY IS THE BEST PLACE TO WORK**

As a dynamic organization that offers flexible work options, we foster a workplace that encourages an authentic, respectful culture of teaching and learning. We work hard and save space to form close-knit relationships that are meaningful to us individually. Health Union also offers top-tier benefits and other perks to full-time employees, starting day one. We cultivate a dynamic, collaborative work environment that values **inclusion, community, excellence, and transparency**. But don’t just take our word for it: The Philadelphia Inquirer, Philadelphia Business Journal, Inc., and Forbes have all named Health Union a “best place to work”-and we take pride in living up to that hype every day.

**Commitment to Inclusion**

At Health Union, we believe that individually we make a statement, but collectively we make an impact. Diversity and inclusion power that impact. We strive to create a sense of belonging by embracing our differences. We are an organization where everyone is valued, heard, and appreciated. Health Union encourages applicants from historically marginalized populations to consider our team as your next opportunity for change. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and advancement regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or gender expression, Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

To comply with federal law, Health Union participates in E-Verify. Successful candidates must pass the E-Verify process after hire.

The position offers a hybrid work arrangement, requiring a minimum of two in-office days per week. Our office is located in Center City, Philadelphia.

Applicants must be legally eligible to work in the U.S for any employer.

3f92c07ad3e59f00094a.description:
**Job Description**

: The Associate Medical Director, Global Medical Affairs Strategy (( [Nephrology and Immunology OR CNS OR Digital Medicine & Therapeutics] NS) supports Medical Directors and Franchise Leads to drive strategic and tactical excellence for assigned Otsuka assets. The incumbent will play a critical role for the execution and implementation of the Medical Affairs strategy by serving as a key member on relevant cross-functional teams, collaboration with regional affiliates and strong project management. This role will also serve as a subject matter expert in content creation, strategic and tactical discussions, and presentations with internal colleagues, as well as external experts and investigators. Other responsibilities include support of medical affairs research execution including but not limited to Phase IV studies and investigator-initiated trials.

Key Responsibilities:

Specific responsibilities include, but may not be limited to:

* Collaborating with Medical Affairs colleagues to develop and execute asset strategy and tactics with appropriate use of resources.
* Assist with product and therapeutic area expert in both internal and external venues including the Medical Affairs sub-teams, and advisory boards / steering committees.
* Support indication and/or franchise leads in providing medical input into all aspects of product development and promotion across the entire asset lifecycle.
* Provide high quality scientific/clinical input and review of disease strategy plans, publications and externally facing educational materials. Part of this responsibility includes ensuring that medical content aligns with Medical Affairs strategy and communication objectives.
* This role may be involved in review of medical content of promotional materials for accuracy as part of the Promotional Review Committee.
* Track priority Medical Affairs tactics and performance to goals/budget.
* Develop data gap analyses and scientific communication priorities.
* Conduct literature searches and prepare data summaries to support strategic decision-making.
* Coordinate with commercial colleagues to provide training to commercial personnel, as needed.
* Help provide direction for medical information specialists.
* Support execution of Medical Affairs evidence generation activities, where applicable.
* Develop educational objectives and review medical education grant requests, as needed.
* Travel (approximately 20%).

Qualifications:

* MD/DO, PharmD or PhD in life sciences required.
* 4+ years’ experience in pharmaceutical industry Medical Affairs with expertise in kidney disease and/or immunology OR CNS preferred (Experience in Clinical Development and/or Medical Communications Agencies may substitute for exceptional candidates)
* Launch experience preferred.
* Motivated and solution oriented with ability to work collaboratively across the organization.
* Demonstrated ability to successfully lead projects in a matrixed environment.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills including experience presenting to large groups.
* Has full understanding of rules and regulations in pharma, which could have impact for the pharmaceutical industry. Can apply knowledge of guidelines and regulations to Medical Affairs activities.
* Proficiency with computer productivity programs necessary to complete work requirements (e.g., MS Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint).
* Knowledge of Medical Affairs systems including Veeva and KOL mapping solutions an asset

**Competencies**  
**Accountability for Results -** Stay focused on key strategic objectives, be accountable for high standards of performance, and take an active role in leading change.
  
**Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving -** Make decisions considering the long-term impact to customers, patients, employees, and the business.
  
**Patient & Customer Centricity -** Maintain an ongoing focus on the needs of our customers and/or key stakeholders.
  
**Impactful Communication -** Communicate with logic, clarity, and respect. Influence at all levels to achieve the best results for Otsuka.
  
**Respectful Collaboration -** Seek and value others’ perspectives and strive for diverse partnerships to enhance work toward common goals.
  
**Empowered Development -** Play an active role in professional development as a business imperative.

1a7d8122f4b9007d6276.title: Director, Revenue Operations
1a7d8122f4b9007d6276.description:
For over 35 years, Peak Technologies has been at the forefront of providing end-to-end enterprise mobility, managed services, printing and mobile data capture solutions for performance-driven organizations focused on the optimization of supply chain and field-based business processes.
  
  
JOB SUMMARY & SCOPE
  
Lead Peak Technologies’ Sales Operations function, including sales planning, forecasting, compensation program management, performance reporting, Salesforce effectiveness, and leadership of Sales Operations Support (SOS) and commercial pre-sales support. Partner with the Chief Revenue Officer, sales leaders, and Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) to strengthen sales execution, improve productivity, and support revenue and margin goals. Establish consistent processes, reliable reporting, and effective commercial support across assigned teams.
  
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
  

* Manage the weekly sales forecast call process, templates, and cadence in coordination with FP&A and Sales SVPs.
* Lead the annual sales quota and financial planning process with the respective sales leaders and FP&A.
* Lead annual sales compensation plan design and implementation in partnership with Sales, Finance, and HR; monitor related KPIs and plan effectiveness.
* Manage monthly sales KPIs, leaderboards, and productivity reporting, providing actionable insights to sales leadership.
* Participate in the preparation, reporting, and overall facilitation of sales quarterly business reviews (QBRs).
* Implement best practices for Salesforce (SFDC) utilization, including adoption, data quality, reporting, and consistent sales processes.
* Facilitate the development and implementation of annual or quarterly SPIFFs and other revenue acceleration programs.
* Support performance inspection at the sales representative and regional levels by providing RVPs with sales data, activity reporting, and performance insights.
* Lead SOS and commercial pre-sales support personnel, establishing clear responsibilities, performance expectations, and accountability.
* Develop staffing, workload allocation, coverage, and training plans aligned with business needs and sales activity.
* Oversee quote preparation and commercial support workflows to improve accuracy, responsiveness, and turnaround time.
* Ensure quotes and supporting documentation reflect approved pricing, applicable terms, and required internal approvals.
* Coordinate with Procurement and vendor partners on pricing, product availability, lead times, and information needed to support customer opportunities.
* Standardize sales support procedures, documentation, escalation paths, and handoffs across assigned teams and business units.
* Partner with Sales, Finance, Procurement, and service delivery teams to resolve commercial issues and support accurate transitions from quotation to order execution.
* Monitor support service levels, quote turnaround, accuracy, backlog, productivity, and rework; use findings to improve workflows and resource allocation.
* Partner with IT and business stakeholders to improve Salesforce, ERP, quoting tools, reporting, and automation supporting sales and commercial operations.
* Manage escalated support issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions.
* Coach and develop employees and people leaders, supporting performance management, succession planning, and organizational effectiveness.
* Provide leadership with reporting on operational performance, resource needs, risks, and improvement priorities.
* Promote a collaborative “One Peak” approach to supporting sellers, customers, and internal business partners.

EDUCATION + EXPERIENCE + KEY TRAITS
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Finance, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Eight or more years of progressive experience in sales operations, commercial operations, or related functions, including sales planning, forecasting, and performance analysis.
* Five or more years of experience leading teams, including responsibility for staffing, performance management, and employee development.
* Experience supporting a technology reseller, distributor, systems integrator, or technology services organization preferred.
* Demonstrated experience managing sales forecasting, quota and financial planning, sales compensation programs, and commercial support workflows.
* Experience driving Salesforce adoption, data quality, reporting, and process improvements; familiarity with ERP, quoting, and business intelligence tools.
* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to translate sales, financial, and activity data into actionable reporting, QBR materials, and performance recommendations.
* Working knowledge of pricing, gross margin, sales incentive structures, and approval controls.
* Proven ability to standardize processes and improve service quality, productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to lead change, manage competing priorities, and establish accountability across distributed teams.
* Collaborative, service-oriented leadership style with sound business judgment and a continuous improvement mindset.

TYPICAL PERFORMANCE TARGETS
  

* SERVICE DELIVERY: Deliver timely, reliable forecasts, sales reporting, planning cycles, compensation program implementation, and commercial support.
* COST TO SERVE: Improve sales and support productivity through effective resource planning, standardized processes, and reductions in manual effort and rework.
* INNOVATION: Improve sales execution through Salesforce adoption, automation, incentive programs, and actionable performance insights.

LANGUAGE SKILLS
  

* Primary language used in daily operations is English. Additional primary company languages include Spanish, French, and Dutch.
* Read and interpret documents, procedure manuals and various correspondence from both internal and external.
* Speak effectively, both individually and before groups of both external customers and/or various levels of employees within the organization.

SUPERVISION
  

* Responsible for the supervision and development of assigned Sales Operations, SOS, and commercial pre-sales support personnel, including managers or team leads where applicable. Responsibilities include staffing, workload allocation, goal setting, coaching, performance evaluation, and employee development.

DECISION MAKING + REASONING
  

* Exercise independent judgment in sales operations planning, reporting, commercial support, resource allocation, and issue resolution. Evaluate sales, operational, and financial information to recommend improvements and support leadership decisions. Coordinate quota, compensation, and incentive recommendations with the appropriate leaders and operate within established policies and delegated authority.

WORKING RELATIONSHIPS
  

* Chief Revenue Officer, Sales SVPs, RVPs, and other sales leaders.
* Sales Operations, SOS, and commercial pre-sales support teams.

def585e730334a7945e1.description:
***ABOUT MEITHEAL PHARMACEUTICALS***

*Founded in 2017 and based in Chicago, Meitheal is focused on the development and commercialization of generic injectable medications and, as of 2022, has expanded its focus to include fertility, biologic, and branded products. Meitheal currently markets over 75 U.S. FDA-approved products across numerous therapeutic areas including anti-infectives, oncolytics, intensive care, and fertility. As of April 2026, Meitheal, directly or through its partners, has 32 products in the research and development phase, 9 products planned for launch in 2026, 4 products in clinical trial phases, and 13 products under review by the FDA. Meitheal’s mission is to provide easy access to fairly priced products through robust manufacturing, consistent supply, and rapid response to our customers’ needs. Ranked regularly as one of Crain’s Fast 50 in Chicago, and in the top 100 of Crain’s Best Places to Work in Chicago from 2022 to 2026, Meitheal emulates the traditional Irish guiding principle we are named for—working together toward a common goal, for the greater good.*

*Learn more about who we are and what we do at* *www.meithealpharma.com**.*

***The pay range for this position is $115,000 to $155,000 / year. Payrate is determined by considering a person's prior experience and competence.***

*The estimated salary range reflects an anticipated range for this position. The actual base salary offered may depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job. The actual base salary offered will be in accordance with state or local minimum wage requirements for the job location.*

***What We Offer***

* *Competitive pay and medical, dental, and vision insurance*
* *Flexible spending accounts*
* *Long- and short-term disability insurance, as well as life insurance*
* *401(k) plan with match*
* *Competitive PTO and company-paid holidays*
* *Paid parental leave (maternity & paternity)*
* *Employee assistance program*

**Summary**

The Associate Director Marketing - Biosimilars & Women’s Health will contribute to establishing the marketing function at an emerging biopharmaceutical company aiming to bring biosimilars to market. This role will support the development and execution of marketing strategies and commercial initiatives for the company’s growing biosimilar and women’s health portfolio including brand strategy, content creation, product naming and branding support, market research support, launch planning support, congress preparation, and agency management.

The ideal candidate will apply knowledge of the biosimilar industry and promotional standards to contribute to the creation of compliant, compelling content and promotional materials across the biosimilar lifecycle. This will include a combination of agency collaboration and management as well as in-house material creation. Additionally, the role will actively participate in the promotional review process, own responses to questions and comments related to assigned materials and help move content efficiently through approval.

This is not a maintenance role, but a build. This individual will provide input to help shape and scale the biosimilar marketing function including developing processes and ways of working e.g., workflows, material storage, and documentation.

**Essential Responsibilities**

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following:

* Contribute to the development of value proposition strategies that effectively communicate the benefits, outcomes, and cost-effectiveness of products to payers and other organized customers.
* Collaborate closely with the biosimilar/fertility team to align go-to-market strategies with overall Meitheal strategy, ensuring appropriate consistency.
* Work in concert with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment of pricing and contracting strategies with overall commercial objectives and biosimilar/fertility strategy.
* Monitor competitive pricing and contracting activities, and proactively identify opportunities and threats to inform strategic decisions including pricing and contracting.
* Oversee the implementation of contract strategies and contracting platforms, including bid processes, negotiations, and pricing analytics.
* Coordinate operational activities such as rebates, chargebacks, and government reporting, ensuring compliance with pharmaceutical regulations.
* Work with Biosimilar Operations team to support development of reimbursement programs, physician and patient resources to address barriers to access of Meitheal products including, but not limited to coding and billing guides, patient copay programs etc.
* Coordinate with external experts and internal teams as needed to facilitate informed decision making with respect to go-to-market strategies required for successful launch of Meitheal Biosimilar platform.
* Execute contract strategies tailored to the unique landscape of biosimilars, ensuring alignment with business goals and regulatory requirements.
* Manage operational budgeting and forecasting processes, ensuring financial justification for contract strategies and offerings based on ROI and sound business judgment.
* Collaborate with Biosimilar operations to provide comprehensive business analytics support, gathering and analyzing market intelligence and competitive data to inform strategic decision-making.
* Foster collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders, including Legal, Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Finance, Quality, and Human Resources, to achieve corporate objectives effectively.
* Support growth and cross collaboration between Meitheal's Women's Health Division.

**Competencies**

* Business Acumen
* Judgement
* Change Management
* Project Management
* Ethics
* Interpersonal

**Qualifications**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* The successful candidate will be able to work across a broad range of therapeutic areas and understand how to communicate value in the biosimilar industry, where clinical novelty is not the main differentiator. This is a role is a great fit for someone with a strong execution focus and creative/efficiency mindset that is comfortable in a build environment without rigid, established processes.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing marketing strategy, brand plans, promotional content, or commercial materials in a regulated healthcare environment.
* Experience participating in a promotional, medical-legal-regulatory, or comparable review and approval process.
* Working knowledge of applicable pharmaceutical advertising and promotional requirements, industry standards, and internal compliance practices.
* Experience with product launch planning, positioning, messaging, market research, congress planning, and commercial readiness activities.
* Experience managing marketing agencies, creative agencies, research vendors, or other external partners.
* Ability to work effectively with Medical, Legal, Regulatory, Clinical, Market Access, Sales, and other cross-functional teams.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and deliverables with strong organization and follow-through.
* Willingness and ability to travel for company meetings, agency meetings, congresses, and other business needs.

*Strongly Preferred:*

* Biosimilar industry experience.
* Experience with customer relationship management systems, marketing automation platforms, or commercial analytics tools.
* Ability to contribute expertise to additional marketing tasks as requested e.g., Hub services, Market Access, Corporate initiatives.

**Education and/or Experience Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, life sciences, pharmacy, communications, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
* 6+ years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or life sciences; experience with biosimilars strongly preferred.

**Computer Skills**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Outlook.
* Familiarity with digital marketing platforms, content management systems, collaboration tools, and virtual meeting platforms.
* Ability to create clear, polished presentations and marketing materials using standard office and presentation software.
* Ability to learn and effectively use company-specific systems for content review, approval, document control, project tracking, and portfolio management.

**Work Environment**

* The ability to travel up to 25%, including overnights, as dictated by business need and attend all company sponsored events/meetings/conferences.
* Field-base Role/Remote.
* While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is frequently required to stand; walk; sit and talk or hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds.

e39a832cbb37efb682b8.title: Regional Insights and Engagement Director, PDAC, Southeast
e39a832cbb37efb682b8.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

**The Opportunity:**

The Regional Insights and Engagement Director, Southeast is a field-based position focused on working closely with PDAC Cancer Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) at select institutions and accounts within the defined geography. This person is a RevMed clinical and product expert for Key Opinion Leaders and ensures that cross-functional resources are made available as appropriate. In this role, you will be a member of the commercial development team, and you will work closely with marketing, medical affairs, field sales, insights and analytics and other cross functional colleagues. You will help inform brand strategy, develop and execute KOL tactics and you will be evaluated in conjunction with individual performance and brand KPIs.

This role will cover major academic institutions, accounts, and the Key Opinion Leaders located in the Northeast.

Essential Duties:

* Designs, executes, and implements significant national strategic marketing deliverables.
* Applies leading-edge clinical and marketplace knowledge and professional concepts to influence the scientific direction of practicing oncologists to support the company and to achieve objectives in creative and effective ways.
* Expert knowledge of clinical practice and rationale for decision-making in PDAC.
* Reputation as a leader in their field across the organization and externally.
* A strategic leader and role model within the commercial team.
* Acutely aware of the impact of decisions across the business and acts with enterprise point of view.
* Collaborates with senior internal and external representatives to achieve objectives.
* Acts independently to determine methods and procedures on new assignments.
* Supports the US launch of RevMed molecules in the lung cancer marketplace and guides marketers supporting field team regarding customer needs.
* Acts as an ambassador of the company.
* Cultivates exceptional partnerships with external KOLs and partners, understands sentiments and influences commercial strategy with internal partners and stakeholders.
* Leads the development of Key Account engagement plans and congress plans for each assigned KOL for the commercial team.
* Plays a key role in enabling and influencing the understanding and opinion of diseases, mechanisms of diseases, and the potential role of products in the management of these diseases using on-label and approved marketing material.
* Executes integrated commercial and marketing strategic plans at national/regional scientific meetings with collaborative and aligned purpose.
* Partner with Sales, Medical Affairs, Market Access, and Commercial Operations & Business Analytics teams to ensure alignment of RevMed’s US commercialization strategy; Uncovers, prioritizes, and communicates market insights, challenges/barriers, and solutions to the organization.
* Develops promotional peer-to-peer content and programming including product theaters and other conference promotional education in alignment with annual congress plan.
* Develops and executes integrated commercial advisory boards to gain insights that will inform brand strategies.
* Contributes actively on all key marketing deliverables including QBR, brand/tactical planning, and Launch Readiness Reviews.
* Assists in the development of promotional speaker bureaus which may involve speaker identification and recruitment, attending and supporting speaker training meetings. Additional follow-on speaker training activities may be required to ensure accurate and effective presentations.
* Complies with all laws, regulations and policies that govern the conduct of RevMed activities.

**Required Skills, Experience and Education:**

* MA/MS degree in related discipline desired; or BA/BS degree in a related discipline with at least 10 years of related experience.
* Field-Based Regional Marketing/ TLL experience.
* Other related experience (e.g., market research, healthcare agency, consulting, etc.).
* Knowledge of KOLs and compliant KOL development practices.
* Ability to present ideas effectively to individuals or groups, targeting presentation to the needs of the audience.
* Oncology experience.
* Launch experience.
* Valid driver's license.
* Must reside within the geographic area of the assigned territory.
* Ability to travel to meetings/training/programs (~65% travel required).

**Preferred Skills:**

* Advanced degree preferred (MBA, PharmD, PhD).
* Equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Expert knowledge of relevant products, their associated therapeutic areas, competitors, and other related marketplace factors (lung cancer preferred).
* Strong organization, planning, project management, and analytical skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Ability to work independently to execute strategic and tactical plans under tight timelines.
* Ability to assemble and lead cross-functional teams toward a shared vision of success.
* Ability to lead, mentor and on-board newer members of the team.
* Highly proficient in Microsoft suite including PowerPoint, Excel, Word.

eb7bc734db26da88c417.title: Director I, AP English Language and Composition, Curriculum and Assessment
eb7bc734db26da88c417.description:
**Director I, AP English Language and Composition**

**College Board – Advanced Placement & Instruction (AP&I)**

**Location:** This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

**Role Type**: This is a full-time position

**About the Team**

The AP Curriculum and Assessment Team at College Board (125+ staff) collaborates with colleagues across all aspects of the AP Program to develop, manage, and deliver AP’s 43 courses in a wide variety of subject areas. AP® is a rigorous academic program built on the commitment, passion, and hard work of students and educators from secondary schools and higher education. AP provides willing and academically prepared high school students with the opportunity to study and learn at the college level. AP’s course teams comprised of educators and disciplinary experts ensure that course curricula are aligned to higher education expectations and reflect the state of the art in the discipline, contribute to instructional resources and tools for teachers, and develop assessments that allow students in these courses to demonstrate their mastery of course content and skills. AP leads in strategic use of AI to expand student access, strengthen instructional design and professional support, and enhance assessment creation and exam analysis.

The English, World Languages, and Arts department, which includes English Literature, English Language, Spanish Language, Italian Language, French Language, German Language, Chinese Language, Japanese Language, Latin, Music Theory, Spanish Literature, and Art and Design is currently comprised of approximately 35 people supporting 14 courses in the AP portfolio. The Science department, which includes biology, chemistry, physics, psychology, environmental science, and Research, is currently comprised of approximately 25 people supporting 10 courses in the AP portfolio. The History and Social Science department, which includes history, art history, human geography, government and politics, economics, business, African American studies, and Seminar, is currently comprised of approximately 35 people supporting 12 courses in the AP portfolio. The Math, Computer Science, and Cybersecurity department, which includes precalculus, calculus, statistics, computer science, cybersecurity, and networking is currently comprised of approximately 22 people supporting 6 courses in the AP portfolio.

**About the Opportunity**

As the Director I, AP English Language and Composition, you will be responsible for preserving and improving the quality and validity of the AP Program’s core deliverables within the subject domain: the exam, the course curriculum, and the professional development content. You are also responsible for item development and management from authoring to administration; training and collaborating with subject-matter experts (SMEs), typically college professors and secondary school teachers. You will ethically and effectively integrate AI technologies in assessment creation and review. This includes judiciously using AI assisted tools to support fairness, validity, and innovation in AP assessments. You will train SMEs on assessment development protocols, translate between academics and technical experts (psychometricians), and collaborate to develop formative assessment materials and resources to support AP English Language and Composition teachers worldwide.

  

You will serve as a point of contact in AP for committees and communities of subject-matter experts and will be responsible for the curriculum and assessment for AP English Language and Composition, and, in partnership with other AP teams, further the strategic growth of AP English Language and Composition across the globe. Additionally, you may have the opportunity to present, speak, and moderate dialogue with academic and membership audiences to ensure that ongoing change and improvement within AP courses and exams is understood, accepted, and supported in secondary and post-secondary educational communities.

*In this role, you will:*

*Assessment Development and Scoring (45-75%)*

* Serve as an assessment leader for AP English Language and Composition, with primary responsibility for assessment development for AP English Language and Composition. Your work in developing and revising test content is of the quality that requires only minimal adjustments based on feedback from your manager and other program leaders.
* Independently lead processes for authoring and revising assessment content, including training educator constituents and leveraging generative AI to author and/or review assessment content, improving and/or making more efficient assessment processes and outputs.
* Independently lead the development and management of assessment content (formative and summative) and scoring materials for AP English Language and Composition through iterative review stages with multiple internal and external stakeholders, including the AP English Language and Composition Team, Assessment Production team, Test Development Committee, and the Chief Reader, as appropriate.
* Independently lead the development of assessment forms for AP English Language and Composition, ensuring the AP Exam development aligns with approved curricula and test specifications.
* Lead multiple face-to-face, weekend meetings, and virtual meetings (during work week, evenings, or weekends) annually with the AP English Language and Composition Test Development Committee. You strategize and develop an agenda and approach to ensure the committee’s meeting time is of the highest productivity; you successfully adapt and pivot during the meeting as needed; and you successfully resolve all post-meeting item content edits.
* Train and directly supervise Test Development Committee members in AP English Language and Composition as content development contributors and reviewers. Recruit educators for the AP English Language and Composition Development Committee and other opportunities to support AP Program.
Lead the successful scoring of student responses for AP English Language and Composition Exams at the annual scoring event in person and online—the “AP Reading”—and produce AP Reading publications materials for teacher and student use. You plan all year, with increasing intensity in the months leading up to the Reading, ensuring all workflow steps for this incredibly complex event, as well as all post-Reading activities, are accounted for and successfully executed.  

  

*Assessment Quality and Process (10-15%)*

* Contribute to current research and best practices in assessment, and engage regularly with AP Curriculum & Assessment colleagues to align on standards and shared principles guiding AP’s assessment directions
* Support assessment workstreams within the AP English, Language, and World Languages department.
* Contribute to processes for efficient, high-quality assessment development.
* Contribute to initiatives to refine and improve question task models as well as exam design in collaboration with AP Curriculum & Assessment leaders and aligned to other College Board initiatives to achieve psychometric and disciplinary best practices on AP English Language and Composition exams.
* Monitor exam validity, security, reliability, fairness, and quality, as well as reader reliability in accordance with established Program thresholds for AP English Language and Composition exam, identifying areas for improvement and executing on targeted improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with psychometrics and AP Curriculum & Assessment staff to establish fair, reliable, and valid cut scores for AP English Language and Composition exam.

*Course Development, Program Support, and Stakeholder Engagement (5-25%)*

  

* Refine and improve AP English Language and Composition Course Framework to ensure clear and explicit learning outcomes that align with strategic priorities, including ensuring college/disciplinary standards as well as expanding the scope of reaching a broader audience of AP students.
* Collaborate with AP teams to support the development of new products for AP English Language and Composition designed to address unmet teacher instructional needs, potentially including developing prototypes, participating in small-scale market-testing, and creating models for subsequent development in conjunction with other AP workstreams.
* Recruit educators for the AP English Language and Composition Development Committee and other opportunities to support AP Program.
* Serve as a recognized and trusted resource within the educator community by collaboration and engagement with the community to drive teacher satisfaction with AP Course English Language and Composition Collaborate with the AP Professional learning team to support AP English Language and Composition consultants and teachers.
* Work with the AP Higher Education team to co-develop and implement plans to raise college and university awareness of AP English Language and Composition courses and exams, including recruiting college faculty to participate in the AP Reading, co-leading the planning and execution of discipline-specific AP Faculty Colloquia events, and supporting Visiting and Virtual Fellows Programs.

**About You**

*You (have):*

* A Master’s degree in English Language and Composition or a directly related discipline, and knowledge of current trends in the discipline (required), although a doctorate in the discipline is strongly preferred
* Expertise in English Language and Composition with at least 5 years of experience in standardized assessment development or related work; experience with digital assessment and teaching preferred
* Strong oral and written communication skills, with solid technical proficiency and a customer-focused mindset
* Excellent organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and maintain close attention to detail, including proofreading
* Demonstrated ability to implement processes and procedures, manage project plans and schedules, and maintain tracking documentation
* Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across all levels, and engage in giving and receiving constructive feedback
* Ability to travel 6-8 times per year, plus up to two additional weeks for the AP Reading; must be eligible to work in the United States

All roles at College Board require:

* A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
* Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
* A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
* A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
* A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
* Authorization to work in the United States

**About Our Process**

* Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as item review and analysis, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.  

  

**What We Offer**

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck- we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  

* The hiring range for this role is $96,000–$135,000.
* Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
* We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
* We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

**Title: Customer Success Manager**

**\*\*Must live withing driving distance to Philadelphia, PA and/or Bristol, PA\*\***

**\*\*Remote position. Primarily work from home but must be located within driving distance of Clients as meetings might be needed once a month. \*\***

Description

Magna5 provides a portfolio of managed IT services, including network and desktop management, cybersecurity, private and public cloud services and back-up and disaster recovery, to name a few. Our clients are small to mid-size enterprises that look to us to improve their IT performance, enhance the experience of their end-users and allow them to focus their resources on projects that are strategic to their organization’s business plan. We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Technical Customer Services/Success Manager. As a Customer Success Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring our clients' satisfaction and success by delivering exceptional service and building strong relationships. The ideal candidate will possess a technical background and have 2-5 years of relevant experience in a similar role. Technical experience is mandatory.

**Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, building and maintaining strong relationships to ensure client satisfaction and success.
* Understand clients' business objectives and develop a deep understanding of their technical requirements.
* Act as a trusted advisor, providing expert guidance and best practices to clients to help them achieve their desired outcomes and maximize the value of our services.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including sales, support, and technical teams to ensure smooth onboarding, implementation, and ongoing support for clients.
* Conduct regular check-ins with clients to assess their satisfaction, address any concerns, and identify opportunities for upselling or cross selling our services.
* Monitor client usage and adoption of our services, proactively identifying areas for improvement and making recommendations to enhance their experience.
* Provide training and product demonstrations to clients, ensuring they have a comprehensive understanding of our offerings.
* Act as an advocate for clients within the organization, communicating their feedback, needs, and requirements to the appropriate teams.
* Stay up to date with industry trends and advancements and share knowledge and insights with clients to help them stay ahead of the curve.
* Continuously seek opportunities to improve internal processes and contribute to the overall growth and success of the company.

Requirements:

**Requirements**

**What You Bring to the Team:**

* 2-5 years of experience in a customer success or account management role, preferably within the IT industry or a Managed Service Provider.
* Strong technical background with a solid understanding of IT infrastructure, networks, and systems.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and establish trust with clients.
* Proven track record of managing client relationships and delivering exceptional customer service.
* Ability to understand complex technical concepts and effectively communicate them to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to quickly identify and resolve issues.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented, with a demonstrated ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field is preferred.

**Work Perks**

* 100% remote position
* Paid Time Off including paid holidays and float holidays
* Bonus potential based on individual and company performance
* Highly competitive and flexible medical, dental, and vision benefits plans
* 401(k) with employer match
* Tailored Life and Disability insurance plans
* Full reimbursement for approved professional certification and career enriching opportunities

**What We Do**

Magna5 is a rapidly growing IT Managed Service Provider delivering cybersecurity, private and public cloud hosting, backup and disaster recovery and other advanced services from mid-market to enterprise customers nationwide, including leaders within the education, healthcare, government, financial services, manufacturing, and other industry segments. We integrate advancements in technology and processes to drive businesses forward. As a trusted managed services provider, we bring together the right mix of managed IT services, security, and network connectivity, fully managed by our team of experts 24/7/365. Our passion is to help companies function better, faster, and smarter. We offer an exciting and collaborative environment, with growth potential. For more information, visit our website at www.magna5.com

5f931ef5098aa79f892b.title: Project Manager – RFP & Implementation Readiness
5f931ef5098aa79f892b.description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.

  

The **Project Manager – RFP & Implementation Readiness** connects Proposal Management, Business Development, and PMO leadership throughout the RFP process. This role ensures implementation plans, timelines, staffing, and commitments made during proposals are realistic and can be successfully delivered after contract award.

The role supports proposal development by collaborating in the creation and validation of project plans, identifying risks and dependencies, and coordinating with PMO and delivery leaders to ensure teams are prepared for potential new work.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary PMO point of contact for implementation-related RFP and proposal activities.
* Partner with Proposal Management, Business Development, Solution Architects, and delivery leaders to develop realistic implementation approaches.
* Develop and validate project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, staffing needs, and implementation timelines using delivery experience and historical project data to ensure proposed commitments are achievable.
* Identify and address risks, assumptions, resource constraints, and unrealistic delivery commitments before proposals are submitted.
* Provide PMO leadership with visibility into upcoming opportunities, staffing needs, and implementation readiness.
* Ensure appropriate project leadership and resources are identified for anticipated contract awards.
* Coordinate the transition from proposal to implementation, ensuring project teams understand key commitments, risks, assumptions, and dependencies.
* Develop and improve implementation planning standards, templates, and processes using lessons learned and actual project performance to improve future estimates and delivery commitments.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of project management, program management, PMO, or implementation leadership experience.
* Experience developing and managing complex project plans for large-scale government implementations.
* Strong knowledge of project scheduling, resource planning, dependencies, critical path analysis, and project lifecycle management.
* Experience supporting RFP, proposal, bid, or pre-sales activities.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to challenge assumptions and influence decisions across teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP or similar project management certification.
* Experience with government, public sector, or large-scale technology implementations.
* Experience with portfolio, capacity, and resource planning.
* Experience working across proposal, sales, solution engineering, and delivery teams.

**Flexible Working**

At Conduent, we want you to be yourself. We recognize that everyone is different and that how people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.

In this role, you can expect the following working conditions:

**Remote work:** Work in a way that allows you to work from home and have time onsite when needed to connect with other team members and business leaders.

**Working For You**

Perks and rewards designed for you:

**Health and Welfare Benefits:** Our health and welfare benefits can be tailored to fit you and your family's needs and start on the first day of employment.

**Retirement Savings:** We will support you as you save for your future.

**Employee Discounts:** We offer you access to a vast selection of global, national, and local discounts on merchandise, services, travel, and more

**Career Growth Opportunities:** We help you thrive, so together, we can grow. We provide opportunities to advance your career with a vast portfolio of businesses and a global footprint.

**Paid Training:** Earn while you learn and continue to grow with access to award-winning learning platforms throughout your Conduent career.

**Paid time off:** We provide attractive paid time off packages designed for you to enjoy your life away from work.

**Great Work Environment:** We are proud of our award-winning culture and the recognition we’ve received for our diversity efforts.

**Join Us**

At Conduent, we are one team, one mission. We understand that our success is directly related to the success of our associates.

We strive to create a culture where you can:

* Bring your authentic self to work.
* Grow and thrive, both personally and professionally.
* Make a difference with our clients, in our communities, and with the millions of people we support.

When you join Conduent, you are engaged in creating the future - both our company’s and your own. With more than 60,000 associates across 24 countries, we will provide you the opportunity to grow with a team of people who will challenge and inspire you to be the best!

Installation Coordinator – HVAC

**Clyde S. Walton, Inc. | Lansdale, PA**

**Job Type:** Full-Time | In-Person

About Us

Clyde S. Walton, Inc. is a fourth-generation, family-owned heating, cooling, and energy company proudly serving Montgomery, Bucks, and Lehigh Counties. For generations, we have built our reputation on exceptional customer service, quality workmanship, and treating our customers and employees like family.

We are looking for a highly organized, motivated, and detail-oriented **Installation Coordinator** to join our growing team.

Position Overview

The Installation Coordinator plays a critical role in keeping our HVAC installation department running smoothly and efficiently. This individual is responsible for coordinating installation schedules, communicating with customers, supporting our sales and installation teams, and ensuring that every job is properly prepared, documented, and completed.

The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys working with people, and takes pride in staying organized and following through on commitments.

**If you enjoy coordinating multiple projects, solving problems, and being the person who keeps everything moving, this could be an excellent opportunity for you.**

Key Responsibilities

**Installation Scheduling & Coordination**

* Schedule HVAC installation projects, site visits, and customer appointments.
* Coordinate daily and upcoming installation schedules with the Installation Supervisor.
* Communicate with homeowners to confirm installation dates, arrival expectations, and project details.
* Ensure installation crews have the information, documentation, and resources necessary to complete their assigned jobs.
* Coordinate equipment deliveries, rentals, subcontractors, and other project requirements.
* Monitor installation schedules and proactively address conflicts, delays, or changes.

**Communication & Customer Service**

* Serve as a primary point of contact between customers, sales representatives, installation technicians, warehouse personnel, and management.
* Provide customers with timely updates throughout the installation process.
* Respond professionally to customer questions, concerns, and scheduling requests.
* Follow up with customers after installations to confirm satisfaction.
* Assist in resolving installation-related issues and escalate concerns when necessary.

**Administrative & Operational Support**

* Maintain accurate installation schedules, job records, work orders, and project documentation.
* Prepare and organize installation packets, proposals, photographs, and other job-related information.
* Track installation progress and ensure completed jobs are properly documented and transferred for billing.
* Coordinate with the warehouse to ensure equipment and materials are available when needed.
* Assist with vehicle maintenance scheduling and other departmental administrative responsibilities.
* Support special projects and process improvements as assigned.

Qualifications

**Required**

* Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a busy office environment.
* Strong customer service skills and a professional, positive attitude.
* Proficiency with computers, email, spreadsheets, and scheduling software.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team.
* Dependability, accountability, and a willingness to take ownership of responsibilities.

**Preferred**

* Previous experience in scheduling, dispatching, project coordination, or office administration.
* Experience in HVAC, plumbing, electrical, construction, or another service-related industry.
* Familiarity with work orders, job scheduling, and field service management software.
* Experience coordinating field technicians or installation crews.

**HVAC experience is a plus, but not required. We are willing to train the right person who possesses strong organizational skills, a positive attitude, and a commitment to excellent customer service.**

What We're Looking For

We want someone who:

* Thinks ahead and anticipates problems before they occur.
* Understands the importance of keeping customers informed.
* Is comfortable juggling multiple responsibilities without losing track of the details.
* Takes initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do.
* Can communicate effectively with technicians, salespeople, management, and customers.
* Remains calm and professional when schedules change or unexpected challenges arise.
* Takes pride in being part of a team and helping others succeed.

Why Join Clyde S. Walton, Inc.?

At Walton's, we believe our employees are the foundation of our success. We value hard work, honesty, teamwork, and doing the right thing for our customers.

You'll be joining an established, family-owned company where your contributions matter and where you'll play an important role in delivering an exceptional customer experience.

Apply Today

If you're an organized, dependable professional who enjoys working with people and keeping projects on track, we'd love to hear from you.

**Join the Clyde S. Walton, Inc. team and help us continue our tradition of outstanding service and quality workmanship.**

*Clyde S. Walton, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $20.00 - $27.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off

Ability to Relocate:

* Lansdale, PA 19446: Relocate before starting work (Required)

Work Location: In person

6b4814fb6e6da8962982.title: Inbound Sales Specialist
6b4814fb6e6da8962982.description:
**Inbound Sales Specialist**
============================

**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Remote  
**Apply here:** https://operationsarmy.com/application

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a motivated, customer-focused Inbound Sales Specialist to join a growing healthcare technology company. This is an opportunity for a sales professional who knows how to turn inbound inquiries into qualified opportunities and wants to develop their skills in consultative selling and closing.

This is not a traditional cold-calling role. You will primarily engage with prospects who have already expressed interest, understand their needs, explain relevant solutions, and guide them through the early stages of the sales process.

You should be comfortable managing a high volume of leads, conducting sales conversations over the phone and video, and following up consistently to keep opportunities moving. The ideal candidate combines strong communication skills with a competitive mindset, disciplined organization, and a desire to achieve measurable results.

You will initially work alongside an existing sales team, qualifying prospects and advancing opportunities. As you gain experience and demonstrate strong performance, you will take on greater responsibility for managing your pipeline and closing customers.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Inbound Sales & Lead Qualification**

* Respond promptly to inbound inquiries and engage prospective customers through phone and video conversations.
* Understand prospects’ needs, challenges, and goals through thoughtful questions.
* Qualify leads based on their needs, level of interest, and suitability for the company’s services.
* Identify customer pain points and determine appropriate next steps.
* Explain the company’s offerings and communicate their value clearly.
* Prioritize incoming leads and manage a high volume of prospect interactions.
* Schedule sales conversations and ensure qualified opportunities are passed to the appropriate team members.
* Maintain a positive and professional experience throughout each interaction.

### **Prospect Engagement & Follow-Up**

* Follow up consistently with interested prospects to maintain engagement and move opportunities forward.
* Re-engage prospects who have not responded or need additional time to make a decision.
* Address initial questions, understand concerns, and identify potential objections.
* Keep track of conversations, commitments, and follow-up deadlines.
* Manage multiple prospects without losing track of important opportunities.
* Support the sales team during periods of high inbound lead volume.
* Ensure every qualified prospect has a clear next step.

### **CRM & Sales Pipeline Management**

* Maintain accurate CRM records, including contact details, call notes, activities, and opportunity status.
* Document prospect needs, qualification outcomes, and follow-up plans.
* Keep sales information organized and current.
* Track sales activities and progress against established performance targets.
* Identify opportunities to improve lead response times, follow-up consistency, and conversion rates.
* Collaborate with sales colleagues to maintain visibility across the pipeline.

### **Growth Into Sales Closing**

As you develop product knowledge and demonstrate strong performance, you will have the opportunity to:

* Take ownership of qualified sales opportunities.
* Conduct discovery calls and sales conversations independently.
* Present solutions that address specific customer needs.
* Handle objections and guide prospects through purchasing decisions.
* Manage your own pipeline and maintain momentum toward closing.
* Take increasing responsibility for closing customers against agreed sales targets.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Must-Haves**

* At least 1–3+ years of experience in inside sales, sales development, business development, or a comparable customer-facing sales role.
* Experience handling a high volume of leads, prospect interactions, or sales conversations.
* Excellent spoken and written English.
* A confident, professional phone presence and strong interpersonal communication skills.
* Experience qualifying prospects and identifying customer needs or pain points.
* Strong follow-up habits and the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
* Experience working toward sales quotas, conversion targets, activity metrics, or similar KPIs.
* Experience using a CRM to track prospects, sales activities, and follow-ups.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to learn new products and explain their value to prospective customers.
* Self-motivated, coachable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
* Based in the United States and available during U.S. business hours.

### **Strong Plus**

* Previous experience in inbound sales or lead qualification.
* Experience conducting discovery calls or consultative sales conversations.
* Experience advancing opportunities or closing deals.
* SaaS or technology-enabled services sales experience.
* SMB sales experience.
* Healthcare technology sales experience.
* Experience managing short sales cycles and high lead volumes.
* A track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

Previous experience in the specific industry is not required. We value strong sales fundamentals, consistent execution, and the ability to learn quickly.

**Working Style**
-----------------

You should enjoy engaging with prospects, asking questions, understanding customer needs, and helping people determine whether a solution is right for them.

This role requires someone who understands that speed and consistency matter in inbound sales. You should be comfortable balancing multiple conversations, prioritizing leads, and following through without constant reminders.

You should also be motivated by measurable performance and willing to use coaching and feedback to improve. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work rather than simply completing assigned calls or tasks.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

Success means responding promptly to inbound inquiries, qualifying prospects accurately, maintaining consistent follow-up, and helping the sales team convert interest into opportunities.

As you grow in the role, success will also mean managing a pipeline independently, leading effective sales conversations, handling objections, and closing customers against agreed targets.

If you’re organized, persistent, customer-focused, and motivated to grow your sales career, we’d love to hear from you.

**Apply here:** https://operationsarmy.com/application

fa4ed18cf9323757f06b.description:
**Audit QA & Project Coordinator (1099 Contract, Part-Time)**

**Revu Healthcare | Remote | Up to 20 hours per week**

**About Revu Healthcare**

Revu Healthcare is a healthcare compliance advisory firm that performs retrospective documentation and coding reviews for hospitals, physician practices, and specialty providers. Our reviews span outpatient specialties, DRG validation, home health and hospice, ESRD dialysis, and remote patient monitoring. We deliver accurate, defensible findings in clear language our clients can act on.

**The Engagement**

We're seeking an experienced, certified coding professional to coordinate audit projects from handoff through final deliverables. This is an independent contractor (1099) engagement of up to 20 hours per week, with hours varying based on project volume. You'll serve as the day-to-day point of contact for clients on your assigned projects and work closely with the Director of Operations and our consulting team to keep reviews accurate, organized, and on schedule.

**Scope of Work**

*Project coordination*

* Take over assigned projects at handoff, confirm each account has the documentation needed for review, and request and track any missing documentation from the client
* Send consultants their project assignment details and Teams notification, and run the internal project kickoff
* Hold a weekly 15-minute project touchpoint with the consultants on each assigned project to review progress, QA feedback, questions, and upcoming deadlines
* Track account progress against project timelines and manage short timeline extensions according to Revu procedures
* Participate in regular Audit Operations check-ins with the Director of Operations (currently Monday, Wednesday, and Friday)

  

*Quality assurance*

* Perform quality assurance reviews of consultant findings for coding accuracy, guideline support, and consistent rationale
* Maintain audit worksheets and account status tracking so project information is current and accurate

  

*Client communication*

* Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for clients on assigned projects, beginning at the external kickoff call
* Send each client a weekly progress update every Friday
* Escalate missing documentation, access issues, timeline risks, and other concerns early, following Revu's escalation path

  

*Deliverables and rebuttals*

* Draft preliminary and final verbal readouts for Director of Operations approval, then send approved readouts to the client
* Initiate and track the 14-business-day client rebuttal period, escalating when a response is at risk
* Cross-check rebuttal outcomes against preliminary findings
* Support preparation of written reports

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Active Certified Professional Coder (CPC) credential through AAPC, held for 5 or more years and in good standing
* 5 or more years of professional coding experience
* Strong working knowledge of ICD-10-CM, CPT, and HCPCS Level II coding guidelines
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and comfort with Word, PowerPoint, and Microsoft Teams
* Strong attention to detail and clear, professional written communication
* Ability to protect PHI and follow HIPAA requirements
* Reliable, secure internet connection and own computer equipment

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in both coding audits and production coding
* Inpatient coding knowledge, including ICD-10-PCS and MS-DRG assignment
* Quality assurance experience reviewing other coders' or auditors' work
* Project management or project coordination experience
* Additional credentials such as CPMA, CIC, COC, CCS, or RHIT/RHIA

  

**Engagement Details**

* **Classification:** Independent contractor (1099); **no benefits are provided.**
* **Hours:** Up to 20 per week **based on workload**; no minimum is guaranteed
* **Time zone:** Revu Healthcare operates on Eastern Time (ET). All deadlines and meeting times follow Eastern Time unless otherwise identified.
* **Location:** Remote. Candidates must reside in and perform all work from within the United States; no exceptions.
  + Due to the nature of our client engagements and requirements for handling protected health information, we can only consider candidates who reside in and perform all work from within the United States.
* **Invoicing:** Biweekly

  

**Selection Process and Onboarding**

* **Written assessment:** 20 questions covering coding, quality assurance, project oversight, administrative tasks, and communication and feedback.

* **Hands-on QA exercise:**

* **Onboarding:** QA two-to-three sets of mock accounts in Revu's audit worksheet, using fictional medical records based on real review scenarios, then shadows a live project before coordinating projects independently.

  

As part of the selection process, candidates will be required to complete a candidate assessment covering coding, quality assurance, project oversight, and administrative tasks.

Overview:

Sprout is a global IT hardware retirement provider for hyperscaler and enterprise clients. We leverage a nationwide footprint (and international partner network) combined with proprietary software to enable efficient end-to-end IT asset disposition with a focus on data-bearing devices from the client to the cloud. The company is headquartered in Charlotte, NC with additional operations near Sacramento, Dallas, and Boston. Sprout provides software and services to clients in the form of our IT Asset Disposition, Certified Destruction, and Responsible Recycling solutions.

Since our founding as an electronic waste startup from a Duke University dorm room in 2014, we have been expanding at an average rate of >50% each year. By adhering to our 3 values (One Sprout, Deliver Excellence, and Integrity Matters), we are proud of our culture to move at #SproutSpeed seeking to become the emerging leader in our industry

The Technical Project Manager owns datacenter hardware projects across the full asset lifecycle — from initial buildout and infrastructure configuration, through steady-state operations handover, to end-of-life decommissioning and disposition. This role is the single point of accountability that keeps complex, multi-vendor hardware programs on schedule, on budget, and on spec while coordinating engineering, facilities, supply chain, and vendor teams. It is a delivery-focused role for someone equally comfortable in a project plan and on a datacenter floor, and who can translate technical detail into clear stakeholder communication.

Responsibilities:

* Plan and manage datacenter buildout projects end to end — site readiness, rack and power layout, cabling, and network fabric — against defined milestones
* Coordinate facilities, engineering, and vendor teams to deliver hardware installation on schedule and to spec
* Manage scope, dependencies, and site logistics across concurrent buildout efforts
* Drive the build and configuration of compute, storage, and network infrastructure to specification
* Manage burn-in, validation, and acceptance testing before production release
* Ensure configurations, firmware, and standards are consistent and documented across deployments
* Lead the transition of newly deployed infrastructure into steady-state operations
* Ensure runbooks, monitoring, documentation, and support ownership are in place before handover
* Confirm operations readiness and sign-off with receiving teams
* Manage decommissioning of end-of-life hardware — safe power-down, de-racking, and removal
* Oversee data sanitization, asset tracking, and compliant resale, recycling, or destruction
* Maintain regulatory and chain-of-custody compliance throughout the disposition process
* Build and maintain integrated project schedules, budgets, risk registers, and status reporting across all lifecycle phases
* Coordinate vendors, contractors, and internal stakeholders, holding each accountable to scope, timeline, and quality
* Track hardware assets and maintain accurate lifecycle records in the CMDB / asset management system
* Identify risks and dependencies early, drive resolution, and escalate clearly when decisions or trade-offs are needed

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Business Management, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* Several years of technical project management experience delivering datacenter or IT infrastructure hardware projects
* Demonstrated experience across the hardware lifecycle: datacenter buildout, infrastructure build and configuration, operations handover, and decommissioning and disposition
* Certifications are a plus — e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, or CSM for project management, and datacenter / infrastructure credentials such as CDCP/CDCS, ITIL, or relevant vendor certifications (Cisco, Dell, HPE)
* Experience with ITAD, data sanitization standards (e.g., NIST 800-88), and environmental / chain-of-custody compliance is a plus
