548e29d3c51a890bd1e4.title: Vendor Support Strategy Specialist, MI
548e29d3c51a890bd1e4.description:
**Position Overview**
---------------------

The Vendor Support Strategy Specialist, Medical Informatics (MI) shapes and governs third-party support arrangements across the MI product portfolio. This role collaborates with Vendors, Product management, Customer Support, Implementation, Contract Administration, and Procurement to translate business and product needs into effective support coverage, commercial terms, lifecycle plans, and escalation practices.

**Company Overview**
--------------------

At FUJIFILM Healthcare Americas Corporation, we’re on a mission to innovate for a healthier world, and we need passionate, driven people like you to help us get there. Our cutting-edge healthcare solutions span diagnostic imaging, enterprise imaging, endoscopic and surgical imaging, as well as in-vitro diagnostics.

But we don’t stop at healthcare; our Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) team harnesses advanced radiography solutions to keep transportation infrastructure, aerospace, and oil and gas assets safe and running smoothly.

Ready to innovate, collaborate, and make a difference? Join us and bring your big ideas to life while working in a dynamic, flexible environment that fuels your creativity and drive.

Our headquarters is in Lexington, Massachusetts, an inspiring healthcare research hub in a historic town.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Duties and responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain the third-party support strategy for the Medical Informatics product portfolio.
* Partner with product management and operational teams to assess vendor support needs, customer impact, lifecycle status, risk, and cost.
* Lead or support vendor discussions and negotiations covering service scope, renewals, pricing, replacement services, and escalation expectations.
* Review vendor proposals and agreements to identify coverage gaps, unclear responsibilities, unfavorable limitations, and customer-impact risks.
* Maintain support entitlements, lifecycle information, vendor scorecards, risk registers, renewal forecasts, and leadership reporting.
* Monitor vendor responsiveness and performance, support escalations, and recommend corrective actions or support-level changes.
* Align third-party support capabilities with customer commitments and advise stakeholders on what can responsibly be offered.
* Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary spend, standardize third-party support tiers, consolidate services, and improve third-party support processes.
* Develop and maintain the enterprise strategy for third-party support arrangements across the Medical Informatics product portfolio.
* Partner with Product Management and operational stakeholders to understand how third-party products and services enable customer deployments and service offerings.
* Recommend the appropriate third-party support level based on customer impact, operational and contractual risk, lifecycle status, replacement needs, service expectations, and cost.
* Advise leadership on the business and customer implications of unsupported, under-supported, obsolete, end-of-life, or otherwise high-risk third-party offerings.
* Comply with all applicable U.S. Food and Drug Administration (U.S. FDA) medical device regulatory requirements, applicable ISO 13485 standard requirements and all other applicable laws, regulations and standards.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* 3-5 years of relevant experience.
* Experience in vendor management, contract administration, product operations, service strategy, healthcare technology, or a related field.
* Experience evaluating, negotiating, or administering third-party support arrangements, renewals, and vendor performance expectations.
* Working understanding of enterprise technology, clinical software, hardware, integrations, and product lifecycle concepts.
* Strong analytical, organizational, documentation, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and drive decisions without direct authority.
* Proficient in Salesforce, Microsoft Office, including PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.
* Healthcare technology, medical devices, clinical software, or regulated environments is preferred.
* Negotiating support provisions in master agreements, statements of work, amendments, or renewals is preferred.
* Experience creating entitlement matrices, vendor scorecards, risk registers, dashboards, or executive reporting is preferred.

**Physical requirements**

* The ability to sit up 75-100% of applicable work time.
* The ability to use your hands and fingers to feel and manipulate items, including keyboards, up to 100% of applicable work time.
* The ability to stand, talk, and listen for 75% of applicable work time.
* Close Vision: The ability to see clearly at twenty inches or less.

**Travel**

* At least 25% travel may be required based on business needs.

* #LI-Remote

  

*In the event that COVID-19 vaccine mandates issued by the federal government, or by state or local government become effective and enforceable, the Company will require that the successful candidate hired for positions covered under relevant government vaccine mandate(s) be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, absent being granted an accommodation due to medical or sincerely held religious belief or other legally required exemption.*  
*Applicants to positions where vendor credentialing or other similar requirements exist to enter facilities will be required to comply with the credentialing requirements of the facilities, including complying with vaccine requirements.*  
*For all positions, the Company encourages vaccination against COVID-19 and requires that the successful candidate hired be willing to test for the COVID-19 virus periodically and wear a face covering indoors as required, absent being granted an accommodation due to medical or sincerely held religious belief or other legally required exemption.*

b948624120c8da5a77af.title: Assistant General Manager
b948624120c8da5a77af.description:
Be a part of the growing boutique fitness industry and join our Studio Team! Interact directly with members and prospective members and help them on their fitness journey while you connect and contribute to our studio community in this fun, high-energy and service-focused environment!

Born in San Diego in 2007, Club Pilates has expanded across the nation, bringing Pilates to hundreds of thousands of people. We serve up over eight million workouts each year to our dedicated members…and we’re just getting started.

Pure to Joseph Pilates’ original Reformer-based Contrology Method, but modernized with group practice and expanded state-of-the-art equipment, Club Pilates offers high-quality, life-changing training at a surprisingly affordable price.

We believe that Pilates is the path to a fuller, more satisfying physical existence. We believe that being in control of your body helps you to be in control of your life. And best of all, we believe that you can start anytime.

**POSITION:** Our studio in Kennett Square is looking for an experienced Assistant General Manager to assist the General Manager and team with new membership sales by bringing new members to the studio and booking them into Intro Classes, contact potential clients, help drive Membership sales and overall studio revenue, confirm attendance for classes, and partake in the day to day operations of the studio. The Assistant General Manager also assists with retaining members and works closely with the General Manager in overseeing the studio operations. The right candidate is comfortable contacting leads on the phone and face to face. Candidates MUST have a sales background and experience in the fitness industry is strongly desired. A passion for Pilates is an extra bonus!

**COMPENSATION & PERKS:**

* Full Time (~40 hours per week)
* Hourly Pay
* Employer Subsidized Health Insurance
* Includes Vision, Dental, Life and LTD insurance
* 401K eligible with employer matching after 1 year
* Monthly bonuses based on sales and performance
* Free Pilates classes and store discounts
* Excellent opportunities for growth within studios in the area, including additional sales and management positions

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* MUST have absolute minimum of 3 years of experience selling Fitness/Health Lifestyle Memberships or a similar type of membership-based sales
* Must be able to work flexible schedule to include one weekend day and a mix of weekdays and weekday evening hours

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Assist General Manager with daily studio sales, operations, and scheduling; manage the studio and provide leadership when the General Manager is off
* Provide exceptional level of customer service to prospects and members
* Understand studio operations and assist in scheduling of classes, sales staff and instructors
* Create an environment of support and encouragement
* In coordination with the General Manager, create and execute monthly member appreciation events, challenges, and workshops
* Greet members, manage class check-ins, announce monthly promotions
* Contact prospects via face-to-face, phone, text and email communication
* Engage with prospects to determine fitness goals, develop rapport and book intro classes
* Support Intro Classes
* Follow up on collecting past due memberships and assisting General Manager in managing cancelations
* Sell memberships; learn and understand the options, effectively communicate them to prospects, overcome objections and close sales
* Provide assistance and information on product features and membership details
* Become proficient with the client management software to troubleshoot member account inquiries and issues including class credits, billing details, cancellations, freezes, membership changes, etc.
* Follow up on retention tasks using provided templates and cadence
* Enforce Club Pilates policies and procedures
* Develop sales skills through consistent training and roleplaying
* Ensure studio is staffed appropriately and fill in shifts when needed
* Merchandising of the retail section. Change the display as needed and keep the slat wall updated by rotating inventory as needed
* Participate in grassroots marketing and community outreach events
* Knowledge and regular use of Social Media i.e., Facebook, Instagram, Google+ to support social media posts for the studio
* Ensure all forms, administrative supplies and studio literature is stocked and visible.
* Ensure the facilities and equipment are clean and maintained, including daily deep cleaning duties

**SKILLS:**

* Energetic and outgoing personality
* Excellent sales, communication and customer service skills
* Professional and effective communication
* Problem solving/Conflict resolution
* Computer proficiency
* Professional, punctual, reliable, neat and organized
* Strong attention to detail
* Highly dependable and trustworthy
* Passion for fitness and a healthy lifestyle
* Goal-oriented with an ability to achieve sales in membership, retail, and private training
* Strong desire to learn and open to feedback
* Ability to stand or sit for up to 8 hours throughout the workday
* Must be able to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines

**VALUES:**

* Integrity – The foundation of our business is built on honesty and trust, loyalty and dedication to the company, our members and to each other.
* Teamwork – We are a loyal Club Pilates team working together with passion as we bring the benefits of Pilates to our external community. We feel a connection with each other and our members through open communication and support.
* Passion – This is our driving force. It is at the heart of everything we do. The knowledge that we are impacting people in a positive way empowers everyone on our team.
* Professionalism – Working in an organized and productive manner to achieve results and exceed sales goals.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $24.00 - $26.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* What is your experience with fitness and/or membership sales?
* Are you able to work a flexible schedule to include one weekend day and a mix of weekdays and weekday evening hours?

Work Location: In person

Project Talent Model (PTM) is a talent model that is tailored specifically for long-term, onsite client service delivery.  
  
**Work you'll do/Responsibilities**  
  
As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte, you will work within an engagement team and be responsible for supporting the overall project goals and objectives. In this role, you will interact with stakeholders and cross-functional teams. It is expected that you will be able to perform independent tasks as well as provide technical guidance to team members, as needed.
  

* Provide strategic and in-depth research, analysis, and recommendations related to Customer Service business processes, operational performance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for Billing processes and transactions, exception management, and regulatory and operational support.
* Act as a liaison between the business area and technical support organizations to ensure business needs are properly documented and translated into technical requirements.

* Communicate regularly with Engagement Managers (Directors), project team members, and representatives from various functional and / or technical teams, including escalating any matters that require additional attention and consideration from engagement management.

  
**The Team**  
  
Our Deloitte Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to deliver holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisers and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to collaborate with leading solution providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable heart-of-the-business solutions.  
  
Enterprise Operations as a Service provides multi-year managed service contracts to support enterprise technology investments and key business processes. We ensure continuous modernization and transformative business changes through five key services: SAP Operations, Oracle Operations, IT Operations, Supply Chain Operations, and Finance Operations. Our mission is to help businesses thrive by maintaining their essential operations and enabling growth.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
**Required**  

* 5+ years of SAP IS-U Billing experience
* Experience in utility Customer Service operations, SAP utility system processes, query and reporting tools, and data analysis.

* Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
* Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

  
**Preferred**  

* Analytical/ Decision Making Responsibilities
* Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products
* Can operate independently or with minimum supervision
* Excellent Written and Communication Skills
* Ability to deliver technical demonstrations

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. 22b0ff1a5edb35c27973.title: VP of Media Operations
22b0ff1a5edb35c27973.description:
##### **Mission**

We give growing brands the **confidence**, **defensibility**, and **predictability** to buy and execute **real world advertising** like the strategic channel it is.

##### **Vision**

Be the strategic partner who has built the **intelligence layer** for brands to confidently extend their omnichannel campaigns into the real world.

##### **Values - how we work**

* We obsess over the customer's real problem
* Chase, say, do
* Move with urgency and intention
* Build with transparency
* Become the standard
* Bring the juice

##### **Value Alignment**

Onescreen hires and develops people with a builder's mindset: curiosity about how things actually work, a habit of pulling the thread past the first explanation to the structural cause, systems thinking that asks "what's the most efficient way to do this" before "how do I do this," and a discomfort with the status quo that shows up as extending the system instead of routing around it. We're services-led today, by design, but our enterprise value depends on proving a scalable platform model — which means every workaround, stale export, or side-doc this role creates or notices is a signal worth surfacing, not a convenience worth keeping quiet. This role is evaluated on the builder's mindset as directly as it's evaluated on its core responsibilities.

##### **About the role**

Onescreen is looking for a VP of Media Operations to own how every Onescreen client gets onboarded, planned, activated, delivered, and proven. This role owns everything after the sale that gets a client live and keeps every campaign delivering on the Onescreen platform. It runs the Customer Success, Media Planning, and Campaign Operations functions that determine whether Onescreen delivers what it promised, on time, on budget, and at margin. As the operational partner to New Business and Client Development, this role gives New Business the confidence it needs to close deals, and Client Development the results it needs to retain and grow every account.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own the process that gets a newly won client live and seeing value quickly, from signed IO through booking, creative QA and approvals, trafficking, and launch checks.
* Own the operational process for campaign and account planning through the Director of Media Planning, ensuring plans are data-driven, built on the platform, and executable as sold.
* Own in-flight monitoring, pacing, make-goods, and proof-of-play / proof-of-performance so every campaign delivers what was sold and clients can see it.
* Give Client Development the operational inputs that drive retention and growth: client health signals, campaign results and recaps for QBRs and renewals, and early warning on at-risk accounts.
* Own day-to-day account servicing and issue resolution through the Director of Customer Success.
* Own operational relationships with media owners and inventory partners: onboarding, availability, booking workflows, SLAs, and issue escalation.
* Report delivery, margin, client health, and operational metrics to the CRO and exec team.

##### **Requirements & Qualifications**

* 8+ years in ad operations, media operations, or client services leadership in media, agency, ad-tech, or a platform/services business.
* Track record owning campaign delivery, pacing, and reconciliation at scale; hands-on with ad servers, DSP/SSP workflows, and delivery reporting.
* Experience building scalable onboarding and ad ops processes, ideally through a services-to-platform transition.
* Experience partnering with account management or client development teams on retention and growth.
* Experienced managing leaders (Director level), not just individual contributors.
* Out-of-home / DOOH, programmatic, or ad tech experience preferred.

##### **Location & Compensation**

* Location: Boston, Chicago, or New York
* Base Salary Range: $200,000 - $225,000 + Corporate Variable Bonus (Target 30%) + Equity & Health Benefits

* **JOB SUMMARY**

  + Plan, direct, or coordinate the daily patient/resident care activities in the clinical environment. The Nurse Supervisor is accountable for the delivery of nursing and patient/resident care services. Acts as the highest-ranking on-site leader in the absence of other administrative/clinical leader for the service/location..The position reports to the Director of Nursing of the site. The Nurse Supervisor will foster the mission and core values of the GSRN in their daily practice.

  + **SUPERVISOR SKILLS**

    - Oversees site operations; strives to achieve organizational and departmental goals and objectives in the area of responsibility.
    - Acts as a clinical and administrative resource while on duty.
    - Participates in leading nursing staff including participation in hiring, participates in transitioning and encouraging professional development of each member within their scope of practice.
    - Supports and assists in scheduling the nursing staffing requirements based upon acuity, specialty, volumes including budgeted NHPPD.
    - Facilitates staff growth and development.
    - Communicates through effective written and verbal communication skills.
    - Assists in implementing plans and strategies to maximize delivery of safe patient/resident care.
    - Assists in leading actions to achieve departmental goals and objectives in area of responsibility.
    - Routinely communicates GSRN, site specific information to associates.
  + **FACILITATES PATIENT****/RESIDENT** **CARE**

    - Participates in development and implementation of nursing policies and procedures utilizing evidence-based practice to standardize care.
  + **CONTRIBUTES TOWARDS ACHIEVING DEPARTMENTAL STRATEGIC GOALS**

    - Gathers pertinent business, financial, service, and operations information in coordination with other nursing leaders.
    - Assists with identifying trends.
    - Collaborate with Nursing Leadership to review and implement best practices for the unit, and evaluate outcomes.
  + **CONTRIBUTES AND WORKS TOWARDS FINANCIAL OBJECTIVES**

    - Utilizes NHPPD and Acuity as a guide to assign staff to meet the needs of patients/residents.
    - Assist staff in obtaining supplies, equipment, medication, and transport services for patients/residents as needed to assist in controlling expenses.
    - Identifying and providing input to Nursing Leaders on work methods that reduce the cost and/or time required to deliver patient/resident care.
    - Exercises fiscal responsibility for expenditures and understands trends and variances in collaboration with Nurse Managers.
  + **DELIVERS QUALITY CARE**

    - Ensures competency-based care is provided through ongoing supervision and evaluation of staff.
    - Recognizes and responds to actual or potential events to ensure patient/resident safety.
    - Recommends systems improvements.
    - Demonstrates evidence-based decision making when addressing practice changes.
    - Assisting the Nurse Managers and Directors in effective communication among team members.
    - Providing handoff clinical report at the end of each shift.
    - Analyzes, reviews and provides feedback for event reporting during the shift.
    - Assists with orienting and evaluating the competency of agency, float, and/or per diem associates or delegating the responsibility to an appropriate individual.
  + **DEVELOPS AND ENHANCES PROFESSIONAL KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS**

    - Demonstrates a willingness to learn, grow and seek new and innovative opportunities.
    - Coordinates and/or provides learning experiences for professional development of staff.
    - Reviews professional publications.
    - Participates in professional societies/organizations.
  + **PROMOTES HEALTHY WORKING ENVIRONMENT BY**

    - Promotes Patient/Resident safety through a Just Culture in the workplace.
    - Complies with policies and procedures, rules and regulations governing environment of care and patient safety.
    - Applying quality improvement techniques to improve deficiencies.
    - Reviewing and revising policies, procedures and standards of care including appropriate references.
    - Demonstrating knowledge of responsibilities in an emergency situation and conducting drills (Code Blue, Fire, Internal Disaster, Bomb Threat, Priority Alert).
  + **CONTRIBUTES TO TEAM EFFORT BY**

    - Developing channels of communication which will enhance working relations and service delivery between nursing shifts, units and hospitals.
    - Establishing cooperative, collaborative relationships among disciplines and departments.
  + **COMPLIES WITH FEDERAL, STATE, AND LOCAL REQUIREMENTS**

    - Ensures that all regulations, and standards are followed at the federal, state and local levels.
    - Maintaining compliance with professional, regulatory and governmental standards of care.
    - Maintains HIPAA Compliance.
  + **DEMONSTRATES PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT BY**

    - Remaining current in nursing and management knowledge and skills. Develops leadership skills in areas of responsibility.

  + ***To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.***

    - **Work Experience**

Bring your talents to Ross, our leading off-price retail chain with over 2,200 stores, and a strong track record of success and growth. Our focus has always been bringing our customers a constant stream of high-quality brands and on-trend merchandise at extraordinary savings. All while providing a fun and exciting treasure hunt experience.

**As part of our team, you will experience:**

* **Success.** Our winning team pursues excellence while learning and evolving.
* **Career growth.** We develop industry leading talent because Ross grows when our people grow.
* **Teamwork.** We work together to solve the hard problems and find the right solution.
* **Our commitment to Diversity, Equality & Inclusion, and our community.** We celebrate the backgrounds, identities, and ideas of those who work and shop with us because our differences make us stronger. We strive to be a positive force in our community.

Our Corporate headquarters are in Dublin, CA, we have 3 buying offices in key markets in New York City, Los Angeles, and Boston, and 8 distribution centers nationwide. With 2025 revenues of $22.8 billion, we are a Fortune 500 company who is committed to providing an inclusive work environment with continuous learning opportunities and development for our teams.

**GENERAL PURPOSE:**  
The Retail Associate is responsible for ensuring our Customers have a positive shopping experience. The Associate makes eye contact, smiles, and greets all Customers in a courteous and friendly manner, treats fellow Associates with respect, efficiently follows all company best practice standards as outlined in all work centers, maintains a clean work area at all times, and ensures proper merchandise presentation. The Retail Associate is expected to be engaged in these tasks as assigned during all working hours and will be expected to perform a range of functions in all areas of the Store as business needs require. The Associate may be requested to perform additional tasks in specific situations, if performance of these tasks will help achieve our Customer service and operational goals.  
  
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Understands that safety is the number one priority and practices safe behaviors in everything they do.
* Maintains a high level of awareness on the sales floor to create a safe and secure shopping environment for everyone. Maintains clutter free, clear egress to emergency exits. Immediately corrects or reports any unsafe conditions or practices to Store Leadership.
* Treats all Customers and Associates with respect and courtesy; is friendly and professional at all times. Recognizes fellow Associates using Company recognition programs.
* Assists Customers in any way necessary - is register-trained, assists Customers with merchandise, and answers Customer questions in a polite and knowledgeable manner. Greets all Customers by making eye contact, smiling and saying "hello" throughout the Store as well as saying "thank you" with every register transaction.
* Provides prompt and efficient responses to Customers at all times. Responds to Customer Service calls immediately. Handles all Customer issues in a courteous and helpful way, calling a member of the Store Leadership when needed.
* Represents and supports the Company brand at all times.
* Performs cleaning tasks such as sweeping, mopping, dusting, wiping counters and mirrors, replenishing restroom supplies, and disinfecting high-touch areas including the front-end, sales floor and restrooms to help maintain merchandise, customer and Team areas.
* Maintains a professional appearance and adheres to the Company's dress code at all times.
* Performs cleaning tasks such as sweeping, mopping, dusting, wiping counters and mirrors, and replenishing restroom supplies to help maintain merchandise, customer and Team areas.
* Performs daily assigned sizing and recovery per company best practice to ensure a neat, clean and organized store that is well-maintained and efficiently merchandised to standards.
* Expedites newly received merchandise receipts to the sales floor with a sense of urgency, merchandising all items per company best practice to the monthly presentation guidelines and maintaining merchandise/brand name familiarity within departments to assist Customers.
* Understands the Loss Prevention Awareness program, the Shortage Highway, the Store Protection Specialist (SPS) position (where applicable), and merchandise protection standards.
* As a representative of Ross Inc., demonstrates integrity and honesty in all interactions with Associates and Customers. Safeguards confidential information, cash and credit card information, and merchandise.
* Follows all Mark-Out-of-Stock (MOS) policies, including the identification of MOS merchandise, proper processing of each piece and the notification of Store Leadership to review and approve all disposals.
* Follows all policies and procedures concerning cash, check, charge card and refund transactions, voids and offline procedures. Maintains a high level of awareness and accuracy when handling bankable tenders.
* Demonstrates a sense of urgency to efficiently perform their role. Maximizes productivity by executing all Store best practices and minimizing steps and touches in their work flow.

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Manages Work Processes.
* Business Acumen.
* Plans, Aligns & Prioritizes.
* Builds Talent.
* Collaborates.
* Leading by Example.
* Communicates Effectively.
* Ensures Accountability & Execution.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND SPECIAL SKILLS REQUIRED:**

* Effectively communicate with Customers, Associates and Store Leadership in a friendly, respectful, cooperative and pleasant manner.
* Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations commonly used in retail environments.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS/ADA:**

* Ability to use all Store equipment, including PDTs, registers and PC as required.
* Ability to spend up to 100% of working time standing, walking, and moving around the Store.
* Ability to regularly bend at the waist, squat, kneel, climb, carry, reach, and stoop.
* Ability to occasionally push, pull and lift more than 25 pounds.
* Ability to use janitorial equipment, rolling racks, ladders and other assigned supplies.
* Certain assignments may require other qualifications and skills.
* Associates who work Stockroom shifts: Ability to regularly push, pull and lift more than 20 pounds.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:** None.

**DISCLAIMER:**  
This job description is a summary of the primary duties and responsibilities of the job and position. It is not intended to be a comprehensive or all-inclusive listing of duties and responsibilities. Contents are subject to change at management's discretion.

Ross is an equal employment opportunity employer. We consider individuals for employment or promotion according to their skills, abilities and experience. We believe that it is an essential part of the Company's overall commitment to attract, hire and develop a strong, talented and diverse workforce. Ross is committed to complying with all applicable laws prohibiting discrimination based on race, color, religious creed, age, national origin, ancestry, physical, mental or developmental disability, sex (which includes pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), veteran status, military status, marital or registered domestic partnership status, medical condition (including cancer or genetic characteristics), genetic information, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, as well as any other category protected by federal, state or local laws.

The base pay range for this role is $15.92 - $16.42. The base pay range is dependent on factors including, but not limited to, experience, skills, qualifications, relevant education, certifications, seniority, and location. The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package for employees. Other rewards vary by position and location.

5bcb175b1a36bf7c9d1b.title: Talent Acquisition Manager
5bcb175b1a36bf7c9d1b.description:
Talent Acquisition Manager

**Company:** BGW Creative Marketing LLC  
**Company Headquarters:** New York City, NY  
**Work Arrangement:** Remote  
**Employment Type:** W-2 Employee  
**Compensation:** Commission-based compensation, subject to applicable wage and employment laws.

Overview

BGW Creative Marketing LLC is seeking an experienced and motivated Talent Acquisition Manager to lead recruiting efforts and help build the company's workforce as we grow.

The Talent Acquisition Manager will identify, attract, screen, interview, and recommend qualified professionals across multiple departments. This individual will help establish candidate pipelines, develop recruiting strategies, and support BGW's long-term expansion.

You will work directly with the Owner/CEO to identify staffing needs, coordinate hiring efforts, and recruit professionals who can contribute to the company's success.

Responsibilities

Lead talent acquisition and recruiting efforts across the following departments as hiring needs arise:

Sales and Business Development

* Senior Business Development Representatives (BDRs)
* Business Development Representatives
* Sales Development Representatives (SDRs)
* Business Development Managers
* Account Executives
* Sales Managers
* Sales Operations Specialists

Marketing and Creative Services

* Marketing Managers
* Social Media Managers and Specialists
* SEO Specialists and Managers
* Graphic Designers
* Brand Strategists
* Copywriters
* Web Designers
* Web Developers
* PPC Specialists
* Digital Advertising Specialists
* Video Editors
* Email Marketing Specialists
* Media Buyers

Advertising and Media

* Outdoor Advertising Specialists
* Billboard Advertising Specialists
* Transit Advertising Specialists
* Radio Advertising Specialists
* Television Advertising Specialists
* Media Partnerships Managers
* Campaign Managers
* Event Marketing Specialists

Operations and Project Management

* Director of Operations
* Operations Managers
* Project Managers
* Account Managers
* Client Services Managers
* Customer Success Specialists
* Customer Support Representatives

Finance, Administration and Human Resources

* Bookkeepers
* Accounting Specialists
* Payroll Administrators
* Human Resources Managers
* Recruiting Coordinators
* Administrative Assistants
* Finance Managers

Core Recruiting Duties

* Develop recruiting strategies for current and future staffing needs.
* Identify and source qualified candidates through job boards, professional networks, social media, and direct outreach.
* Review applications and evaluate candidate qualifications.
* Conduct initial candidate screenings and interviews.
* Coordinate interviews between candidates and company leadership.
* Recommend qualified candidates for consideration.
* Maintain organized candidate pipelines and recruiting records.
* Communicate with applicants throughout the recruitment process.
* Provide regular recruiting updates and hiring progress reports.
* Build relationships with potential candidates for future openings.
* Help establish and strengthen BGW's recruiting processes as the company expands.

Requirements

* Experience in talent acquisition, recruiting, or human resources.
* Experience sourcing and recruiting candidates across multiple professional departments.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
* Strong interviewing and candidate evaluation abilities.
* Familiarity with applicant tracking systems and recruiting platforms.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple recruiting priorities.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
* Professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment when handling candidate information.

Compensation

**Commission-based W-2 compensation.**

Compensation will be determined through a written commission agreement outlining the applicable commission structure, earning conditions, and payment terms.

All compensation will be administered in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local employment and wage laws, including any required minimum-wage and overtime payments.

Reporting Structure

The Talent Acquisition Manager will report directly to the Owner/CEO of BGW Creative Marketing LLC.

The Owner/CEO retains final approval over all hiring decisions.

Primary Objective

Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline to help BGW Creative Marketing recruit qualified professionals across its sales, marketing, advertising, operations, finance, administration, and human resources departments.

The ultimate goal is to help BGW establish a capable workforce and support the company's long-term growth and expansion.

Pay: $80,800.00 - $97,400.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

e347e76f03a484324df7.title: Commercial Electrical Foreman
e347e76f03a484324df7.description:
Job Summary

Responsible for managing electrical projects and other team members, reading and understanding electrical drawings, communicating with other colleagues and tradesmen, planning/preparing for upcoming work, documenting work progress and processes, and finalizing testing of all systems. Must be Familiar with all Electrical Codes and some NFPA 70E experience for Life safety and fire alarm scopes. Oversee work in progress and drive the work of our team to completion.

Essential Job Functions

· Reading and understanding drawings and specifications. Interpret other trade drawings such as architectural, structural, plumbing, and HVAC as needed for coordination.

· In depth knowledge of codes and standards governing the work.

· Identifying conflicts, finding collaborative solutions, and tracking changes for as-builts.

· Assigning work to other team members and confirming the work is completed correctly.

· Ordering materials, equipment, and requesting labor, tools, and fabrication equipment in advance of scheduled work on the project

· Scheduling and maintaining schedules for all subcontractors and vendors.

· Attend and contribute to all foreman/subcontractor meetings and provide all relevant look aheads and schedule information

· Work with superintendents and/or owners representatives to support the interest of the company and maintain relationships.

· Work in conjunction with project manager to ensure timelines are met, issues are identified and resolved quickly, changes are captured, and all tasks related to completing the project within the labor and material allotments.

· Receiving deliveries and communicating with shippers for schedules

· Reporting on project deficiencies to provide change orders or alternate solutions.

· Tracking manpower for specific tasks against available timelines and hours.

· Documenting work in progress and completed work for As-Builts and project closeout.

· Supporting equipment startup and commissioning requirements.

· Training apprentices and journeyman for tasks required to complete the work in conjunction with safety manager.

· Identifying key personnel and placing them in the best position to support project success

· Capable of instructing workers of all skill levels

· Knowledge of safe practices for the work and identifying safety hazards.

· Conduct and document weekly toolbox talks and execute any JSA’s or JHA’s.

Core Competencies

· **Adaptability & Accountability:** Adapts to changes in the work environment, manages competing demands, open to criticism and feedback, changes approach or method to best fit the situation, and takes responsibility for own actions.

· **Analytical Skills:** Synthesizes complex or diverse information, prioritizes projects, and determines best way of meeting deadlines and requirements.

· **Attendance & Punctuality:** Schedules time off in advance, begins working on time, keeps absences within guidelines, ensures work responsibilities are covered when absent, and arrives at meetings and appointments on time.

· **Communication:** Ability to communicate clearly and effectively in English and take direction from supervisors. Expresses ideas and thoughts both verbally and in written form, exhibits good listening skills and comprehension, responds well to questions, and writes clearly and informatively. Assign tasks clearly and effectively.

· **Decision Making:** Making sound judgements and decisions based on available information.

· **Delegation and Empowerment:** Trusting team members and providing opportunities to grow and take ownership. Identifying key personnel and putting them in the best position for success.

· **Independence of Action:** Sets goals and determines how to accomplish defined results with some guidelines. Follows precedents and procedures. Seeks assistance when confronted with difficult and/or unpredictable situations.

· **Judgment:** Displays willingness to make decisions timely, exhibits sound and accurate judgment, supports and explains reasoning for decisions, includes appropriate people in decision-making process, and takes responsibility for communication including what is heard.

· **Leadership:** Inspiring and directing diverse crews towards successful goals.

· **Organization:** Maintains clean, functional workspace, continuous workflow to meet daily/weekly/monthly deadlines.

· **Performance Management:** Setting clear expectations, providing regular feedback, and addressing performance-related issues. Supervising temporary employees and knowing when it’s time to replace them.

· **Strategic Thinking and Planning:** Understands, implements, and creates the department’s goals and strategies. Strong problem-solving skills to identify and resolve issues and roadblocks effectively.

· **Safety:** Identify, assess, and mitigate site hazards. Enforce safety standards and regulations. Promote safe working practices and culture.

· **Teamwork / Morale:** Treats others with professionalism, gives and welcomes feedback, inspires the trust of others, displays a solution-driven mindset, offers assistance and support to co-workers consistent with this role, works cooperatively and collaboratively in group situations. Engages consistently in professional behavior.

· **Time Management:** Organization, prioritization, scheduling, completing, and tracking tasks effectively.

Other Duties

· Attend staff, departmental, and other required meetings and trainings.

· Travel to client or prospect locations, conferences, or other professional development and networking events.

· Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications, Experience, and Education

· 5-15 years’ experience in Commercial and industrial electrical projects

· 10 Hour OSHA Certified; 30 Hour OSHA Certified; First Aid; CPR. In addition, you will be required to attend courses in managing field personnel, coordination with other trades, managing personalities, and additional courses related to foreman activities.

· Be familiar with foreman procedure and capable of executing its requirements.

· Capable of reading single lines, panel, and fixture schedules.

· Excellent communication skills

· Knowledge of Fire Alarm systems and installations

· Knowledge of lighting control systems and installations

· Capable of working on voltages 0-600V AC and current ratings up to 6000AMP’s

· Valid Driver’s license

· Capable of working in a high reach/ scissor lift.

· Understanding of electrical theory and principles

· Understanding of the national electrical code and grounding requirements for electrical systems.

Pay: $45.00 - $55.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 – 45.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

Position Overview

We are seeking motivated individuals interested in financial services, client relationships, and professional development.

In this role, you will communicate with individuals and families about their financial protection needs, provide information about applicable insurance products, and help connect clients with appropriately licensed professionals when additional expertise is needed.

Candidates with backgrounds in sales, customer service, relationship management, business development, or financial services are encouraged to apply. Previous industry experience may be helpful but is not required, subject to applicable licensing and training requirements.

* Communicate professionally and follow up with clients as appropriate.
* Participate in product education, training, and professional development.
* Use approved technology and resources to support client communication and business activities.

Qualifications

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Professionalism, integrity, and a client-focused approach.

Training and Development

Pay: $65,000.00 - $87,000.00 per year

Benefits:

0a02bcf74d71bafe5290.title: Construction Project Manager
0a02bcf74d71bafe5290.description:
**Job Location:** Remote, but must be based in Pacific or Mountain Standard Time Zones within close proximity to a major airport  
**Travel:** Approximately 50% to active job sites across the Livewell portfolio

**Summary / Objective:**  
The Construction Project Manager is responsible for overseeing the development and construction of Livewell Animal Hospital facilities from inception to completion. This role works exclusively on building out new and existing Livewell locations, managing project timelines, budgets, and resources to ensure successful delivery of high-quality facilities. The Construction Project Manager will coordinate with architects, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure that all Livewell projects are completed on time, within scope, and in compliance with relevant regulations and standards.

**Role Competencies:**

*Collaboration*

* Acts on individual responsibilities, objectives, and performance expectations in support of team goals
* Leveraging individual skills and expertise to support the team in problem solving, decision making, and continuous improvement
* Offers and seeks feedback on opportunities that will improve skills and efficiency for themselves and their teammates
* Demonstrates a sense of commitment and support to direct teammates and the larger Livewell team

*Communication*

* Demonstrates consistent, effective communication with internal and external clients, teammates and other departments, written and verbal
* Establishes rapport, builds and maintains effective working relationships
* Practices attentive and active listening
* Gives and receives feedback timely and appropriately

*Problem-Solving*

* Understands how the business of their department works
* Champions innovative ideas for continuous improvement
* Demonstrates the functional and technical knowledge needed for their role
* Makes decisions by using a combination of analysis, experience and judgment and an understanding of department and organizational impacts

*Continuous Improvement*

* Meets agreed upon individual and team goals and objectives
* Understands how the team's priorities align with company goals
* Provides key information about their unique responsibilities in support of the formulation of strategies, tactics and deadlines
* Continuously examines personal effectiveness and seeks to make improvements as needed

**Role Specific Tasks:**

* Oversee and direct construction projects exclusively for Livewell Animal Hospital facilities, from conception to completion, for numerous projects of varying sizes across the Livewell portfolio
* Drive adherence to and continuous execution of established project management processes across internal teams
* Coordinate communication and execution with all internal teams (operations, marketing, accounting, etc.)
* Review the project in-depth to schedule deliverables and estimate costs
* Manage project budgets and timelines across up to 10 concurrent hospital build-outs; typical individual project budgets range from $1,000,000-2,000,000
* Coordinate and direct architects, general contractors and vendors
* Review work progress on daily basis
* Prepare internal reports pertaining to job status

**Required Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's Degree and minimum 5 years of experience in construction management
* Advanced knowledge of construction management processes, means and methods
* Expert knowledge of building products, construction details and relevant rules, regulations and quality standards
* Familiarity with construction management software packages (e.g., Procore, Smartsheet, Bluebeam, Monday.com, or Workday)
* Strong strategic and long-range planning ability
* Leadership management skills
* Excellent attention to detail
* Excellent time and project management skills
* BS degree in construction management, architecture, engineering or related field a plus

**The Mission Pet Health Way – Our Core Values:**

We deliver on our mission by executing our WAG values and exemplifying them in everything we do.

* **WORK TOGETHER** – We are part of something greater. We are a community; we work as a team; we are better together.
* **AMAZE** – We create #AMAZING moments. Exceed expectations; deliver personalized care; have a "YES" mentality.
* **GROW** – We are always seeking ways to improve. Grow our hospitals; serve more pets; enhance staff capabilities.

**Physical Demands:**  
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a teammate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The teammate is occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 20 pounds without assistance. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

**Other Duties:**  
Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the teammate for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

80d7193a6abf1bb693cd.description:
CLIENT SUCCESS MANAGER – US INSURANCE (P&C)WHO WE ARE

**Paktolus – Leaders of the Digital Evolution**

Paktolus is a trusted partner to our clients for transformative, end-to-end software and application development solutions. Our mission is to deliver a tangible boost in productivity, profitability, and shareholder value for clients across the globe, whether they are a capitalized start-up or a Fortune 500 company.

With a team of 350+ experts and a footprint spanning North America, Europe, Asia, and Latin America, Paktolus offers an unparalleled advantage by seamlessly combining the strengths of local, nearshore, and international talent pools to bring projects to life.

JOB SUMMARY

We are seeking an experienced **Client Success Manager with strong expertise in the US Insurance domain, particularly Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance and Underwriting.**

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in **Product Management and Technical Business Analysis**, along with hands-on experience in custom software/application development.

The candidate will be responsible for understanding client business needs, gathering and analyzing requirements, designing workflows, creating wireframes/mockups, and translating business requirements into functional and technical specifications.

This role requires someone who can bridge the gap between clients, business stakeholders, product teams, and technical teams to drive successful product development and implementation.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, customers, and internal teams.
* Take ownership of end-to-end product development and successful delivery of assigned initiatives.
* Lead ERP/CRM and custom application development initiatives with minimal supervision.
* Gather, analyze, and document detailed business and functional requirements.
* Conduct stakeholder discussions, brainstorming sessions, and requirement-gathering workshops.
* Create detailed use cases, user stories, functional specifications, and process documentation.
* Design and develop wireframes, mockups, and workflow diagrams to translate business requirements into application functionality.
* Demonstrate strong Product Management capabilities rather than limiting responsibilities to project coordination and tracking.
* Work closely with UI/UX, development, and QA teams to ensure requirements are clearly understood and implemented.
* Lead Scrum planning, backlog prioritization, sprint reviews, and Agile ceremonies.
* Provide functional guidance to technical teams throughout the SDLC.
* Understand and validate business workflows related to US P&C insurance, including underwriting processes.
* Ensure the delivered product functionality meets customer expectations and business requirements.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), validate test scenarios, and facilitate client feedback.
* Conduct product demonstrations and walkthroughs of newly developed features and applications.
* Identify potential project/product risks and recommend mitigation strategies.
* Monitor project progress, communicate updates to management, and obtain necessary approvals for key decisions.
* Drive continuous improvement in product functionality based on customer feedback and business requirements.

KEY SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS (MUST HAVE)

* 5+ years of experience in end-to-end software/application development, technical business analysis, or product management.
* Strong understanding of the **US Insurance market, particularly Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance**.
* Practical knowledge of **P&C insurance underwriting processes, workflows, and business operations**.
* Proven experience in Product Management, preferably involving custom software/application development.
* Hands-on experience in requirement gathering, workflow designing, wireframing, and creating application mockups.
* Ability to translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, and technical requirements.
* Experience working closely with UI/UX designers, developers, QA teams, and business stakeholders.
* Strong knowledge of SDLC, Agile (Scrum), and Waterfall methodologies.
* Experience with Scrum planning, product backlog management, and prioritization.
* Knowledge and experience using Postman for API testing and validation.
* Understanding of REST, SOAP, XML, Swagger, and system integration concepts.
* Strong understanding of client-server architecture, relational databases, cloud-based, and web-based applications.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and system integration solutions.
* Must have working knowledge of Business Intelligence concepts, including reporting, querying, dashboards, OLAP, spreadsheets, and data mining.
* Basic understanding of ERP and CRM system implementation.
* Strong understanding of testing methodologies, UAT, and quality assurance processes.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to independently manage priorities, identify risks, solve problems, and meet deadlines.
* Excellent documentation and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate ideas through PowerPoint, Word, wireframes, and workflow diagrams.

ADD-ON SKILLS

* Experience in the US P&C Insurance industry, particularly underwriting.
* Knowledge of policy administration, claims management, rating, and insurance lifecycle processes.
* Understanding of insurance technology platforms and custom insurance application development.
* Knowledge of Information Security and Identity Management.
* Experience with BI tools and data-driven product enhancements.
* Exposure to UI/UX design tools and prototyping platforms.

Pay: $120,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience communicating directly with clients, customers, or stakeholders?
* Whats your current salary (USD) per year
* What are your salary expectations (USD) per year
* Do you have experience in US Insurance?
* “Do you have experience working in the P&C insurance domain?

**About the Role**

Location: United States — fully remote (any U.S. state).

Xenios seeks a practical finance leader to turn operating activity into reliable decisions. This fractional role works with the founder and operations team on cash visibility, operating budgets, financial models and investor preparation.

**Responsibilities**

You will maintain a rolling 13-week cash forecast, reconcile forecast assumptions with the accounting records, document monthly reporting, and model revenue, contribution margin, acquisition costs and staffing scenarios. You will help organize financial due-diligence materials, reconcile capitalization information with counsel, and explain the implications of proposed spending and compensation commitments.

First Deliverables:

Early priorities are a dependable cash forecast, a clear budget owner for each expense category, a monthly reporting package and an assumptions register that distinguishes actual results from targets. Bookkeeping, tax filings and securities legal work require appropriately scoped specialists; this role coordinates with them rather than claiming to cover every function within 20 hours.

**Qualifications**

We seek experience managing finance for an early-stage business, strong spreadsheet and accounting fluency, careful handling of confidential records, and the ability to challenge unsupported forecasts respectfully. Healthcare, subscription or marketplace experience is useful; a CPA or comparable qualification is preferred where relevant.

This role does not carry a fundraising success fee.

**Schedule and Compensation**

20 hours/month; $100–$150/hour ($2,000–$3,000/month).

**How to Apply**

Apply through this Indeed job listing with your resume and a sanitized example of a cash forecast or reporting package.

**Explore Xenios**

* Company website: https://xeniostechnology.com
* LinkedIn company page: https://www.linkedin.com/company/officialxenios
* Instagram: Xenios Health: https://www.instagram.com/xenioshealth/
* Instagram: Official Xenios: https://www.instagram.com/officialxenios/
* X: Xenios Health: https://x.com/xenioshealth

Base Pay: $100.00 - $150.00 per hour

* Please answer Yes or No. Have you built and maintained a rolling cash-flow forecast?
* Please answer Yes or No. Have you supported an early-stage or cash-constrained company?
* Please answer Yes or No. Can you reconcile a management model with accounting records?
* Please answer Yes or No. Have you modeled gross margin, contribution margin and cash timing separately?
* Please answer Yes or No. Have you supported investor financial due diligence?

**Company Overview:**  
Pediatric Associates of Dayton is dedicated to providing high-quality healthcare for infants, children, and adolescents in the Dayton area with office locations in Beavercreek, Englewood, and Centerville.
  
  
Receptionist - FLOAT
  
  
**Company Overview:**  
Pediatric Associates of Dayton is dedicated to providing high-quality healthcare for infants, children, and adolescents in the Dayton area with office locations in Beavercreek, Englewood, and Centerville.
  
  
**Job Summary:**  
The Receptionist position for Pediatric Associates of Dayton is responsible for providing efficient office support and excellent customer service. The Receptionist is the first point of contact for patients and visitors, greeting them with warmth and professionalism, determining their needs, and directing them accordingly.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Greet and assist patients in a welcoming and professional manner.
* NEW PATIENT REGISTRATION

* Insurance information
* Demographics

5bd8a7f864291c1d0657.description:
**About the Role:**
===================

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

12

**The Team:**

Global Network Services is a high-impact, globally distributed engineering team responsible for designing, securing, and automating S&P Global's cloud and hybrid network infrastructure. The Cloud Network Engineering team operates at the forefront of GCP adoption, network automation, and security platform modernization — combining hands-on engineering rigor with infrastructure-as-code discipline to deliver a cloud network estate that is faster to provision, safer to operate, and built to scale. You will work both autonomously and collaboratively, with direct influence over the standards and architecture that underpin business-critical connectivity across the enterprise.

  

**The Impact:**

  

You will shape how S&P Global builds and secures its Google Cloud network. Your designs will determine the scalability, segmentation and performance of GCP connectivity for business-critical applications, and the automation you write will become the standard way those networks are provisioned. Through the Palo Alto egress and inspection platform, you will directly strengthen our security posture, reducing data-exfiltration risk and replacing inconsistent legacy controls with centrally governed, observable policy. The result is a cloud network that is faster to deliver, cheaper to operate and materially harder to misconfigure.

  

**Job Responsibilities**

  

* **Own the enterprise GCP network architecture** — design, deploy and manage GCP network services including VPCs/Shared VPC, Cloud Interconnect, Cloud Router, Cloud NAT, Cloud DNS, Cloud Load Balancing and Private Service Connect across multi-project, multi-folder environments, including hierarchical firewall policies, VPC Service Controls and hybrid connectivity to on-premises and other cloud providers via BGP and routing policy.

* **Build and maintain Terraform modules** for GCP and multi-cloud network provisioning; develop Python and Ansible automation to eliminate manual network provisioning, reduce configuration drift, and materially shorten delivery timelines across the network estate.

* **Establish and operate CI/CD pipelines for network change delivery** — including automated validation, policy-as-code checks, pre-deployment testing, and controlled rollback — setting version-controlled, peer-reviewed, modular engineering standards across shared automation repositories.

* **Design, deploy and operate Palo Alto Networks VM-Series firewalls at enterprise scale** — including autoscaling deployments, centralized policy management via Panorama and Strata Cloud Manager (SCM), full security policy configuration (App-ID, URL filtering, anti-spyware, decryption), and integration with SIEM and observability tooling; contribute to the migration of legacy firewall platforms onto the Palo Alto estate.

* **Drive network segmentation and security posture** across cloud, data center, and hybrid infrastructure — partnering with Security, InfoSec, application, and infrastructure teams to ensure designs meet enterprise governance, audit, and compliance requirements; support egress proxy platform onboarding and phased policy enforcement.

* **Serve as the senior technical authority for GCP networking** across engineering and operations — troubleshooting complex network failures across hybrid environments, participating in on-call rotation, delivering approved changes within maintenance windows, and identifying continuous improvement opportunities to reduce risk, optimise capacity, and elevate engineering standards.
  

**What We’re Looking For:**

**Basic Required Qualifications:**

  

* Proven experience (10+ years) in enterprise networking, including significant hands-on experience in large-scale cloud environments.

* Hands-on experience designing, deploying and operating Palo Alto Networks firewalls, including VM-Series in cloud and centralized management via Panorama.

* Deep, hands-on GCP networking experience, including VPC and Shared VPC design, Cloud Interconnect, Cloud Router, Cloud NAT, Cloud DNS, Cloud Load Balancing and Private Service Connect.

* Demonstrable production experience with network automation and infrastructure-as-code, including Terraform and Python, with version control using Git.

* Excellent knowledge of networking standards, protocols and technologies, including BGP, OSPF, routing policy, switching, VPNs, DNS and load balancing.

* Working knowledge of AWS and Azure networking, including Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, VPC and security groups, ExpressRoute and Virtual WAN.

* Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills to diagnose and resolve complex network issues across cloud and hybrid environments.

* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

* Team player who enjoys a mix of autonomy and collaboration-based delivery.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities, commitments and projects.
* Bachelor's degree or advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience demonstrating technical leadership capabilities
  

**Additional Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Google Professional Cloud Network Engineer certification. Palo Alto Networks PCNSE certification.

* HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Advanced Networking Specialty or Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate certification.

* Experience with network segmentation and micro-segmentation technologies such as Akamai Guardicore or Illumio.

* Familiarity with Cloud Native NaaS (Network as a Service) platforms such as Alkira, Prosimo or Aviatrix.

* Understanding of AI and its practical application to cloud networking, such as using LLM-based assistants and AI-assisted tooling for Terraform and policy generation, configuration review, log and flow analysis, root-cause troubleshooting and documentation.

* Experience with Ansible, and with automated network testing using tools such as Batfish or pyATS.

* Exposure to network observability and AIOps platforms such as Selector AI or ThousandEyes.

Experience working in a regulated financial services environment with formal change, audit and evidence requirements.  

  

**Compensation/Benefits Information:** (This section is only applicable to US candidates)

  

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $129,000 to $175,000. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications.

  

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan.

This role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please click here .

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. COA Youth & Family Centers seeks a skilled, creative, and detail-oriented Wix Website Specialist to provide ongoing maintenance, updates, and technical support for the organization’s website. This is an independent contractor engagement requiring approximately 1–2 hours per week at a rate of $100 per hour.

The Wix Specialist will collaborate with designated COA staff to ensure the website remains accurate, engaging, accessible, user-friendly, and reflective of COA’s mission, programs, and community impact.

The ideal contractor is highly proficient in the Wix platform, responsive to requests, proactive in identifying opportunities for improvement, and capable of working independently while managing time efficiently and meeting agreed-upon deadlines.

**Main Responsibilities**

* **Website Maintenance:** Maintain and update COA’s Wix website, ensuring content, images, links, forms, and other website elements remain accurate, current, and functional.
* **Content Management:** Add, edit, and publish website content, including program descriptions, announcements, events, news, and other organizational information as requested.
* **Website Design and User Experience:** Implement minor design and layout improvements to enhance visual appeal, navigation, mobile responsiveness, and consistency with COA’s branding.
* **Technical Support:** Troubleshoot and resolve website issues, including broken links, formatting inconsistencies, and functionality concerns.
* **Search Engine Optimization (SEO):** Apply basic SEO best practices to improve website visibility and help community members, prospective participants, and supporters find COA online.
* **Website Accessibility:** Support accessibility best practices to ensure website content is usable by individuals with varying abilities and across multiple devices.
* **Website Functionality:** Create, update, and maintain online forms, donation links, registration links, buttons, and other interactive website features.
* **Website Performance:** Periodically review website functionality, performance, and analytics, recommending practical improvements when appropriate.
* **Collaboration and Communication:** Coordinate with designated COA staff to prioritize requests, provide timely updates, and complete projects within agreed-upon timelines.
* **Security and Platform Updates:** Monitor relevant Wix platform updates and recommend improvements to maintain website functionality, reliability, and security.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Proactively identify and recommend cost-effective enhancements that strengthen COA’s online presence and support its mission.
* **Additional Services:** Perform other website-related services as mutually agreed upon within the contracted scope of work.

**Qualifications**

* Must have all technology/equipment required to be successful.
* Demonstrated proficiency and experience with the Wix website platform required.
* Must reside in the State of Wisconsin. (Southeast Wisconsin, preferred.)
* Experience with website design, content management, and basic SEO practices preferred.
* Familiarity with website accessibility and mobile-responsive design preferred.
* Ability to independently manage assignments and meet agreed-upon deadlines.
* Experience supporting nonprofit organizations is a plus.

**Professional Competencies**

* Commitment to COA’s mission and core values.
* Philosophical compatibility with COA’s mission and youth and family development approach.
* Strong creativity, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities.
* Effective interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and take initiative.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Responsiveness, reliability, and commitment to delivering quality work.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion when accessing organizational information and website systems.

**Contractor Expectations**

The Wix Specialist will coordinate with a designated COA representative to establish priorities, timelines, and expected deliverables.

The contractor is expected to communicate promptly regarding requests, anticipated completion dates, and any issues affecting website functionality.

All work exceeding the anticipated 1–2 hours per week, or requiring additional expenses, must receive advance approval from COA’s designated representative.

The contractor will provide an itemized invoice documenting services performed and hours worked in accordance with the terms of the independent contractor agreement.

**Working Conditions**

Services will be performed primarily remotely, with onsite workspace available during regular business hours when mutually arranged.

The work generally involves prolonged computer use and may occasionally require availability during evenings or weekends, subject to mutual agreement.

Reasonable accommodations may be considered to support individuals with disabilities in performing the contracted services.

**Independent Contractor Relationship**

This position is structured as an independent contractor engagement and does not constitute an offer of employment. The contractor will provide services under a separate written independent contractor agreement defining the scope of work, compensation, invoicing procedures, confidentiality obligations, and other applicable terms.

The contractor will retain responsibility for determining the manner and means of performing the agreed-upon services, consistent with project requirements, deadlines, and applicable organizational security standards.

Any changes to the scope of services will be mutually agreed upon by the contractor and COA Youth & Family Centers.

**Scope of Services Disclaimer**

This description outlines the general nature and anticipated scope of the contracted services. It is not intended to be an exhaustive statement of responsibilities or requirements. Additional or modified services may be incorporated through mutual agreement between COA Youth & Family Centers and the contractor.
