48670c40720c0756ebb3.title: Client Support Specialist
48670c40720c0756ebb3.description:
**Client Support Specialist**
=============================

**Full-Time | Customer Service | Spectrum Healthcare Group** 
 
**Position Type:** Full-Time 
 
**Pay:** Starting at $19.00 an hour Based on experience
=======================================================================================================================================================

**Position Overview**
---------------------

Spectrum Healthcare Group is seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused Client Support Specialist to provide exceptional service to patients and support daily customer service operations.

This blended role combines patient communication, appointment scheduling, insurance verification, eligibility screening, and administrative support. The Client Support Specialist responds to patient inquiries by phone, chat, and email, verifies insurance benefits, assists with financial and coverage questions, and helps eligible clients navigate the AHCCCS application process.

The ideal candidate is organized, professional, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and passionate about helping people access healthcare services.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Customer Service & Communication**

* Respond to incoming calls, chats, and emails in a timely, professional, and courteous manner.
* Provide accurate information to patients, staff, insurance companies, and outside agencies.
* Manage high call volumes while maintaining excellent customer service.
* Direct calls, take messages, and route inquiries to the appropriate departments.
* Explain Spectrum Healthcare Group policies and procedures, including confidentiality requirements.
* Communicate calmly, clearly, and respectfully with individuals from diverse backgrounds.
* Follow established crisis response and telephone procedures when needed.

### **Appointment Scheduling & Administrative Support**

* Schedule, reschedule, and update patient appointments using established scheduling procedures.
* Perform accurate data entry and maintain complete, up-to-date patient records.
* Complete non-clinical intake paperwork and prepare reports as needed.
* Operate multi-line telephone systems, computers, electronic fax programs, email, and other office applications.
* Organize and prioritize tasks while maintaining accuracy and efficiency.
* Follow centralized scheduling policies and procedures.

### **Insurance Verification & Benefits Support**

* Verify patient insurance coverage for required services and procedures.
* Contact insurance companies to confirm eligibility, benefits, and coverage details.
* Enter and update patient insurance and benefit information accurately in the electronic medical record (EMR) system.
* Explain insurance coverage, applicable copayments, and available payment options to patients.
* Assist with payment receipt processes and financial information updates.
* Communicate professionally with insurance representatives, managed care organizations, and other relevant parties.
* Prepare eligibility reports and follow established verification procedures.

### **Eligibility Screening & Financial Assistance**

* Conduct client eligibility interviews and screenings.
* Complete AHCCCS applications and monitor application processing.
* Follow up on incomplete or unprocessed AHCCCS applications to help ensure timely resolution.
* Perform data entry related to client eligibility and financial updates.
* Make appropriate referrals to the Department of Economic Security (DES), Supplemental Security Income (SSI), and Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI).
* Help patients understand coverage requirements and available financial options.

### **Compliance & Professional Standards**

* Maintain compliance with agency policies, confidentiality requirements, and safety protocols.
* Follow applicable federal and state laws, accreditation requirements, and organizational compliance standards.
* Protect confidential patient information and follow established privacy procedures.
* Provide culturally responsive service that respects individual backgrounds and needs.
* Maintain professional, ethical, and collaborative relationships with patients, coworkers, insurance representatives, and community partners.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Required Education & Experience**
-----------------------------------

* High school diploma or GED required.
* Two years of experience working with clients in a medical and/or behavioral health setting preferred.
* Two years of data entry experience preferred.
* Two years of insurance experience, including work with contracted and managed care clients, preferred.
* Proficiency with multi-line telephone systems and standard office equipment required.
* Experience using electronic fax systems, email, and office applications required.
* Previous remote work experience preferred.
* Reliable high-speed internet service required.

**Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**
------------------------------------------

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

* Strong customer service and professional telephone etiquette.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Accurate and efficient typing, data entry, and document preparation skills.
* Basic math skills and the ability to operate a 10-key efficiently.
* Ability to manage high call volumes and multitask in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to prioritize tasks while maintaining accuracy and productivity.
* Knowledge of general medical terminology.
* Ability to communicate professionally with insurance companies and verify client eligibility accurately.
* Familiarity with insurance benefits, copayments, eligibility requirements, and payment processes.
* Ability to use scheduling systems to book, update, and reschedule appointments.
* Knowledge of standard office equipment, computers, electronic fax programs, and communication systems.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and follow established privacy policies.
* Knowledge of internal departments, customer service procedures, and organizational resources.
* Ability to respond calmly and appropriately to sensitive situations and follow established crisis telephone procedures.
* Flexibility, professionalism, sound judgment, and a commitment to providing quality service.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

A successful Client Support Specialist provides a positive patient experience while ensuring that appointments, insurance information, eligibility records, and administrative documentation are accurate and up to date. This role helps patients navigate coverage and financial questions while supporting efficient customer service operations across Spectrum Healthcare Group.

**Join Spectrum Healthcare Group**
----------------------------------

If you enjoy helping people, solving problems, staying organized, and supporting access to healthcare, we encourage you to apply for the Client Support Specialist position.

Join a team committed to professional service, patient support, and helping individuals connect with the care and resources they need.  
#Spectrum

fc5ccf2e199b3e50e28f.title: Patient Engagement Specialist
fc5ccf2e199b3e50e28f.description:
**About beBright**

beBright is a doctor-founded, doctor-led organization dedicated to creating bright smiles and lifelong impact for children and families. Through exceptional providers, integrated pediatric dentistry and orthodontic care, and strong support systems, beBright delivers superior patient experiences and clinical outcomes. Focused exclusively on pediatric dentistry and orthodontics, beBright empowers local practices with clinical autonomy while providing comprehensive administrative and operational support. Since its founding, beBright has been a trusted partner to providers and practices and continues to grow with purpose. At beBright, every patient, provider, and team member’s smile is a priority.

**Position Summary**

The Patient Engagement Specialist is responsible for handling inbound and outbound patient communications across beBright's network of pediatric dental and orthodontic practices. This role focuses on new patient conversion, existing patient scheduling, recovery of unbooked and missed calls, and accurate documentation within our phone, practice management, and scheduling systems. Team members are expected to meet or exceed defined performance standards for answer rate, call quality, booking conversion, and follow-up completion. **This is a remote position with working hours of 8am-5pm CST Monday-Friday, with a one hour lunch break from 12pm-1pm each day.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary inbound point of contact for patients, answering calls promptly and professionally using approved scripting and brand-specific greetings.
* Engage with patients via brand-approved platforms.
* Schedule appointments in accordance with individual practice guidelines, provider preferences, and access rules.
* Convert inbound inquiries into appointments following location-specific protocols.
* Educate patients on services, providers, locations, and next steps (non-clinical).
* Address basic insurance and payment questions per practice policy.
* Maintain schedule integrity through rescheduling and open-time optimization.
* Accurately document interactions in PMS/CRM systems.
* Meet expectations for call handling, quality, responsiveness, and productivity.
* Escalate non-standard requests or issues to the appropriate practice team.
* Perform additional duties in support of approved brands, as assigned by management.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate's degree or higher preferred.
* Minimum one (1) year of experience in a call center or dental front office role.
* Demonstrated ability to handle a high volume of inbound and outbound calls (80+ interactions per day) while maintaining quality.
* Proficient computer skills, including the ability to learn and navigate multiple software platforms simultaneously.
* Clear, professional verbal and written communication skills.
* Comfortable working across multiple brands, time zones, and practice workflows.
* Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, HIPAA-appropriate work environment if remote.

**Preferred**

* Experience in pediatric dental, orthodontic, or general dentistry front office operations.
* Prior use of dental practice management systems.
* Prior use of VoIP platforms.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) strongly preferred.
* Experience with insurance verification and benefits review.

**Performance Expectations**

Team member performance is reviewed monthly against the following standards. Specific numeric targets will be set during onboarding and updated as network baselines are established.

* **Answer Rate:** 95%
* **Speed to Answer:** 10 second average
* **New Patient Booking Conversion:** Meet or exceed individual target based on role and brand mix
* **Call Quality Score:** Maintain 85%+ on quality reviews
* **Patient Engagement:** 100% of assigned outreach communications documented within defined SLA

**Work Environment & Physical Requirements**

* Primarily remote, seated role with extended periods of computer and headset use.
* Must adhere to beBright’s remote work policy.
* Must maintain a private, quiet, HIPAA-compliant workspace during all scheduled hours.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Additional Information About the Role**  
  
  

BJC Health is looking for a PRN (as needed) Remote Call Center Specialist!

* + Handles large volume of incoming customer inquiries; utilizes customer service skills and tools to accurately identify, research and respond to the customers' inquiry.
  + Supports hospital marketing efforts through referrals to physicians, services and class/event registration.
  + Maintains accountability for accurate data entry and maintains patient privacy and security as outlined by HIPAA.
  + Communicates in a professional, positive and respectful manner; provides a high level of customer service when handling telephone calls and responding to e-mails.
  + PRN opportunity, candidates should have the ability to work between the days of Monday-Friday, 8a-6p.

  
**Overview**  
  
  

**BJC HealthCare** is one of the largest nonprofit health care organizations in the United States, delivering services to residents primarily in the greater St. Louis, southern Illinois and southeast Missouri regions. With net revenues of $6.3 billion and more than 30,000 employees, BJC serves patients and their families in urban, suburban and rural communities through its 14 hospitals and multiple community health locations. Services include inpatient and outpatient care, primary care, community health and wellness, workplace health, home health, community mental health, rehabilitation, long-term care and hospice.

  

BJC is the largest provider of charity care, unreimbursed care and community benefits in the state of Missouri. BJC and its hospitals and health service organizations provide $785.9 million annually in community benefit. That includes $410.6 million in charity care and other financial assistance to patients to ensure medical care regardless of their ability to pay. In addition, BJC provides additional community benefits through commitments to research, emergency preparedness, regional health care safety net services, health literacy, community outreach and community health programs and regional economic development.

  

BJC’s patients have access to the latest advances in medical science and technology through a formal affiliation between Barnes-Jewish Hospital and St. Louis Children’s Hospital with the renowned Washington University School of Medicine, which consistently ranks among the top medical schools in the country.

  

Expands BJC HealthCare's growth from hospitals located in the 500 mile catchment area, through direction of the BJC HealthCare corporate service line marketing initiatives. This includes the BJC Call Center, the WUSM Department of Pediatrics line, the SLCH Nurse Triage Answer Line, After Hours Service and Physician Exchange. Through telephone and internet vehicles, expands consumer and physician access to BJC¿s hospitals and corporate service lines. Includes 24/7 operation of multidisciplinary call centers that handle over 450,000 physician and consumer calls a year. Includes SLCH Children's Direct Physician Accessl Line/Transfer Center, which, in partnership with WUSM provides services including transfers, direct admits Transport Team dispatch, phone consults, referrals to/appointment for WUSM clinics, patient information, etc. generating incremental volume and margin to the system, enhanced communication with physicians and clients and high physician/patient satisfaction. Also delivers market research and customer relationship management activities.

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
  

**Role Purpose**

The Experience Center connects our consumers and patients to the care they need while increasing access to our health system and reducing friction. The Associate Advisor, Experience Center role is responsible for managing a high volume of inbound and outbound contacts for BJC Medical Group, Washington University, and private providers affiliated with BJC Health System. This position serves as the initial point of contact for patients seeking to establish care within our health system. This position also facilitates our patients' healthcare needs by fielding a variety of inquiries including event registration, patient navigation, and support for our MyChart patient portal.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Manage a high volume of customer contacts including: incoming and outbound calls , emails, chat, etc, from patients for a variety of reasons, to include tier one calls (single service line or domain)
* Manage inquiries/contacts within established performance and customer service standards; achieves targeted abandoned call rate, average speed of answer, average response time and average transaction time; provides excellent and consistent customer service for a variety of call types; communicates in a professional, positive and respectful manner with patients, providers, BJC staff and external organizations.
* Consistently exceeds individual service level standards including: contacts managed, ASA, Transaction Time, RONA, QI Scores, etc.
* Responsible for appropriate and accurate data entry, coding and documentation of all interactions.

**Minimum Requirements**

**Education**

* High School Diploma or GED

**Experience**

* No Experience

**Supervisor Experience**

* No Experience

**Preferred Requirements**

**Experience**

* <2 years

  
**Benefits and Legal Statement**  
  
  

**BJC Total Rewards**

At BJC we’re committed to providing you and your family with benefits and resources to help you manage your physical, emotional, social and financial well-being.

* Comprehensive medical, dental, vison, life insurance, and legal services available first day of the month after hire date
* Disability insurance\* paid for by BJC
* Annual 4% BJC Automatic Retirement Contribution
* 401(k) plan with BJC match
* Tuition Assistance available on first day

* Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
* Paid Time Off benefit combines vacation, sick days, holidays and personal time
* Adoption assistance

fe32a1f9616efc381367.title: Assistant Principal of Operations - 2027/2028 School Year
fe32a1f9616efc381367.description:
**About Mastery:**

Founded in 2001, Mastery Schools is a public charter network of 23 K-12 schools in Philadelphia and Camden, serving more than 14,000 students.

At Mastery, we’re on a mission to provide all students with the academic and personal skills they need to succeed after graduation and pursue their dreams. Student achievement is not just a goal for our organization; it's the reason we exist, and every member of our team is dedicated to securing student success. We are also committed to pursuing equity, actively disrupting systemic racism, and addressing the disparities that limit our students' choices.

Our culture is built on respect, service, and the belief that the success of our students, their families, and the communities we serve will help us achieve our mission. We foster a positive, open, and inclusive environment where honesty, humor, and continuous improvement are celebrated.

***Join us in creating a model urban school district that serves all students with excellence. Together, we can make a lasting impact.***

**The Opportunity:**

The Assistant Principal of Operations ensures the efficient and compliant functioning of all non-academic school operations. This role oversees assessments, procurement, payroll, enrollment, communication, budgets, logistics, compliance, safety, facilities, and transportation. Working closely with school leadership, this position fosters a structured and supportive environment that enhances the educational experience for students and staff.

### **Duties and Responsibilities:**

* ***Assessments and Testing:***
* Oversee standardized and school-based assessments, ensuring smooth administration and compliance.
* Analyze and report assessment data to support school leadership and network reporting.

* ***Procurement and Budget:***
* Manage purchasing processes and expense tracking to ensure responsible budgeting.
* Collaborate with finance teams to maintain budget integrity and align spending with school goals.

* ***Payroll Administration:***
* Ensure accurate and timely payroll processing in coordination with the finance and HR teams.
* Address payroll inquiries and resolve discrepancies.

* ***Enrollment and Admissions:***
* Support the enrollment processes from initial inquiries to admissions.
* Maintain accurate student enrollment records and monitor enrollment trends.
* Communicate effectively with prospective and current families regarding enrollment.

* ***School Communications:***
* Collaborate with the communications team to maintain and update school websites, newsletters, and other platforms.
* Maintain school-based parent communication system.

* ***Administrative Assistant Management:***
* Supervise school administrative assistants, ensuring high level of organization, customer service, and support for school teams, primarily school operations.
* Oversee daily administrative tasks and maintain an efficient office environment.

* ***Logistics and Events Planning:***
* Plan and coordinate school events, meetings, and logistics, including transportation and materials.

* ***Compliance and Regulatory Adherence:***
* Ensure all operations comply with local, state, and federal regulations.
* Manage record-keeping, reporting, and inspections to ensure adherence to health, safety and operational guidelines.

* ***Safety and Facilities Management:***
* Oversee school safety protocols, emergency preparedness, and regular safety drills.
* Coordinate facility maintenance and improvements to ensure a clean, safe, and welcoming environment.

* ***Transportation Management:***
* Manage school transportation services, ensuring safe and efficient student transport.
* Collaborate with transportation providers and school district partners.

* ***Scheduling and Teacher Coverage:***
* Collaborate with school leaders and Network Support Team to design and maintain a schedule that meets curriculum requirements and optimizes student learning experiences.
* Update and adjust schedules as needed to accommodate changes in enrollment, staffing, and academic programs; Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of student schedules, teacher assignments and coverage needs.
* Organize and coordinate daily and long-term coverage for teachers and staff, including substitute teaching services, ensuring all classes have appropriate supervision.
* Communicate clearly with substitutes and support staff regarding expectations, responsibilities, and schedules.
* Track and analyze scheduling data to identify trends, optimize future schedules, and anticipate coverage needs.

### **Qualifications:**

* Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
* Effective problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to adapt and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work with a diverse range of stakeholders.
* Strong leadership and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Commitment to providing a safe and efficient school environment.
* Strong analytical skills to drive data-informed strategies.
* Proficiency in office management software and database systems.

### **Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, education management, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
* 3+ years of experience in school operations or a similar role within an educational institution that included compliance, safety regulations, and financial management.

### **Physical Requirements:**

* This role may involve standing for extended periods, moving throughout the school building, lifting school materials, observing classrooms, facilitating school operations, and participating in school events. Reasonable accommodations will be made as needed.

### **Salary and Bonus Information:**

* **This role is eligible for a $5,000 bonus as well as up to $5,000 for relocation expenses!**
* **New-to-Mastery Assistant Principals can expect a starting salary between $108,200 and $125,350, based on experience and education.**
* **The full salary range for this role is $108,200 to $137,025, with opportunities for growth as your career progresses. All offers are reviewed individually to ensure equity in compensation and to reflect relevant experience.**

**Mastery's Benefits Package:**

We offer a full benefits program and opportunities for professional growth. Some of our most popular benefits include our 403(b) retirement plan for PA employees (with a 5% match from Mastery for full-time employees), enrollment in the State of New Jersey Pension Plan for NJ employees, a robust Employee Assistance Program, mental health and counseling programs, an annual Professional Development Fund, and discounts and perks at a myriad of retailers, travel organizations, insurance providers, and so much more, as well as access to the Health Advocate Helpdesk to help you navigate various benefits-related topics. **Please go here to see all of our Benefits offerings****!**

**Annual Calendar:**

As you plan to make Mastery your new work home, please feel free to review our **calendar here****.** We like to think our calendar is a benefit of working here too!

**Why You Should Apply:**

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they can perform every job description task. We are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and that candidate may come from a less traditional background. Mastery may consider an equivalent combination of knowledge, skills, education, and experience to meet minimum qualifications. *If you are interested in applying, we encourage you to think broadly about your background and skill set for the role.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist Mastery's Talent Acquisition Team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

b1521432d7dd6f8c1ebf.title: Executive Assistant to Business Owner | Remote | Part-Time
b1521432d7dd6f8c1ebf.description:
**Please read the entire job description. Application instructions are at the bottom.**

Who We Are

We're a growing sales and corporate gifting business based in Reno, Nevada, serving thousands of customers nationwide.

We specialize in personalized corporate gifts, customer relationships, and live sales events across the country.

We're a small team with big goals, and we take pride in solving problems creatively, working efficiently, and providing exceptional customer experiences.

We're looking for someone who can help us continue growing while keeping everything running smoothly.

Who We're Looking For

**We're looking for a right-hand person, not just someone who checks boxes on a to-do list.**

We need an experienced, highly resourceful Executive Assistant who can handle a wide variety of responsibilities, think independently, and take ownership of projects from beginning to end.

One day you might be researching wholesale manufacturers. The next day you could be troubleshooting software, coordinating a marketing campaign, organizing travel, or helping resolve a customer issue.

You won't always know how to do everything we ask.

**That's okay. What matters is your ability to figure it out.**

We want someone who takes initiative, researches solutions, asks thoughtful questions, and follows through without needing constant supervision.

If you're naturally organized, tech-savvy, and genuinely enjoy solving problems, this could be a great opportunity.

What You'll Be Doing

This is a versatile position supporting the business owner across several areas:

* **Executive Support:** Manage calendars, appointments, reminders, travel arrangements, and administrative projects.
* **Research & Problem-Solving:** Research vendors, products, services, and business opportunities. Compare options and present recommendations.
* **Customer Relationships:** Respond to customer inquiries, maintain CRM records, coordinate orders, and manage follow-ups.
* **Marketing:** Assist with scheduling email and SMS campaigns, creating Canva designs, and coordinating social media content.
* **CRM & Technology:** Help manage HighLevel, troubleshoot software issues, maintain workflows, and learn new systems.
* **Project Management:** Coordinate with remote team members and vendors, track deadlines, and ensure projects are completed.
* **Event Coordination:** Research trade shows, communicate with organizers, and assist with travel and event logistics.
* **Process Improvement:** Identify opportunities to streamline operations, improve efficiency, and make the business run more smoothly.

The Ideal Candidate

We're not necessarily looking for the person with the most impressive resume. **We're looking for someone who gets things done.**

You should be:

* **Resourceful:** You enjoy figuring things out, even when you've never done something before.
* **Independent:** You can manage projects without constant instructions or reminders.
* **Organized:** You can juggle multiple priorities while keeping track of important details.
* **Detail-Oriented:** You double-check your work and take pride in accuracy.
* **Proactive:** You communicate updates, anticipate problems, and take initiative.
* **Accountable:** You take ownership of your responsibilities and follow through on commitments.
* **Tech-Savvy:** You're comfortable learning new software and troubleshooting unfamiliar systems.

We provide guidance and support, but we expect you to be comfortable researching solutions and working independently.

Requirements

* Previous experience in executive assistance, administrative support, or business operations.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace and common business software.
* Comfortable using Canva and learning new technology.
* Reliable computer and internet connection.
* Availability during agreed-upon U.S. business hours; Pacific Time preferred.

**Bonus points for:** HighLevel experience, CRM management, marketing automation, customer service, or experience supporting entrepreneurs.

Compensation & Growth

* **Starting pay: $24–$28/hour**, based on experience and demonstrated abilities.
* Opportunities for quarterly bonuses tied to overall company sales performance.
* Approximately 10-20 hours per week initially, with potential for additional hours.
* Remote work with flexible scheduling.
* Paid training and onboarding.
* Employee discounts.
* Opportunities for increased compensation and responsibilities.

We're looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship and growing alongside the business.

Our Values

**Truth:** Be honest, own your mistakes, and communicate openly.

**Responsibility:** Take initiative, follow through, and look for ways to contribute beyond the minimum.

**Heart:** Care about your work, your teammates, and the customers who depend on us.

We believe in working smarter, taking pride in what we do, and treating our customers' experiences as if they were our own.

How to Apply

**Attention to detail matters. Please follow these instructions carefully.**

Email your application to **QualityCustomGifts@gmail.com**.

**Subject line:** I actually read the instructions

Please include:

* **Your resume in PDF format**, named Lastname.Firstname.ExecutiveAssistant.pdf.
* **A brief introduction** explaining your relevant experience and why this position interests you.
* **Problem-Solving:** Tell us about a time you were given a problem you didn't know how to solve. What did you do, and what was the outcome?
* **Personal Question:** What does the following quote mean to you? *"Work is love made visible." - Khalil Gibran*

Please keep your responses thoughtful but concise. Specific examples are more valuable than generic answers.

**Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.**

Our Hiring Process

Qualified applicants will be invited to interview. Finalists may be asked to complete a brief, paid practical exercise to demonstrate their problem-solving and organizational skills.

**If you're a dependable, resourceful problem-solver who loves making things happen, we'd love to hear from you!**

Pay: $24.00 - $29.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10.0 – 20.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

5051838264f7347b84ee.title: Immigration Evaluation & Practice Operations Coordinator
5051838264f7347b84ee.description:
**Overview**  
Immigration Evaluation & Practice Operations Coordinator

The Immigration Evaluation & Practice Operations Coordinator supports the daily administrative and operational functions of Still Waters Therapeutic Services, LLC, with a primary focus on psychological immigration evaluations, client coordination, attorney communications, and practice development.

This position keeps evaluation workflows organized, ensures timely communication and documentation, monitors deadlines, and supports efficient scheduling, referral management, and administrative processes. You'll work collaboratively with the practice owner, clients, attorneys, and other professionals to ensure evaluations progress efficiently while maintaining professionalism, confidentiality, and accuracy.

**Duties**

* Coordinate psychological immigration evaluation workflows, including client inquiries, intake documentation, scheduling, case tracking, and report delivery.
* Communicate professionally with clients, immigration attorneys, referral partners, and internal team members to provide updates and coordinate next steps.
* Track evaluation deadlines, maintain organized client records, identify missing documentation, and ensure timely administrative follow-up.
* Support attorney referral development through contact management, outreach coordination, follow-up communications, and relationship tracking.
* Manage daily administrative responsibilities, including scheduling, calendar management, email correspondence, client reminders, and electronic record organization.
* Maintain and improve standard operating procedures (SOPs), administrative workflows, tracking systems, and organizational processes.
* Utilize electronic health record systems, CRM platforms, spreadsheets, and administrative software to maintain accurate documentation and monitor practice activities.
* Coordinate with billing personnel to monitor outstanding balances, payment tracking, billing concerns, and administrative follow-up.
* Assist with professional training programs, including registration, webinar coordination, participant communications, training materials, and administrative support.
* Support practice growth initiatives, networking activities, professional outreach, and continuous improvement of operational procedures.
* Maintain confidentiality and follow applicable HIPAA requirements and established organizational policies.

**Experience**

* Strong organizational skills, professional written and verbal communication, attention to detail, time management, and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Previous experience in healthcare administration, behavioral health services, legal administration, immigration services, case coordination, or practice operations is preferred.
* Experience coordinating client intake, scheduling appointments, maintaining confidential records, and managing professional communications.
* Familiarity with electronic health records (EHR), SimplePractice, CRM platforms, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or similar administrative systems is preferred.
* Knowledge of HIPAA requirements, confidentiality standards, and appropriate handling of sensitive client information.
* Strong project coordination skills, including tracking deadlines, organizing documentation, following established procedures, and monitoring workflow progress.
* Experience communicating with attorneys, referral partners, healthcare professionals, or clients in a professional service environment is an asset.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining accountability, accuracy, responsiveness, and consistent communication.
* Experience supporting business development, referral management, training coordination, or professional education programs is a plus.
* Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills are a plus.

**Position Details**

* **Employment Type:** Part-time
* **Work Arrangement:** Fully remote
* **Starting Hours:** 15–20 hours per week
* **Compensation:** $20–$25 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications

**Important:** This is a non-clinical administrative position. The coordinator will not conduct psychological evaluations, provide therapy, diagnose clients, make independent clinical determinations, or offer legal or immigration advice. All clinical matters must be referred to the appropriate licensed or authorized professionals.

Pay: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15.0 – 20.0 per week

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience managing client intake, scheduling appointments, and tracking documentation or case deadlines?
* How many years of experience do you have in healthcare administration, legal administration, immigration services, or case coordination?
* Are you comfortable using electronic health records, CRM systems, spreadsheets, and scheduling software?
* Do you have experience communicating with attorneys, referral partners, or healthcare professionals?
* . Briefly describe how you organize competing deadlines, missing documents, and follow-ups across multiple cases or clients.

Work Location: Remote

99c394477c0852537c28.description:

 **Job Description**

Red Wing is seeking an Account Coordinator to join our Direct-to-Consumer team, supporting our Industrial and Direct to Consumer channels. The Mobile Account Coordinator supports the onboarding, activation, and ongoing management of mobile service accounts by partnering closely with Inside Sales, Operations, and other cross-functional teams. The role helps facilitate a smooth transition from prospect to active customer, ensuring schedules, resources, and internal communications are aligned to deliver a high-quality customer experience and support business growth. The coordinator assists with new-account activation and conversion, partnering closely with the Inside Sales team and other departments to help move opportunities from prospect to active account while supporting operational readiness and alignment across the organization.

* Notify the Industrial team when additional business is needed to fill available capacity.

**Cross-Department Coordination**

* Identify available trucks, equipment, personnel, and other assets needed to support new business.
* Confirm company capabilities and capacity before commitments are finalized.
* Maintain clear communication among Sales, Inside Sales, Operations, Scheduling, and account stakeholders.

**New-Account Activation and Conversion Support**

* Partner with the Inside Sales team to support the conversion of qualified prospects into active accounts by coordinating timelines, resources, and internal handoffs.
* Assist with coordinating onboarding requirements, timelines, resources, and internal assignments.

* Support the transition of new opportunities into active, successfully serviced accounts.

**Reporting and Process Improvement**

* Identify recurring scheduling or onboarding challenges and recommend process improvements.
* Help develop consistent procedures for evaluating, activating, and transitioning new accounts.

  
**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Three (3) or more years of experience in customer service, scheduling, coordination, revenue operations support, sales support, or supporting cross-functional sales teams is required.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Knowledge of customer service, account support, scheduling, and coordination processes.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, schedules, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively interact with customers, sales teams, and operational partners.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, including the ability to identify issues and coordinate appropriate solutions.
* High level of attention to detail, accuracy, and follow-through.
* Ability to build collaborative working relationships across departments and functions.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Excel, and Teams, and the ability to learn new software and systems.
* Ability to analyze scheduling, account, and operational information to support effective planning and resource utilization.

**Work Environment:**

This role is fully remote and operates within U.S. Central Time (CT) business hours, giving you the flexibility to work from any state where the company is authorized to conduct business and employ workers. As a Clinical Operations Coordinator at Talkiatry, you will partner with our Clinical and Operational leaders (dyad leadership team) to drive clinician satisfaction and operational excellence. Your primary focus is on providing excellent experience for our clinicians by fielding, responding, and/or escalating questions that arise in their day-to-day practice.

In addition, you will coordinate key operational processes such as provider preferences, clinician time-off, clinician pre-ramp preparation, and clinician offboarding. Your seamless service and detail orientation will alleviate administrative burden for our clinicians and leadership (Chief Psychiatrists and Nurse Practitioner Director) in ways that make Talkiatry truly a special place to work. To be successful in this role, you will need exceptional organizational skills, clear communication, and the ability to adapt to the unique needs of each clinician or leader.

  

**About Talkiatry:**
--------------------

Talkiatry is transforming mental health care by making high-quality psychiatry more accessible, human, and sustainable for both patients and clinicians. Co-founded by a patient and a triple-board-certified psychiatrist, we were built to solve one of healthcare’s most urgent challenges: millions of people struggle to access mental health care, while clinicians face growing administrative burden and burnout. Through our technology-powered, in-network platform, we’re changing that, creating a better experience for patients and empowering clinicians to focus on delivering exceptional care.

  

Today, Talkiatry is the largest dedicated psychiatry practice in the U.S., with 750+ psychiatrists, 250+ therapists, and more than two million patient visits delivered nationwide. At our scale, every innovation has real impact. Every workflow we improve, every technology solution we build, and every patient experience we redesign helps thousands of clinicians provide better care to hundreds of thousands of patients. We’re not just growing quickly — we’re redefining how behavioral healthcare is delivered in America.

  

Joining Talkiatry means joining a mission-driven team that is solving complex problems at scale, driving meaningful change in healthcare, and building the future of mental health care with compassion, innovation, and purpose.

* Process provider preference changes to ensure patients are appropriately matched with providers

* Schedule onboarding introduction meetings for new hire clinicians and execute our Onboarding Checklist

* Excellent follow-through that is proactive and responsive.
* Proactive problem-solving skills and adaptability to changing plans and priorities.
* Exceptional customer service skills and a high level of organizational knowledge.
* Skilled with Microsoft Office Suite.
* Familiar with working in EMRs (big plus if eClinicalWorks (eCW))

* A readiness to assume other duties as assigned

* Must be proficient in Microsoft Office, including Outlook

76b55ed17212aaaebf6c.title: Talent Operations Specialist
76b55ed17212aaaebf6c.description:
#### **Description**

At Rankings.io, the candidate experience doesn’t end when someone signs an offer. We’re looking for an Talent Operations Specialist who can turn that “yes” into an exceptional new-hire experience — one that is organized, intentional, and consistent from the moment an offer is accepted through an employee’s first several months with the company.

As a fast-growing, fully remote digital marketing agency serving law firms, we need someone who thrives behind the scenes making sure every detail is handled, every new hire feels supported, and nothing falls through the cracks.

##### **Your Mission: Create an Exceptional New-Hire Experience**

You’ll own the onboarding experience from signed offers through Day 90 and help support employees beyond onboarding through structured check-ins, surveys, and stay interviews. You’ll partner closely with Talent Acquisition, HR, IT, and hiring managers to ensure every new hire has the tools, training plan, communication, and support they need to hit the ground running.

This is more than checking boxes. You’ll own and continuously improve a process that includes dozens of moving pieces for every hire while helping us create an onboarding experience that supports engagement, retention, and long-term success.

#### **Responsibilities**

* Own the full onboarding lifecycle for every new hire from signed offer through Day 90, managing approximately 30–50+ onboarding tasks per hire.
* Partner with hiring managers to develop structured 30/60/90-day training plans and maintain those plans in ClickUp.
* Conduct and manage our new-hire check-in cadence, including 1-week, 30-day, 60-day, and 90-day check-ins.
* Coordinate the 6-month employee survey and quarterly stay interviews to better understand the employee experience beyond initial onboarding.
* Conduct stay interviews and communicate meaningful feedback and trends to department leaders and Human Resources.
* Partner closely with the IT Director to ensure new hires have the appropriate systems, access, and login credentials prior to their start date.
* Coordinate with Talent Acquisition, HR, IT and hiring managers to ensure employee information and onboarding requirements are completed accurately and on time in Rippling.
* Partner with the Experience Coordinator to ensure every new hire receives their new-hire swag.
* Serve as a consistent point of contact for new hires throughout their onboarding and early employee experience.
* Maintain organized and accurate onboarding documentation across Rippling, ClickUp, Notion, and other internal systems.
* Identify gaps, bottlenecks, and opportunities to continuously improve our fully remote onboarding experience.
* Support Talent Acquisition, recruiting initiatives and overflow as needed, which may include proactive candidate sourcing and outreach during high-volume hiring periods.

#### **Requirements**

* Experience in onboarding, Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, recruiting coordination, People Operations, or a similar role.
* Experience managing multiple employees or candidates through different stages of a structured process simultaneously.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage 15–20 new hires at different stages of onboarding without losing sight of the details.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to create a welcoming, white glove employee experience.
* Comfortable taking ownership of a process from beginning to end rather than simply executing an existing checklist.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, fully remote environment where priorities and hiring volume can shift quickly.
* Genuine interest in employee engagement, retention, and building an onboarding experience that sets people up for long-term success.

#### **Benefits**

* Starting Salary of $60,000
* Fully Remote
* Unlimited PTO
* $100 Wellness Reimbursement Program
* Quarterly training stipend for Professional Development
* 401(k) with 3% Employer match (Safe Harbor)
* 100% Employer-Paid Health Insurance (For Employee)

#### **What to Expect in the Interview Process**

* **Resume Review**: Applications and resumes are reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team.
* **One Way Interview:** Selected candidates will receive a link to answer a short set of questions by video. Please plan to record your responses in your typical work-from-home environment, ensuring it is well-lit and free of distractions.
* **Live Zoom Interview:** Candidates who move forward will meet with Head of Talent Acquisition for a live Zoom interview to discuss experience, role expectations, and team fit.
* **Final Live Zoom Interview:** Candidates who move forward will meet with Head of Talent Acquisition and VP of HR.

Our Talent Acquisition team plays an important role in Express Flooring's continued growth, helping ensure we have the right people in place to support our teams and deliver an exceptional experience for our customers. Behind every successful hire is a recruiting process that is organized, responsive, and accurate—from the moment a position opens through a new employee's first day.

As a **Recruiting Coordinator**, you'll be at the center of that process, helping keep every detail moving forward. You'll support requisitions, offers, pre-employment requirements, and onboarding while partnering closely with Recruiters, Hiring Managers, Human Resources, Payroll, IT, and candidates.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, stays ahead of the details, communicates proactively, and takes pride in creating a seamless experience for candidates and hiring teams.

**Job Type:** Remote; Full-Time (Must reside on CST or MST time zone)

**Full-Cycle Recruitment**
--------------------------

* Manage high-volume, full-cycle recruitment for Dental Assistants, Front Office Staff, Treatment Coordinators, and other practice-level roles.
* Create and maintain job postings across applicant tracking systems and job boards.
* Source and engage candidates through job boards, resume databases, referrals, and other channels.
* Review applications, conduct phone screens, and assess candidate qualifications.
* Coordinate interviews and maintain timely communication with candidates and hiring managers.
* Partner with Practice Administrators and hiring managers to understand staffing priorities across locations.
* Prepare and extend employment offers and coordinate pre-employment steps.
* Track applicant pipelines, follow up promptly, and manage multiple open requisitions and urgent staffing needs.

**Onboarding & New Hire Experience**
------------------------------------

* Coordinate new hire onboarding, including documentation, background checks, and pre-employment requirements.
* Serve as a point of contact for new hires and help ensure they are prepared for their first day.
* Enter and maintain accurate employee information in ADP and other HR systems.

**I-9 & Compliance**
--------------------

* Complete, review, and maintain Form I-9 employment eligibility verification in accordance with applicable requirements.
* Monitor outstanding documentation and support accurate, confidential recordkeeping and audits.

**Recruitment Operations & Collaboration**
------------------------------------------

* Provide regular recruiting updates to practice leaders and HR leadership.
* Track open positions, candidate activity, and recruiting progress; identify opportunities to improve time-to-fill and candidate experience.
* Support additional recruiting initiatives and HR projects as needed.

**QUALIFICATIONS**
==================

* Previous experience in recruiting, staffing, HR, or talent acquisition preferred; entry-level candidates with strong transferable skills are encouraged to apply.
* Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred, not required.
* Experience with applicant tracking systems or HRIS platforms preferred; ADP experience is a plus.
* High-volume recruiting, healthcare, dental, or multi-location experience is a plus.
* Strong communication, organization, time management, and technology skills.

* Hands-on experience in full-cycle recruiting and HR operations.

Starting salary: approximately $52,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications.

**SUMMARY:** The Service Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and managing field service work orders from initial request through completion, ensuring timely service delivery, accurate documentation, and effective communication with customers, technicians, and internal teams.

This role operates in a fast-paced, high-volume, 24/7 service environment, supporting both routine and emergency service requests. The position requires strong organizational skills, adaptability, sound judgment, and the ability to independently manage competing priorities while collaborating closely with team members.

Service Coordinators must be dependable, self-motivated, and comfortable working during shifts when direct leadership support may be limited.

This position requires a reliable internet connection and a dedicated workspace in a quiet environment suitable for focused work.

**PRIMARY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**WORK ORDER MANAGEMENT & SCHEDULING**

* Receive, review, and prioritize incoming service requests based on customer requirements, service level agreements (SLAs), and urgency.
* Source qualified field technicians and vendors based on technical requirements, availability, location, and cost considerations.
* Confirm technician qualifications, availability, rates, and necessary equipment or tools prior to scheduling.
* Communicate work order details, expectations, and scheduling requirements to assigned resources.

**DISPATCH MONITORING & SERVICE COORDINATION**

* Manage work orders throughout the service lifecycle, including scheduling, technician arrival, onsite progress, and completion.
* Monitor service commitments and proactively address potential delays, scheduling conflicts, or resource challenges.
* Coordinate with technicians, customers, and internal support teams to resolve service-related issues.
* Adapt quickly to changing priorities, emergency requests, and unexpected service challenges.
* Recognize situations requiring escalation and communicate concerns to the appropriate parties.

**COMMUNICATION & COLLABORATION**

* Maintain proactive, professional communication with customers, technicians, vendors, and internal teams.
* Provide timely updates regarding service schedules, progress, delays, and completion.
* Collaborate with fellow coordinators to balance workloads, share responsibilities, and maintain service continuity.
* Ensure clear communication and accurate handoffs of outstanding work between shifts.

**QUALITY, DOCUMENTATION & PERFORMANCE**

* Maintain accurate and timely work order documentation, including service updates, technician arrival/departure times, and completion details.
* Review technician deliverables, work order details, and associated charges for accuracy and compliance.
* Follow established operational procedures, quality standards, customer requirements, and company policies.
* Meet established performance expectations, service level commitments, and quality objectives.
* Independently manage workload, demonstrate accountability, and proactively address issues with limited supervision.
* Identify and communicate recurring issues or opportunities for process improvement.

**COMPETENCIES & KEY SKILLS**

* Customer Service: Strong customer-focused approach with the ability to manage expectations and handle challenging situations professionally.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with internal and external stakeholders.
* Organization & Time Management: Ability to manage multiple work orders, competing priorities, and time-sensitive requests efficiently.
* Independent Judgment & Accountability: Self-motivated with the ability to make informed decisions, take initiative, and work effectively with limited supervision.
* Problem-Solving & Adaptability: Ability to assess information, identify solutions, and respond effectively to unexpected challenges.
* Teamwork & Collaboration: Ability to work effectively in a highly collaborative environment where responsibilities and workloads are shared.
* Attention to Detail: Strong focus on accuracy, documentation, and adherence to established processes.
* Technical Proficiency: Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications and the ability to learn and navigate multiple software systems.
* Related Experience: One or more years of experience in dispatch, service coordination, scheduling, customer support, or a related field preferred. Direct industry experience is beneficial but not required.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT & SCHEDULE**

* Operates within a 24/7 service environment, with assigned schedules potentially including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
* Requires dependable attendance, responsiveness, and the ability to maintain productivity during assigned shifts.
* Must be comfortable working independently during periods of limited leadership availability while appropriately escalating concerns.

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:**

* High School diploma or equivalent
* At least one year of previous customer service experience required

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

* Requires regular use of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse and other standard office equipment
* Ability to listen, comprehend, and respond to spoken communication in both in-person and remote setting (e.g., phone calls, video conferencing).
* Ability to view and read information on a computer screen for extended periods, including the capacity to adjust focus as needed to process information effectively.

Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!

O.N.E Purpose:

* **Customer Obsession:** Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.
* **Embracing New Ideas:** Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.
* **Striving for Excellence:** Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

**The Opportunity:**

**ENTRY LEVEL CAREER OPPORTUNITY OFFERING:**

* Bonus Incentives
* Paid Certifications
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Comprehensive Benefits
* Career Advancement
* This position pays between $17.00 - 18.15/hr based on experience

**\*\*\*This position is an onsite role, and candidates must be able to work on-site at Tower - Pottstown Hospital, Pottstown, PA\*\*\***

We are searching for the next Patient Access Specialist champion. This role is responsible for performing admitting duties for all patients admitted for services at the hospital. They are responsible for performing these functions while meeting the mission and goals of the organization and all regulatory compliance requirements. The Representative will work within the policies and processes as they are being performed across the entire organization.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Patient Access staff are responsible for assigning accurate MRNs, completing medical necessity / compliance checks, providing proper patient instructions, collecting insurance information, receiving, and processing physician orders, and utilizing an overlay tool while providing excellent customer service as measured by Press Ganey.
* Operates the telephone switchboard to relay incoming, outgoing, and inter-office calls as applicable.
* They are to adhere to policies and provide excellent customer service in these interactions with the appropriate level of compassion.
* Patient Access staff will be held accountable for point of service goals as assigned.
* Patient Access staff are responsible for the utilization of quality auditing and reporting systems to ensure accounts are corrected. These activities may include accounts for other employees, departments, and facilities. Conducts audits of accounts and assures that all forms are completed accurate, timely to meet audit standards and provides statistical data to Patient Access leadership.
* Patient Access Staff are responsible for the pre-registration of patient accounts prior to patient visits. This may include inbound and outbound calling to obtain demographic, insurance, and other patient information including the patient financial liabilities including collecting point of service collections as well as past due balances including payment plan options.
* The Patient Access Staff explains general consent for treatment forms to the patient/guarantor/legal guardian, obtains necessary signatures and witness’s name. Explains and distributes patient education documents, such as Important Message from Medicare, Important Message from Tricare, Observation Forms, MOON form, Consent forms, and all forms implemented for future services.
* Reviews eligibility responses in insurance verification system and appropriately selects the applicable insurance plan code, enters benefit data into system to support POS (Point of Service Collections) and billing processes to assist with a clean claim rate.
* Responsible for accurately screening of medical necessity using the Advanced Beneficiary Notice (ABN) software to inform Medicare patients of possible non-payment of test by Medicare and distribution of the ABN as appropriate. Responsible for distribution and documentation of other designated forms and pamphlets.

**Experience We Love:**

* 1+ years of customer service experience
* Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences.

**Minimum Education:**

* High School Diploma/GED Required

**Certifications**:

* CRCR Required within 9 months of hire (Company Paid)

**VIVO Infusion - Patient Access Lead**

**Remote**

**Compensation:**

* Pay Range: $28.00 - $30.00/Hour
* Bonus Plan Target: 5% Annually (Based on performance)
* Private Equity for the Greater Good - Company-wide Employee Ownership Program

**Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental, Vision
  + HSA w/ Employer Contribution
  + Touchcare - Insurance Concierge Service
* 401K with Match up to 4%
* PTO: Accrual 3+ weeks
  + PTO Rollover and PTO Donation Program.
* Wellness Reimbursement Program - $360 Annually
* Employee Referral Bonus - Uncapped Bonus Potential
* Tuition Assistance Program & Professional Association Reimbursement
* Employee Assistance Program (Employer-provided)
* Short & long-term disability (Employer-provided)
* Life Insurance (Employer-provided)

**Employment Type, Schedule, FLSA Status:**

* Full-time
* Position Scheduled:
  + Monday-Friday | Flexible hours 7:00am - 7:00pm EST
* Non-Exempt

**Reports to:** Patient Access Manager

**Location:**

* **The Patient Access Specialist will work remotely from a home office with a secure network. Only candidates residing in the states below at the time of employment will be able to be considered. Travel with Vivo equipment is not permitted without prior approval.**

  Arizona, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, North Carolina, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Nevada, New York, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Wisconsin, Wyoming, Washington D.C.

As the Patient Access Lead you will support the Patient Services department and facilitate the infusion admission process. Individuals in this role will collaborate with and support the Patient Access Managers by ensuring the thorough and accurate processing of referrals and updated orders to include insurance eligibility and benefits verifications, prior approvals, and data entry. In addition, Patient Access Leads support continuity of care for existing patients by ensuring that eligibility, current financial documents, and prior approval renewals are reviewed and maintained prior to patient appointments. The lead is responsible for prioritizing, organizing, and delegating tasks to the Patient Access Specialists; completing audits and reviews; training new and existing employees; and handling escalated needs and calls.

**For this position, applicants must have the following experience:**

* **3+ years of experience working in high-volume insurance verification, benefits, and eligibility/authorizations.**
* **2 years of medical billing and authorizations or managing physician referrals.**
* **1 year experience working in a customer service or patient facing role.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Subject Matter Expert (SME) in all aspects of the Patient Access functions, responsibilities, and processes & procedures.
* Proficient in all applicable systems, programs, resources, and tools.
* Assists with all Patient Access functions as needed per business demands.
* Knowledgeable of all Patient Services roles and able to assist workload as needed.
* Maintain working knowledge of insurance contracts and exclusions.
* Maintain knowledge of applicable CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes
* Maintain familiarity with drug copay assistance program requirements to determine whether a patient meets base eligibility conditions.
* Uphold and promote adherence to HIPAA guidelines.
* Generate and manipulate Excel spreadsheets to sort, condense, and prioritize data.
* Demonstrate exceptional written and verbal communication skills when interacting with insurances, referring office staff, patients, and internal & clinical staff.
* Communicate and maintain contact with the Patient Navigator, Medical Records Review, and Patient Resources teams regarding patient accounts, referral documentation, insurance and coordination of benefits concerns, patient financial documents, prior approvals, referrals, etc.
* Utilize appropriate templates, naming conventions, formats, and email distribution lists for system notations and email & task communication.
* Conduct training for new and existing employees, to include onboarding and refresher training sessions.
* Acts as a key point of contact for the Patient Access team
* Assists Patient Access Managers in driving team goals, guidelines, and expectations.
* Monitor team workload and productivity.
* Complete regular Quality Assurance (QA) audits.
* Responds to escalations and concerns.
* Makes recommendations for improvements to established processes and procedures.
* Run and build daily, weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reports for review and assignment.
* Facilitate schedule review reports, authorization tracking, and other routine reports.
* Assist and support leadership in communication regarding process changes, function and responsibility coverage, and guidelines updates.
* Assist with managing the workload and coordinates coverage assistance when necessary to ensure that referrals and orders are handled in a timely manner.
* Identify and escalate team performance issues and communicate concerns to manager.
* Collaborates with manager in educating team members toward improvement and provides peer feedback as directed.
* Act as key participant and co-presenter on weekly calls as outlined by manager

**Secondary responsibilities:**

29db776454b2aeeeb22a.title: Community House Manager
29db776454b2aeeeb22a.description:
The Community House Manager (CHM) is responsible for managing group homes for Individuals with developmental disabilities. This professional is responsible for maintaining a safe, supportive, home environment which facilitates the development of independence, empowerment, and self-help skills among Individuals. This professional is responsible for promoting KenCCID’s vision, mission and values, and in implementing the best practices in the “Everyday Lives” publication from the Office of Developmental Programs (ODP).

The CHM is responsible for four core duties; directing care for up to six (6) Individuals residing at assigned homes, ensuring that assigned homes meet the compliance standards, managing allocated funds and resources for assigned homes, and supervising the work of Direct Support Professionals (DSPs) at assigned homes. Other duties may be assigned on an as-need basis.

The intent of this description is to provide a representative summary of the major duties and responsibilities performed by incumbents of this job. Incumbents may be requested to perform job-related tasks other than those specifically presented in this description.

The CHM position is a full-time non-exempt hourly position. The CHM is required to be present at assigned homes on a scheduled basis. This position works in conjunction with Program Specialists (PS), and reports to a Residential Director (RD). As KenCCID operates its homes on a 24-hour, 365 day a year basis, the CHM will have the opportunity to work overtime hours, if approved by the RD.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Ensures that all Individuals are being treated with respect and dignity and that the rights of the Individuals are observed at all times
* Responsible for all assigned homes being in compliance with the group home licensing requirements set forth in Pennsylvania law (55 Pa. Code § 6400, hereinafter “6400 regulations”)
* Manages and administers all financial accounts for assigned homes
* Supervises the work of all Direct Support Professionals (DSPs) assigned to the homes
* Other duties as assigned

**Working with Individuals**

* Ensures that the specified services provided in the Individual Service Plans (ISPs) for each individual are provided, focusing on quality of life for Individuals
* Submits monthly reports on the Individual’s progress towards ISP outcomes to RD
* Collaborates with PS and RD to review ISPs, behavior plans, assessments and medical histories regularly to ensure that all services are provided as required; reports on any recommendations, changes, or discrepancies in the plan
* Attends and participates in ISP reviews or other meetings related to the Individual
* Coordinates medical care for Individuals; reviews daily medication log and ensures that all Individuals meet all medical and dental appointments
* Ensures that nutritional needs of Individuals are met, including ensuring that healthy food for Individuals is available and that Individuals follow any and all dietary guidelines and recommendations
* Participates in the ongoing assessments, updates, and recommendations for the ISP
* Reports any and all issues involving potential abuse or neglect of an Individual to Incident Management staff; completes incident reports and works with Incident Management on any investigations
* Understands basics of social services system, Medicaid, ODP waiver programs, ISPs, staffing ratios, etc.
* Works directly with family members, support coordinators, medical treatment teams, and others to support Individual goals
* Works with outside stakeholders and service agencies to coordinate services; ensures transportation for Individuals to day program sites, job sites, or other appointments

**Working with Compliance Issues**

* Ensures that all homes comply with the 6400 regulations on a daily basis
* Ensures that safety equipment in all homes is in good working order, including but not limited to smoke detectors, security alarms, fire extinguishers, etc.
* Monitors upkeep and maintenance of all assigned homes and files requests with maintenance staff for needed repairs
* Prepares and submits weekly written reports on compliance status for all assigned homes
* Alerts RDs of compliance issues at sites and resolves issues within 24 hours
* Reviews and submits service notes, medical information, and other documentation through KenCCID’s electronic records database
* Conducts required monthly fire drills, reviews outcomes of fire drills with Individuals and staff, and documents status of drills
* Responsible for compliance with federal OSHA standards at all assigned homes
* Remains in compliance with ODP requirements regarding training, physicals, tuberculosis testing, and drivers license

**Working with Fiscal Issues**

* Allocates and reconciles petty cash to the DSPs for food, shopping, and necessities for the individual
* Ensures that groceries and all items purchased for the home are audited and delivered, and allocated for the Individual’s use *only*
* Responsible for upkeep and maintenance of all KenCCID vehicles assigned to homes; monitors vehicle log and GPS reports, reports any damage to vehicles, and ensures that all vehicles are clean and gas levels do not drop below a quarter tank
* Collaborates with fiscal department on all work orders or bids for maintenance services

**Working with Direct Support Professionals (DSPs)**

* Ensures that DSPs complete assigned job responsibilities pursuant to their job descriptions and the Individual’s ISP
* Serve as role model and mentor for DSPs in terms of attendance, professionalism, and work ethic
* Align DSP performance with KenCCID mission and values
* Works with scheduling coordinator to ensure that DSPs are available to meet staffing ratios for all assigned homes
* Reviews and approves requests for paid time off and collaborates with HR and payroll on any attendance, timesheet, or benefits issues
* Provides site-specific orientation for all new employees stationed at assigned homes, including training on ISPs
* Provides quarterly site-specific refresher orientation for all employees stationed at assigned homes, including training on ISPs, assessment and medical history
* Observes, measures, and evaluates DSP job performance, utilizing supervision and evaluation tools
* Enforces KenCCID’s standards of conduct and discipline and documents issues where these standards are violated; collaborates with HR to issue verbal and written warnings
* Collaborates with training coordinator to provide ongoing training for DSPs, and ensures that all DSPs are current on training requirements, including but not limited to online training, medication administration, first aid and CPR, and on working with nonverbal Individuals
* Engages staff in frequent review of fire safety procedures, evacuation procedures, and the designated safe place outside the home in the event of a fire
* Understands contents of union contract, employee handbook and employee benefits in managing work of DSPs

**Minimum Education and Experience Requirements**

* Experience working face to face with people in a customer service, health/human services or business environment, ideally with demonstrated supervision of employees in a direct care or community home environment that supports individuals with disabilities
* Associate degree in related field with three years of experience, or high school diploma or equivalent with five years of experience
* **V****alid** Driver’s License
* Ability to read and understand English as it relates to reading medical prescriptions, directions, recipes, policies, procedures and directions for managing the daily life and activities of Individuals and a safe and healthy home
* Basic technology literacy, including, but not limited to the ability to read and respond to email, generate reports and access online resources
* Ability to use online records technology, including scanning and uploading documents to a database
* Proven communication skills both written and verbal
* Patient and caring work attitude
* Able to effectively multitask
* Math and finance aptitude
* Health conscious and organized in maintaining clean, safe environment
* Demonstrated home management skills, to include, budget management, cleaning, menu preparation and nutrition and emergency steps

**Position Competencies**

  

* Proven Supervisory skills
* Ability to direct and advise others in the execution of their duties
* Skilled at giving direction and able to train employees on job related content
* Demonstrated care-giving skills
* Able to evaluate and assess Individuals’ behavior and make applicable recommendations
* Ability to follow written directions/plans and record results
* Demonstrated home management expertise
* Skilled at budget/financial management
* Effective at managing crisis to resolution
* Ability to keep accurate records
* Work well under pressure
* Proficient at working with others for common goal
* Attention to detail and accuracy
* Consistently show sound judgment
* Ability to adapt to spontaneous situations

**Physical Requirements**

  

* Must be able to lift 40 pounds & possess physical dexterity
* Must be able to shovel snow, climb/walk up stairs
* Physical capability to perform household chores
* Physical ability for wheelchair transfer, walking, lifting pushing wheelchair when required
* Ability to drive a modified van
* Ability to sit long hours
* Adequate sight/vision capability to be able to read small print on medication labels

**KenCCID is an equal opportunity employer and does not discrimination in the terms and conditions of employment of any person based on their age, sex, race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, domestic violence status, pregnancy status, marital status, disability status veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants who require an accommodation to participate in the recruiting process for this position should ensure that this request is included in their application for the position**
